lotr00106.subtitle: Captain of the King's Guard (P)
lotr00106.game_text: Hama is strength +1 for each Shadow possession you can spot. Each time Hama wins a skirmish, you may discard a possession from play.

lotr00107.name: Guard of the White Tree (P)
lotr00107.game_text: Knight. Skirmish: Discard a [Gondor] condition from your support area to make this companion strength +2.

lotr00108.name: The Witch-king, Captain of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00108.subtitle: Captain of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00108.game_text: Fierce. Toil 2. (For each [Ringwraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lotr00108.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set0/lotr00108/The Witch-king, Captain of the Nine Riders (P) (0P108).jpg

lotr00109.name: Ulaire Attea, Second of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00109.subtitle: Second of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00109.game_text: Fierce. Each time Ulaire Attea is assigned to a fierce skirmish involving a character who has resistance 4 or less, you may exert Ulaire Attea to add a burden.
lotr00109.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set0/lotr00109/Ulaire Attea, Second of the Nine Riders (P) (0P109).jpg

lotr00110.name: Ulaire Nelya, Third of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00110.subtitle: Third of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00110.game_text: Fierce. Shadow: Exert Ulaire Nelya to replace the fellowship's current site with a site from your adventure deck.
lotr00110.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set0/lotr00110/Ulaire Nelya, Third of the Nine Riders (P) (0P110).jpg

lotr00111.name: Ulaire Cantea, Fourth of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00111.subtitle: Fourth of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00111.game_text: While Ulaire Cantea is at a forest or dwelling site, he is strength +2 and fierce.
lotr00111.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set0/lotr00111/Ulaire Cantea, Fourth of the Nine Riders (P) (0P111).jpg

lotr00112.name: Ulaire Lemenya, Fifth of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00112.subtitle: Fifth of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00112.game_text: Each character skirmishing Ulaire Lemenya who has resistance 5 or less is strength -3.
lotr00112.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set0/lotr00112/Ulaire Lemenya, Fifth of the Nine Riders (P) (0P112).jpg

lotr00113.name: Ulaire Enquea, Sixth of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00113.subtitle: Sixth of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00113.game_text: Fierce. When you play Ulaire Enquea, if you can spot 2 other Nazgul, you may exert 2 unbound companions (or exert each companion if you can spot 6 companions).
lotr00113.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set0/lotr00113/Ulaire Enquea, Sixth of the Nine Riders (P) (0P113).jpg

lotr00114.name: Ulaire Otsea, Seventh of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00114.subtitle: Seventh of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00114.game_text: When you play Ulaire Otsea, you may spot a companion who has X wounds to reveal the top X cards of your draw deck. Take each [Ringwraith] card revealed this way into hand.
lotr00114.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set0/lotr00114/Ulaire Otsea, Seventh of the Nine Riders (P) (0P114).jpg

lotr00115.name: Ulaire Toldea, Eighth of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00115.subtitle: Eighth of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00115.game_text: Fierce. Each time Ulaire Toldea wins a skirmish, you may play the fellowship's next site.
lotr00115.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set0/lotr00115/Ulaire Toldea, Eighth of the Nine Riders (P) (0P115).jpg

lotr00116.name: Ulaire Nertea, Ninth of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00116.subtitle: Ninth of the Nine Riders (P)
lotr00116.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) While Ulaire Nertea is at a forest site, he is strength +2. While you can spot 6 companions, each Nazgul is strength +2.
lotr00116.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set0/lotr00116/Ulaire Nertea, Ninth of the Nine Riders (P) (0P116).jpg

lotr00117.name: Faramir, Prince of Ithilien (P)
lotr00117.subtitle: Prince of Ithilien (P)
lotr00117.game_text: While you can spot Boromir, Faramir is twilight cost -1. While you can spot Denethor, Faramir is twilight cost -1. While Faramir bears a [Gondor] possession, he is defender +1.

lotr00118.name: Eowyn, Restless Warrior (P)
lotr00118.subtitle: Restless Warrior (P)
lotr00118.game_text: Each possession you play on Eowyn during the fellowship phase is twilight cost -1. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may reinforce a [Rohan] token (or reinforce 2 [Rohan] tokens if you can spot Eomer or Theoden).

lotr00119.name: Isildur, Heir of Elendil (P)
lotr00119.subtitle: Heir of Elendil (P)
lotr00119.game_text: Knight. Isildur is resistance +1 for each card in your hand. At the end of any phase, if Isildur has resistance 0, place him in your dead pile. Each time you reconcile, you may draw a card.

lotr00120.name: Isengard Marauder (P)
lotr00120.game_text: To play, discard 3 cards from your hand. While you can spot 2 other [Orc] minions, this minion is fierce.

lotr00121.name: Covetous Uruk (P)
lotr00121.game_text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each possession you spot.

lotr00122.name: Haldir, Sentry of the Golden Wood (P)
lotr00122.subtitle: Sentry of the Golden Wood (P)
lotr00122.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. While the fellowship is at a battleground site, Haldir is strength +2. While the fellowship is at a forest site, Haldir is an archer.

lotr00123.name: Gimli, Eager Hunter (P)
lotr00123.subtitle: Eager Hunter (P)
lotr00123.game_text: Damage +1. Hunter 3. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +3.)

lotr00124.name: Legolas, Fleet-footed Hunter (P)
lotr00124.subtitle: Fleet-footed Hunter (P)
lotr00124.game_text: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Regroup: Exert 2 hunter companions to draw a card.

lotr00125.name: Aragorn, Swift Hunter (P)
lotr00125.subtitle: Swift Hunter (P)
lotr00125.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make a hunter companion strength +1.

lotr00126.name: Lurtz, Now Perfected (P)
lotr00126.subtitle: Now Perfected (P)
lotr00126.game_text: Damage +1. Each time Lurtz wins a skirmish, the Free People's player must exert X companions, where X is the current region number.

lotr00127.name: Aragorn, Defender of Rohan (P)
lotr00127.subtitle: Defender of Rohan (P)
lotr00127.game_text: Valiant. While the Ringbearer is assigned to a skirmish, each [Rohan] companion gains hunter 1.

lotr00128.name: Primitive Brand (P)
lotr00128.game_text: Bearer must be a [Men] minion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish you may transfer this possession to another [Men] minion. If you do, stack a [Men] minion from play on a [Men] possession in your support area.

lotr00129.name: Watcher at Sarn Ford, Ranger of the North (P)
lotr00129.subtitle: Ranger of the North (P)
lotr00129.game_text: Ranger. Skirmish: Exert a [Gondor] Man with a resistance 6 or more to make that Man strength +3.
lotr00129.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set0/lotr00129/Watcher at Sarn Ford, Ranger of the North (P) (0P129).jpg

lotr01001.name: The One Ring, Isildur's Bane
lotr01001.subtitle: Isildur's Bane
lotr01001.game_text: Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, he wears The One Ring until the regroup phase. While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, add 2 burdens instead.
lotr01001.lore: ”…the Ring slipped from his fingers as he swam….”

lotr01002.name: The One Ring, The Ruling Ring
lotr01002.subtitle: The Ruling Ring
lotr01002.game_text: Response: If bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he wears The One Ring until the regroup phase. While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, add a burden instead.
lotr01002.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set1/lotr01002/The One Ring, The Ruling Ring (1C2).jpg

lotr01003.name: Axe Strike
lotr01003.game_text: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +3 if bearing a [Dwarven] hand weapon).
lotr01003.lore: Though Gimli's words were praised by the Lady of Light, he proved his best skill was swinging his axe.

lotr01004.name: Battle Fury
lotr01004.game_text: Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf to make that Dwarf strength +3 and damage +1.
lotr01004.lore: The Dwarves quickly dispatch Orcs and Uruk-hai with their mighty battle axes.

lotr01005.name: Cleaving Blow
lotr01005.game_text: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 and damage +1.
lotr01005.lore: The shoddy workmanship of Orc-smiths cannot withstand the fury of Durin's folk.

lotr01006.name: Delving
lotr01006.game_text: Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf companion to draw 3 cards.
lotr01006.lore: ”'…they delved too greedily and too deep, and disturbed that from which they fled, Durin's Bane.'”

lotr01007.name: Dwarf Guard
lotr01007.lore: Dwarves from Dain's people are stout companions, trustworthy and loyal.

lotr01008.name: Dwarven Armor
lotr01008.game_text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
lotr01008.lore: The strongest armour still being made in Middle-earth is forged by Dwarves. It is so heavy that only they can bear it.

lotr01009.name: Dwarven Axe
lotr01009.game_text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each time a player's minion loses a skirmish to bearer, that player discards the top card from his draw deck.
lotr01009.lore: ”'Buckler and corslet, axe and sword / And shining spears were laid in hoard.'”

lotr01010.name: Dwarven Heart
lotr01010.game_text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. When you play this condition, heal bearer up to 2 times. At the start of each of your turns, exert bearer.
lotr01010.lore: ”'…a Dwarf goes on, be the burden twice his own weight….'”

lotr01011.name: Farin, Dwarven Emissary
lotr01011.subtitle: Dwarven Emissary
lotr01011.game_text: To play, spot a Dwarf. While skirmishing an Orc, Farin is strength +2.
lotr01011.lore: Among the envoys sent to represent the Dwarves of Erebor at the Council of Elrond was Farin, a young but wise Dwarf, and a fierce foe in battle.

lotr01012.name: Gimli, Dwarf of Erebor
lotr01012.subtitle: Dwarf of Erebor
lotr01012.game_text: Damage +1. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, add (2) to place a card from hand beneath your draw deck.
lotr01012.lore: “Gimli now walked ahead by the wizard's side, so eager was he to come to Moria.”

lotr01013.name: Gimli, Son of Gloin
lotr01013.subtitle: Son of Gloin
lotr01013.game_text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Gimli to make him strength +2.

lotr01014.name: Gimli's Battle Axe
lotr01014.game_text: Bearer must be Gimli. He is damage +1. Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may wound an Orc.
lotr01014.lore: “Beside them Gimli stood with his stout legs apart, wielding his dwarf-axe.”

lotr01015.name: Gimli's Helm
lotr01015.game_text: Bearer must be Gimli. He takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase. Skirmish: Discard Gimli's Helm to prevent all wounds to him.
lotr01015.lore: A helm fashioned under the Lonely Mountain protects the head of Gimli the Dwarf.

lotr01016.name: Greatest Kingdom of My People
lotr01016.game_text: Tale. Exert a Dwarf to play this condition. Plays to your support area. Each time your opponent plays an Orc, that player discards the top card of his or her draw deck.
lotr01016.lore: ”'With golden roof and silver floor / And runes of power upon the door.'”

lotr01017.name: Grimir, Dwarven Elder
lotr01017.subtitle: Dwarven Elder
lotr01017.game_text: Fellowship: Exert Grimir to shuffle a [Dwarven] event from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lotr01017.lore: Old and grey after many years spent in exile before the Lonely Mountain was reclaimed, Grimir can still wield his axe with strength.

lotr01018.name: Halls of My Home
lotr01018.game_text: Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf to reveal the top 3 cards of any draw deck. You may discard 1 Shadow card revealed. Return the rest in any order.
lotr01018.lore: ”'I will go and look on the halls of Durin, whatever may wait there….'”

lotr01019.name: Here Lies Balin, Son of Fundin
lotr01019.subtitle: Son of Fundin
lotr01019.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to wound 2 Orcs or to wound 1 Orc twice.
lotr01019.lore: ”'I have looked on Moria, and it is very great, but it has become dark and dreadful; and we have found no sign of my kindred.'”
lotr01019.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set1/lotr01019/Here Lies Balin, Son of Fundin (1C19).jpg

lotr01020.name: Let Them Come!
lotr01020.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a Dwarf wins a skirmish against an Orc, discard that Orc. Discard this condition if a Dwarf loses a skirmish.
lotr01020.lore: ”'There is one Dwarf yet in Moria who still draws breath!'”

lotr01021.name: Lord of Moria
lotr01021.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each Dwarf is damage +1.
lotr01021.lore: Gimli rushed ahead into the vast, empty chamber to see a huge slab of white stone. Knowing instinctively the significance of this tomb, he fell to his knees, overcome with grief.

lotr01022.name: Mithril Shaft
lotr01022.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to discard cards from the top of your draw deck until you choose to stop (limit 5). Add (1) for each card discarded in this way. Take the last card discarded into hand.

lotr01023.name: Nobody Tosses a Dwarf
lotr01023.game_text: Response: If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, make an opponent discard 3 cards from the top of his or her draw deck.
lotr01023.lore: ”'My folk have never had dealings with any of the servants of the Enemy.'”

lotr01024.name: Stairs of Khazad-dum
lotr01024.game_text: Tale. Plays to your support area. While a Dwarf skirmishes a [Moria] minion, that Dwarf is strength +1.

lotr01025.name: Still Draws Breath
lotr01025.game_text: Response: If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, heal that Dwarf.
lotr01025.lore: “When thirteen had fallen the rest fled shrieking, leaving the defenders unharmed….”

lotr01026.name: Their Halls of Stone
lotr01026.game_text: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 if at an underground site).
lotr01026.lore: ”'These are not holes,' said Gimli. 'This is the great realm and city of the Dwarrowdelf. And of old it was not darksome, but full of light and splendour, as is still remembered in our songs.'”

lotr01027.name: Thrarin, Dwarven Smith
lotr01027.subtitle: Dwarven Smith
lotr01027.game_text: Maneuver: Exert Thrarin to allow him to participate in archery fire and skirmishes until the regroup phase.
lotr01027.lore: A blacksmith by trade, Thrarin puts down his hammer and takes up his axe to fight when the need arises.

lotr01028.name: Wealth of Moria
lotr01028.game_text: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all Free Peoples cards revealed into hand and discard the rest.
lotr01028.lore: ”'For here alone in all the world was found Moria-silver, or true-silver as some have called it: mithril is the Elvish name.'”

lotr01029.name: Ancient Enmity
lotr01029.game_text: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +1. If a minion loses this skirmish to that Elf, that minion's owner discards 2 cards at random from hand.
lotr01029.lore: Hard and bitter is the Elven hatred of Orcs, for they have lost many kinsmen to Orc savagery.

lotr01031.name: Asfaloth
lotr01031.game_text: Bearer must be an Elf. When played on Arwen, Asfaloth's twilight cost is -2. While at a plains site, bearer is strength +2. Discard Asfaloth when at an underground site.

lotr01032.name: Border Defenses
lotr01032.game_text: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing an archer).

lotr01033.name: Bow of the Galadhrim
lotr01033.game_text: Bearer must be Legolas. Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion.
lotr01033.lore: “To Legolas she gave a bow such as the Galadhrim used, longer and stouter than the bows of Mirkwood, and strung with a string of elfhair.”

lotr01034.name: Celeborn, Lord of Lorien
lotr01034.subtitle: Lord of Lorien
lotr01034.game_text: Fellowship: Exert Celeborn to heal an [Elven] ally.
lotr01034.lore: “They were clad wholly in white … and the hair of the Lord Celeborn was of silver long and bright; but no sign of age was upon them, unless it were in the depths of their eyes; for these were keen as lances in the starlight, and yet profo

lotr01035.name: The Council of Elrond
lotr01035.game_text: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to play a tale from your draw deck.
lotr01035.lore: ”'You will hear today all that you need in order to understand the purposes of the Enemy …. What shall we do with the Ring, the least of rings, the trifle that Sauron fancies? That is the doom that we must deem.'”

lotr01036.name: Curse Their Foul Feet!
lotr01036.game_text: Fellowship: Exert an Elf to reveal an opponent's hand. That player discards a card from hand for each Orc revealed.
lotr01036.lore: ”'A strong company of Orcs has passed. They crossed the Nimrodel - curse their foul feet in its clean water!'”

lotr01037.name: Defiance
lotr01037.game_text: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a Nazgul).
lotr01037.lore: ”'If you want him, come and claim him!'”

lotr01038.name: Double Shot
lotr01038.game_text: Archery: Spot an Elf archer companion to make the fellowship archery total +1.
lotr01038.lore: “The affray was sharp, but the orcs were dismayed by the fierceness of the defence. Legolas shot two through the throat.”

lotr01039.name: Elf-song
lotr01039.game_text: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to remove a burden.
lotr01039.lore: ”…the beauty of the melodies and of the interwoven words in elven-tongues, even though he understood them little, held him in a spell, as soon as he began to attend to them.”

lotr01040.name: Elrond, Lord of Rivendell
lotr01040.subtitle: Lord of Rivendell
lotr01040.game_text: To play, spot Gandalf or an Elf. At the start of each of your turns, heal every ally whose home is site 3. Fellowship: Exert Elrond to draw a card.
lotr01040.lore: “He was the Lord of Rivendell and mighty among both Elves and Men.”

lotr01041.name: Elven Bow
lotr01041.game_text: Bearer must be an Elf. Bearer is an archer.
lotr01041.lore: ”'We live now upon an island amid many perils, and our hands are more often upon the bowstring than upon the harp.'”

lotr01042.name: Elven Cloak
lotr01042.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. Bearer must be a companion. The minion archery total is -1.
lotr01042.lore: ”'…never before have we clad strangers in the garb of our own people.'”

lotr01043.name: Far-seeing Eyes
lotr01043.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time you play an Elf, choose an opponent to discard a card from hand.
lotr01043.lore: Keen Elven eyes see farther and more clearly than those of Men or Dwarves.

lotr01044.name: Foul Creation
lotr01044.game_text: Fellowship: Exert an Elf to reveal an opponent's hand. You may discard a [Isengard] minion revealed to draw 2 cards.
lotr01044.lore: Saruman's Uruk-hai mirrored the singular focus of their master, viewing with contempt and disgust all they encountered.

lotr01045.name: Galadriel, Lady of Light
lotr01045.subtitle: Lady of Light
lotr01045.game_text: At the start of each of your turns, heal every ally whose home is site 6. Fellowship: Exert Galadriel to play an Elf for free.
lotr01045.lore: “Very tall they were, and the Lady no less tall than the Lord; and they were grave and beautiful … and the hair of the Lady was of deep gold….”

lotr01046.name: Gift of Boats
lotr01046.game_text: To play, exert an Elf ally. Plays to your support area. When the fellowship moves from a river during the fellowship phase, the move limit for this turn is +1.
lotr01046.lore: ”'They will not sink, lade them as you will; but they are wayward if mishandled.'”

lotr01047.name: Gwemegil
lotr01047.game_text: Bearer must be Arwen. She is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Arwen or discard 2 cards from hand to make her strength +1.
lotr01047.lore: Forged by the Elven-smiths of Rivendell, Arwen's blade bears enchantments to ward off the forces of the Great Eye.

lotr01048.name: Haldir, Elf of the Golden Wood
lotr01048.subtitle: Elf of the Golden Wood
lotr01048.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. While Haldir is at site 6, 7, or 8, he is strength +2.
lotr01048.lore: ”'But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies …. I am one. Haldir is my name.'”

lotr01049.name: The Last Alliance of Elves and Men
lotr01049.game_text: Tale. Bearer must be a [Gondor] Man. Limit 1 per bearer. Bearer is strength +1 for each Elf you can spot (limit +3).
lotr01049.lore: “But Sauron of Mordor assailed them, and they made the Last Alliance of Elves and Men, and the hosts of Gil-galad and Elendil were mustered….”
lotr01049.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set1/lotr01049/The Last Alliance of Elves and Men (1R49).jpg

lotr01050.name: Legolas, Greenleaf
lotr01050.subtitle: Greenleaf
lotr01050.game_text: Archer. Archery: Exert Legolas to wound a minion; Legolas does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lotr01050.lore: ”'And I too will go with him,' said Legolas. 'It would be faithless now to say farewell.'”

lotr01051.name: Legolas, Prince of Mirkwood
lotr01051.subtitle: Prince of Mirkwood
lotr01051.game_text: Archer. While skirmishing a Nazgul, Legolas is strength +3.
lotr01051.lore: “There was also a strange Elf clad in green and brown, Legolas, a messenger from his father, Thranduil, the King of the Elves of Northern Mirkwood.”

lotr01052.name: Lightfootedness
lotr01052.game_text: Archery: Spot an Elf companion to make the minion archery total -1.
lotr01052.lore: ”'…let a ploughman plough, but choose an otter for swimming, and for running light over grass and leaf, or over snow - an Elf.'”

lotr01053.name: Lorien Elf
lotr01053.lore: ”'…we dwell now in the heart of the forest, and do not willingly have dealings with any other folk.'”

lotr01054.name: Mallorn-trees
lotr01054.game_text: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Reveal an [Elven] card from hand and place it beneath your draw deck.
lotr01054.lore: “Upon the further side there rose to a great height a green wall encircling a green hill thronged with mallorn-trees taller than any they had yet seen in all the land.”

lotr01055.name: The Mirror of Galadriel
lotr01055.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each Elf ally whose home is site 6 is strength +1. Maneuver: If an opponent has at least 7 cards in hand, exert Galadriel to look at 2 of those cards at random. Discard one and replace the other.
lotr01055.lore: ”'What you will see I cannot tell….'”

lotr01056.name: Orophin, Lorien Bowman
lotr01056.subtitle: Lorien Bowman
lotr01056.game_text: Archer. Archery: Exert Orophin to wound an Uruk-hai.
lotr01056.lore: The swift bow of Orophin, Haldir's kinsman, has slain many Orcs.

lotr01057.name: Rumil, Elven Protector
lotr01057.subtitle: Elven Protector
lotr01057.game_text: Archer. Archery: Exert Rumil to wound an Orc.

lotr01058.name: The Seen and the Unseen
lotr01058.game_text: Fellowship: Exert 2 Elves to discard a condition.
lotr01058.lore: ”'You have entered the realm of the Lady of the Wood - you cannot go back.'”

lotr01059.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
lotr01059.game_text: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Add (1) and exert a Dwarf to heal an Elf, or add (1) and exert an Elf to heal a Dwarf.
lotr01059.lore: ”'May it be a sign that though the world is now dark better days are at hand, and that friendship shall be renewed between our peoples.'”

lotr01060.name: Silinde, Elf of Mirkwood
lotr01060.subtitle: Elf of Mirkwood
lotr01060.game_text: While you can spot your site 3, Silinde has the game text of that site.
lotr01060.lore: Among the representatives of the Elves of Northern Mirkwood was Silinde, friend of the House of Thranduil.

lotr01061.name: Songs of the Blessed Realm
lotr01061.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time you play an [Elven] tale, you may remove a burden.
lotr01061.lore: Elves seem to like music and poetry and tales as much as Hobbits like food.

lotr01062.name: The Splendor of Their Banners
lotr01062.game_text: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: If bearer is an archer, exert bearer to make the fellowship archery total +1.
lotr01062.lore: ”'It recalled to me the glory of the Elder Days and the hosts of Beleriand, so many great princes and captains were assembled.'”

lotr01063.name: Stand Against Darkness
lotr01063.game_text: Maneuver: Exert an Elf to discard a [Sauron] minion, a [Sauron] condition, or a [Sauron] possession.
lotr01063.lore: ”'What power still remains lies with us, here in Imladrisstrength, have we here the strength to withstand the Enemy…?'”

lotr01064.name: Support of the Last Homely House
lotr01064.game_text: Maneuver: Exert an Elf ally whose home is site 3. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
lotr01064.lore: “Merely to be there was a cure for weariness, fear, and sadness.”

lotr01065.name: Swan-ship of the Galadhrim
lotr01065.game_text: Maneuver: Exert an Elf ally whose home is site 6. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
lotr01065.lore: ”…and suddenly they perceived that it was a ship, wrought and carved with elven-skill in the likeness of a bird.”

lotr01066.name: The Tale of Gil-galad
lotr01066.game_text: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make bearer strength +2.
lotr01066.lore: “Gil-galad was an Elven-king / Of him the harpers sadly sing: / the last whose realm was fair and free / between the Mountains and the Sea.”

lotr01067.name: Uruviel, Maid of Lorien
lotr01067.subtitle: Maid of Lorien
lotr01067.game_text: While you can spot your site 6, Uruviel has the game text of that site.
lotr01067.lore: An Elf-maid of the Galadhrim, Uruviel has dwelt for years beneath the mallorn-trees

lotr01068.name: The White Arrows of Lorien
lotr01068.game_text: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: If bearer is an archer, exert bearer to make an opponent discard 2 cards at random from hand.
lotr01068.lore: Straight and true, the arrows of the Golden Wood are known to leave a deadly mark.

lotr01069.name: Albert Dreary, Entertainer From Bree
lotr01069.subtitle: Entertainer From Bree
lotr01069.game_text: To play, spot Gandalf. Maneuver: Exert Albert Dreary to discard a [Isengard] or [Moria] condition.
lotr01069.lore: Typical of Bree-folk, Albert is a plain but stout-hearted fellow. He does not seek trouble, but he is willing to protect his home.

lotr01070.name: Barliman Butterbur, Prancing Pony Proprietor
lotr01070.subtitle: Prancing Pony Proprietor
lotr01070.game_text: Fellowship: Exert Barliman Butterbur to take a [Gandalf] event into hand from your discard pile.
lotr01070.lore: ”'You don't know much even about them, if you think old Barliman is stupid,' said Gandalf. 'He is wise enough on his own ground.'”

lotr01071.name: Durin's Secret
lotr01071.game_text: Fellowship: Spot Gandalf, a Dwarf, and an Elf to make the move limit for this turn +1.
lotr01071.lore: ”'They are wrought of ithildin that mirrors only starlight and moonlight, and sleeps until it is touched by one who speaks words now long forgotten in Middle-earth.'”

lotr01072.name: Gandalf, Friend of the Shirefolk
lotr01072.subtitle: Friend of the Shirefolk
lotr01072.game_text: Gandalf is strength +1 for each of these races you can spot in the fellowship: Hobbit, Dwarf, Elf, and Man.
lotr01072.lore: ”'Among the Wise I am the only one that goes in for hobbit-lore: an obscure branch of knowledge, but full of surprises.'”

lotr01073.name: Gandalf's Cart
lotr01073.game_text: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Stack a Free Peoples artifact (or possession) from hand on this card, or play a card stacked here as if played from hand.
lotr01073.lore: ”…a cart came in through Bywater … An old man was driving it all alone.”

lotr01074.name: Gandalf's Pipe
lotr01074.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to remove X burdens.
lotr01074.lore: ”'I know what is the matter with me,' he muttered, as he sat down by the door. 'I need smoke!'”

lotr01075.name: Glamdring
lotr01075.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. He is damage +1. Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Gandalf to reveal an opponent's hand. Remove (1) for each Orc revealed.
lotr01075.lore: ”…in his other hand Glamdring gleamed, cold and white.”

lotr01076.name: Intimidate
lotr01076.game_text: Spell. Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf to prevent that wound.

lotr01077.name: Let Folly Be Our Cloak
lotr01077.game_text: Fellowship: Exert X companions to remove (X).
lotr01077.lore: ”'Well, let folly be our cloak, a veil before the eyes of the Enemy! … Into his heart the thought will not enter that any will refuse it, that having the Ring we may seek to destroy it.'”

lotr01078.name: Mysterious Wizard
lotr01078.game_text: Spell. Skirmish: Make Gandalf strength +2 (or +4 if there are 4 or fewer burdens on the Ring-bearer).
lotr01078.lore: ”'…there are older and fouler things than Orcs in the deep places of the world.'”

lotr01079.name: The Nine Walkers
lotr01079.game_text: To play, spot Gandalf. Plays to your support area. Each time you play a companion whose race you cannot spot, that companion's twilight cost is -2.
lotr01079.lore: ”'Nine companions to match the Nine Ringwraiths … So be it.'”

lotr01080.name: Ottar, Man of Laketown
lotr01080.subtitle: Man of Laketown
lotr01080.game_text: To play, spot Gandalf. Fellowship: Exert Ottar to discard up to 3 cards from hand and draw an equal number of cards.
lotr01080.lore: The Men of Laketown come from the North, where they trade with the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain.

lotr01081.name: Questions That Need Answering
lotr01081.game_text: Spell. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 3 twilight tokens, spot Gandalf to look at the top 4 cards of your draw deck. Take 2 of those cards into hand and discard the rest.
lotr01081.lore: ”'There are some things that I must see to….'”

lotr01082.name: Risk a Little Light
lotr01082.game_text: Spell. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, spot Gandalf to look at the top 2 cards of your draw deck. Take one into hand and discard the other.
lotr01082.lore: ”'Let me risk a little more light.'”

lotr01083.name: Servant of the Secret Fire
lotr01083.game_text: Spell. Skirmish: Spot Gandalf to make a minion strength -3.
lotr01083.lore: ”'I am a servant of the Secret Fire, wielder of the flame of Anor. You cannot pass.'”

lotr01084.name: Sleep, Caradhras
lotr01084.subtitle: Caradhras
lotr01084.game_text: Spell. Fellowship: Exert Gandalf to discard every condition.
lotr01084.lore: ”'Losto Caradhras, sedho, hodo, nuitho i ruith.'”

lotr01085.name: Strength of Spirit
lotr01085.game_text: Spell. Response: If a companion is about to exert, spot Gandalf to place no token for that exertion.
lotr01085.lore: ”'There are many powers in the world, for good or for evil. Some are greater than I am. Against some I have not yet been measured. But my time is coming.'”

lotr01086.name: Treachery Deeper Than You Know
lotr01086.game_text: Spell. Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to reveal an opponent's hand.
lotr01086.lore: ”'By foul craft, Saruman has crossed Orc with Goblin Men - he is breeding an army in the Caverns of Isengard.'”

lotr01087.name: A Wizard Is Never Late
lotr01087.game_text: Fellowship: Play a [Gandalf] character from your draw deck.
lotr01087.lore: ”'A wizard is never late, Frodo Baggins, nor is he early. He arrives precisely when he means to.'”

lotr01088.name: An Able Guide
lotr01088.game_text: Regroup: Spot a ranger to remove (4).
lotr01088.lore: ”'…though I cannot disappear, I have hunted many wild and wary things and I can usually avoid being seen, if I wish.'”

lotr01089.name: Aragorn, Ranger of the North
lotr01089.subtitle: Ranger of the North
lotr01089.game_text: Ranger. Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to make him defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr01089.lore: ”'Lonely men are we, Rangers of the wild, The hunters - but The hunters ever of the servants of the Enemy….'”

lotr01090.name: Aragorn's Bow
lotr01090.game_text: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is an archer. Archery: Exert Aragorn to wound a minion; Aragorn does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lotr01090.lore: Rangers learn the bow as well as the blade.

lotr01091.name: Aragorn's Pipe
lotr01091.game_text: Bearer must be a [Gondor] companion. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to heal X companions.
lotr01091.lore: “He had a tall tankard in front of him, and was smoking a long-stemmed pipe curiously carved.”

lotr01092.name: Armor
lotr01092.game_text: Bearer must be a Man. Bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase.

lotr01093.name: Arwen's Fate
lotr01093.game_text: Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make Arwen strength +3, or exert Arwen to make Aragorn strength +3.
lotr01093.lore: For the love of a mortal Man, Arwen, daughter of Elrond, must forsake her Elven heritage, and give up forever her journey to the Undying Lands.

lotr01094.name: Athelas
lotr01094.game_text: Bearer must be a [Gondor] Man. Fellowship: Discard this possession to heal a companion or to remove a Shadow condition from a companion.
lotr01094.lore: The hands of the king are the hands of a healer, and so shall the true king be known.

lotr01095.name: Blade of Gondor
lotr01095.game_text: Bearer must be Boromir. He is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Boromir to wound an Orc or Uruk-hai he is skirmishing.
lotr01095.lore: With the valour of Boromir's mighty longsword, the Enemies of the West are kept at bay.

lotr01096.name: Boromir, Lord of Gondor
lotr01096.subtitle: Lord of Gondor
lotr01096.game_text: Ranger. Boromir is not overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
lotr01096.lore: ”'…Boromir will also be in the Company. He is a valiant man.'”

lotr01097.name: Boromir, Son of Denethor
lotr01097.subtitle: Son of Denethor
lotr01097.game_text: Skirmish: Exert Boromir to make a Hobbit strength +3.
lotr01097.lore: ”'Long has my father, the Steward of Gondor, held the forces of Mordor at bay - by the blood of our people are the lands of others kept safe.'”

lotr01098.name: Boromir's Cloak
lotr01098.game_text: Bearer must be Boromir. Maneuver: Exert Boromir to discard a weather condition.
lotr01098.lore: “He was cloaked and booted as if for a journey on horseback; and indeed though his garments were rich, and his cloak was lined with fur, they were stained with long travel.”

lotr01099.name: Change of Plans
lotr01099.game_text: Regroup: Exert a ranger to make an opponent shuffle his hand into his draw deck and draw 8 cards.
lotr01099.lore: ”'Then let me help you. There are other ways, Frodo - other paths that we might take.'”

lotr01100.name: The Choice of Luthien
lotr01100.game_text: Tale. Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to heal Arwen, or exert Arwen to heal Aragorn.
lotr01100.lore: ”'But she chose mortality, and to die from the world, so that she might follow him; and it is sung that they met again beyond the Sundering Seas….'”

lotr01101.name: Coat of Mail
lotr01101.game_text: Bearer must be a Man. Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
lotr01101.lore: Soldiers of the White Tower have long appreciated the craftsmanship of the Gondorian metalsmiths.

lotr01102.name: Dagger Strike
lotr01102.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Gondor] or [Shire] companion bearing a hand weapon strength +2 and damage +1.
lotr01102.lore: Every warrior needs a sword, bow, or axe - but sometimes, a dagger is enough.

lotr01103.name: Elendil's Valor
lotr01103.game_text: Maneuver: Make a [Gondor] companion defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr01103.lore: ”shield was scored with runes / to ward all wounds and harm from him….'”

lotr01104.name: Eregion's Trails
lotr01104.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a ranger to make each roaming minion strength -3 until the regroup phase.
lotr01104.lore: “Guided by Aragorn they struck a good path. It looked to Frodo like the remains of an ancient road, that had once been broad and well planned….”

lotr01105.name: Foes of Mordor
lotr01105.game_text: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Exert a [Gondor] character to wound a [Sauron] minion.
lotr01105.lore: Through the long years, the Men of the Tower of Guard have shielded the West from the minions of the Eye.

lotr01106.name: Gondor's Vengeance
lotr01106.game_text: Regroup: Exert a ranger companion to discard a minion.
lotr01106.lore: A Ranger in the wild is a deadly foe for the forces of the Shadow.

lotr01107.name: Great Shield
lotr01107.game_text: Bearer must be a Man. The minion archery total is -1.
lotr01107.lore: The Kingdom of Gondor has smiths much practiced in creating strong tools of war.

lotr01108.name: No Stranger to the Shadows
lotr01108.game_text: Bearer must be a ranger. Limit 1 per ranger. Each site's shadow number is -1.
lotr01108.lore: ”'Ah, but you had not got me with you then,' laughed Strider. 'My cuts, short or long, don't go wrong.'”

lotr01109.name: One Whom Men Would Follow
lotr01109.game_text: Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to spot an ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +2 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
lotr01109.lore: ”'The skill of the elves can reforge the Sword of Elendil - but only you have the power to wield it.'”

lotr01110.name: Pathfinder
lotr01110.game_text: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot a ranger to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).
lotr01110.lore: ”'Strider can take you by paths that are seldom trodden. Will you have him?'”

lotr01111.name: Pursuit Just Behind
lotr01111.game_text: Regroup: Exert a ranger companion to wound every minion.
lotr01111.lore: ”'We must do something to delay the enemy first. We will make them fear the Chamber of Mazarbul!'”

lotr01112.name: Ranger's Sword
lotr01112.game_text: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is damage +1.
lotr01112.lore: Aragorn is a trustworthy companion and a deadly foe. His years roaming the wild have honed his swordfighting skills.

lotr01113.name: A Ranger's Versatility
lotr01113.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a ranger at a river or forest to exhaust a minion.
lotr01113.lore: ”'If you bring a Ranger with you, it is well to pay attention to him, especially if the Ranger is Aragorn.'”

lotr01114.name: The Saga of Elendil
lotr01114.game_text: Tale. Bearer must be a [Gondor] companion. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make bearer strength +2.

lotr01115.name: Strength of Kings
lotr01115.game_text: Response: If a Skirmish event is played during a skirmish involving a [Gondor] Man, cancel that event.

lotr01116.name: Swordarm of the White Tower
lotr01116.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Gondor] companion strength +2 (or +4 if he is defender +1).
lotr01116.lore: ”'By our valour the wild folk of the East are still restrained, and the terror of Morgul kept at bay; and thus alone are peace and freedom maintained in the lands behind us, bulwark of the West.'”

lotr01117.name: Swordsman of the Northern Kingdom
lotr01117.game_text: Skirmish: Make a ranger strength +2 (or +4 when skirmishing a roaming minion).
lotr01117.lore: ”'This is no mere Ranger. He is Aragorn, son of Arathorn … and you owe him your allegiance.'”

lotr01118.name: Valiant Man of the West
lotr01118.game_text: Maneuver: Make Aragorn defender +1 and he takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase until the regroup phase.

lotr01119.name: What Are They?
lotr01119.game_text: Maneuver: Spot a ranger to discard a roaming minion.

lotr01120.name: Alive and Unspoiled
lotr01120.game_text: To play, exert an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) and spot X burdens to make the Free Peoples player reveal X cards at random from hand. You may discard 1 revealed card.
lotr01120.lore: ”'Bring them to me…. Kill the others….'”

lotr01121.name: Bred for Battle
lotr01121.game_text: Skirmish: Exert an Uruk-hai to make it strength +3.
lotr01121.lore: ”'You are the Uruk-hai of Isengard! The blood in your veins is black and cold - you do not know pain, you do not know fear - for you are the servants of the White Hand - the hand that gives you Man flesh to eat!'”

lotr01122.name: Breeding Pit
lotr01122.game_text: Response: If you play an Uruk-hai, take all copies of that card in your discard pile and place them beneath your draw deck.
lotr01122.lore: ”'He is breeding an army in the Caverns of Isengard. An army that can move in sunlight and cover great distance at speed.'”

lotr01123.name: Caradhras Has Not Forgiven Us
lotr01123.game_text: Spell. Weather. Maneuver: Exert a [Isengard] minion and spot 5 companions to discard an exhausted companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr01123.lore: ”'It was no ordinary storm. It is the ill will of Caradhras.'”

lotr01124.name: Cruel Caradhras
lotr01124.game_text: Spell. Weather. Maneuver: Exert a [Isengard] minion to make the opponent choose to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.
lotr01124.lore: ”'Yonder stands Barazinbar, the Redhorn, cruel Caradhras….'”

lotr01125.name: Greed
lotr01125.game_text: To play, spot an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions and remove (2) to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr01125.lore: ”'It is a strange fate that we should suffer so much fear and doubt over so small a thing….'”

lotr01126.name: Hunt Them Down!
lotr01126.game_text: Maneuver: Make an Uruk-hai fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr01126.lore: ”'Do not stop until they are found!”

lotr01127.name: Lurtz, Servant of Isengard
lotr01127.subtitle: Servant of Isengard
lotr01127.game_text: Archer. Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot another Uruk-hai to make Lurtz fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr01127.lore: ”'And now… perfected. Grown beyond the height of Men - straight-limbed and strong, fearing nothing.'”

lotr01128.name: Lurtz's Battle Cry
lotr01128.game_text: Skirmish: Make an Uruk-hai strength -1 and damage +1.

lotr01129.name: The Misadventure of Mr. Underhill
lotr01129.game_text: To play, exert an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of each companion played to a site which is not a sanctuary is +2.
lotr01129.lore: ”'You're drawing far too much attention to yourself… Mr. Underhill.'”

lotr01130.name: No Ordinary Storm
lotr01130.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time you play a weather condition, exert a [Gandalf] companion or [Gandalf] ally.
lotr01130.lore: ”'So Gandalf… you try to lead them over Caradhras. And if that fails - where then will you go?'”

lotr01131.name: Orthanc Assassin
lotr01131.lore: Black-feathered arrows from Uruk-hai bows reign over the corpses of Saruman's enemies.

lotr01132.name: Parry
lotr01132.game_text: Maneuver: Spot an Uruk-hai to cancel the strength bonus from a possession until the regroup phase.
lotr01132.lore: Even the sword of a powerful warrior can be parried by the strength of an Uruk-hai.

lotr01133.name: Saruman's Ambition
lotr01133.game_text: Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of your [Isengard] events is -1. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an Uruk-hai strength +2.
lotr01133.lore: ”'I did not expect you to show wisdom, even in your own behalf; but I gave you the chance of aiding me willingly, and so saving yourself much trouble and pain.'”

lotr01134.name: Saruman's Chill
lotr01134.game_text: Spell. Weather. To play, exert a [Isengard] minion. Plays on a site. Limit 1 per site. Each Hobbit who moves from this site must exert. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
lotr01134.lore: Saruman's hand can control the chill of winter.

lotr01135.name: Saruman's Frost
lotr01135.game_text: Spell. Weather. To play, exert a [Isengard] minion. Plays on a site. Limit 1 per site. Each Hobbit at this site is strength -2. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
lotr01135.lore: The small and weak suffer first from the The White Wizard's powerful sorcery.

lotr01136.name: Saruman's Power
lotr01136.game_text: Spell. Shadow: Exert a [Isengard] minion to discard all conditions.
lotr01136.lore: The Uruks of Saruman are bred to be the instruments of his will, destroying his enemies with foul cruelty.

lotr01137.name: Saruman's Reach
lotr01137.game_text: Search. Maneuver: Exert an Uruk-hai to make the opponent choose to either exert 2 companions or make the Ring-bearer put on The One Ring until the regroup phase.
lotr01137.lore: Saruman used both magic and minions to impose his will.

lotr01138.name: Saruman's Snows
lotr01138.game_text: Spell. Weather. To play, exert a [Isengard] minion. Plays on a site. No player may play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities during skirmishes at this site. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
lotr01138.lore: Saruman's spells can hinder even the wary.

lotr01139.name: Savagery to Match Their Numbers
lotr01139.game_text: Skirmish: Make an Uruk-hai strength +2, or spot 5 companions to make an Uruk-hai strength +4 and fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr01139.lore: Uruk-hai match their enemies' strength with their own feral rage.

lotr01140.name: Spies of Saruman
lotr01140.game_text: To play, exert a [Isengard] minion. Plays on a site. While the fellowship is at this site, skip the archery phase. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
lotr01140.lore: ”'…they are crebain out of Fangorn or Dunland. I do not know what they are about….'”

lotr01141.name: Their Arrows Enrage
lotr01141.game_text: To play, spot Saruman or an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. Each archer companion and archer ally is strength -1.
lotr01141.lore: The ferocious charge of the Uruk-hai catches enemy archers groping for their swords.

lotr01142.name: Traitor's Voice
lotr01142.game_text: Search. To play, spot an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. While the Ring-bearer is exhausted or you can spot 5 burdens, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1).
lotr01142.lore: ”'In all the long wars with the Dark Tower treason has ever been our greatest foe.'”

lotr01143.name: Troop of Uruk-hai
lotr01143.game_text: Damage +1. A character skirmishing this minion does not gain strength bonuses from weapons.
lotr01143.lore: Attacking in swarming hordes, the Urukhai close with the enemy rapidly to make weapons useless.

lotr01144.name: Uruk Bloodlust
lotr01144.game_text: Plays to your support area. Response: If your Uruk-hai wins a skirmish, remove (1) to heal him.

lotr01145.name: Uruk Brood
lotr01145.game_text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Remove (2) to make this minion strength +1 for each other Uruk-hai you spot.
lotr01145.lore: ”'He does not see the caverns hidden deep beneath this tower… nor does he know what is growing there.'”

lotr01146.name: Uruk Fighter
lotr01146.game_text: Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot 5 companions to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr01146.lore: Not stealth or cunning, but strength and ferocity are the weapons of Saruman's army of abominations.

lotr01147.name: Uruk Guard
lotr01147.game_text: Damage +1. Assignment: Exert this minion and spot a companion to prevent the opponent from assigning that companion to this minion.
lotr01147.lore: ”'SWolves and orcs were housed in Isengard, for Saruman was mustering a great force….'”

lotr01148.name: Uruk Lieutenant
lotr01148.game_text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each other Uruk-hai you can spot.
lotr01148.lore: Uruk-hai leaders gain savagery from their following hordes to maintain the rule of the strong.

lotr01149.name: Uruk Messenger
lotr01149.game_text: Damage +1. While you can spot a weather condition, this minion is strength +3.
lotr01149.lore: Saruman uses his Uruks abroad to gain information on the movements - and weaknesses - of his many enemies.

lotr01150.name: Uruk Rager
lotr01150.game_text: Damage +1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must discard the top 2 cards of his draw deck.
lotr01150.lore: A bloodthirsty bellow from a huge Uruk can win a skirmish before it begins.

lotr01151.name: Uruk Savage
lotr01151.lore: ”'The friendship of Saruman is not lightly thrown aside. One ill turn deserves another …. We have work to do.'”

lotr01152.name: Uruk Shaman
lotr01152.game_text: Damage +1. Maneuver: Remove (2) to heal an Uruk-hai.
lotr01152.lore: Uruk shamans know the arts of healing as well as those of battle.

lotr01153.name: Uruk Slayer
lotr01153.game_text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Remove (1) to make this minion strength +1 (limit +3).
lotr01153.lore: A foe who is willing to kill or die outright is a foe to be feared indeed.

lotr01154.name: Uruk Soldier
lotr01154.game_text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player discard the top card of his draw deck.
lotr01154.lore: Saruman's Uruk-hai band together as an extremely effective fighting unit.

lotr01155.name: Uruk Spy
lotr01155.game_text: Response: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, exert this minion. Discard a card from the top of your draw deck for each [Isengard] minion you spot. Add a burden for each Shadow card discarded in this way.
lotr01155.lore: A wary eye on the mission could undo the quest.

lotr01156.name: Uruk Warrior
lotr01156.game_text: Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr01156.lore: Powerful and fearless, Uruk-hai warriors are not intimidated by the weapons or numbers of their enemies.

lotr01157.name: Uruk-hai Armory
lotr01157.game_text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot an Uruk-hai, the fellowship archery total is -1.
lotr01157.lore: The ranks of Saruman's army include forgers of weapons and armour.

lotr01158.name: Uruk-hai Raiding Party
lotr01158.lore: ”'Imagine, Gandalf, an army - born from the earth of Isengard.'”

lotr01159.name: Uruk-hai Rampage
lotr01159.game_text: To play, spot an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. Response: If your Uruk-hai wins a skirmish, remove (3) to make him fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr01159.lore: Victory breeds rage in Saruman's foul creations.

lotr01160.name: Uruk-hai Sword
lotr01160.game_text: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must discard the top card of his draw deck.
lotr01160.lore: Their malevolent strength worsens the wounds from the gruesome weapons of the Uruks.

lotr01161.name: Wariness
lotr01161.game_text: Search. Response: If a stealth event is played, exert or discard your Uruk-hai to cancel that event.
lotr01161.lore: Even Hobbits have trouble evading the Uruk-hai.

lotr01162.name: Worry
lotr01162.game_text: To play, exert an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving an Uruk-hai, the opponent must choose to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.
lotr01162.lore: ”'One by one, regardless of their strength to good or evil… they fell.'”

lotr01163.name: Ancient Chieftain
lotr01163.game_text: For each other [Moria] Orc you can spot, Ancient Chieftain is strength +1.
lotr01163.lore: ”…a huge orc-chieftain, almost man-high, clad in black mail from head to foot, leaped into the chamber; behind him his followers clustered in the doorway.”

lotr01164.name: Bitter Hatred
lotr01164.game_text: Archery: Spot a [Moria] archer to wound an Elf.
lotr01164.lore: Bitter and long is the hatred of the Orcs for the Elves, and thus they prefer Elves as targets.

lotr01165.name: Cave Troll of Moria, Scourge of the Black Pit
lotr01165.subtitle: Scourge of the Black Pit
lotr01165.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot a [Moria] Orc. At an underground site, Cave Troll of Moria's twilight cost is -3.
lotr01165.lore: Frodo's quest nearly ended before his companions halted the Cave Troll's ferocious attack.
lotr01165.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set1/lotr01165/Cave Troll of Moria, Scourge of the Black Pit (1R165).jpg

lotr01166.name: Cave Troll's Hammer
lotr01166.game_text: Bearer must be Cave Troll of Moria. Cave Troll of Moria is damage +1.
lotr01166.lore: Suddenly the door burst into fragments and the Cave Troll was among them, his huge hammer striking like thunder.

lotr01167.name: Denizens Enraged
lotr01167.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Moria] Orc strength +1 for each other [Moria] Orc you spot (limit +4).
lotr01167.lore: ”…there came a great noise: a rolling Boom that seemed to come from depths far below, and to tremble in the stone at their feet.”

lotr01168.name: Drums in the Deep
lotr01168.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Moria] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a Dwarf).
lotr01168.lore: “The drum-beats broke out wildly: doomboom, doom-boom, and then stopped … Doom, doom went the drum-beats again….”

lotr01169.name: The End Comes
lotr01169.game_text: Assignment: Spot 5 [Moria] minions to make the Free Peoples player assign the Ring-bearer to a skirmish.
lotr01169.lore: ”'They have taken the Bridge and the second hall; we have barred the gates -_but cannot hold them for long….'”

lotr01170.name: Fool of a Took!
lotr01170.game_text: Shadow: Spot a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer) to reveal cards from the top of your draw deck until you reveal one that is not a [Moria] minion. Take the revealed cards into hand.
lotr01170.lore: ”'Fool of a Took! Throw yourself in next time and rid us of your stupidity!'”

lotr01171.name: Frenzy
lotr01171.game_text: Assignment: Assign an exhausted companion (except the Ring-bearer) to skirmish a [Moria] Orc.
lotr01171.lore: The Goblins of the Misty Mountains, like all of their race, use their teeming numbers to slaughter their foes.

lotr01172.name: Goblin Archer
lotr01172.game_text: Archer. While you can spot another [Moria] Orc, the fellowship archery total is -6.

lotr01173.name: Goblin Armory
lotr01173.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time you play a [Moria] weapon, add (1). Response: If a [Moria] Orc is about to take a wound, discard this condition to prevent that wound.
lotr01173.lore: For scavenging vermin, the weapons of fallen foes are prized possessions.

lotr01174.name: Goblin Backstabber
lotr01174.game_text: This minion is damage +2 while in the same skirmish as another [Moria] Orc.
lotr01174.lore: An attack from behind provides a cowardly Goblin with a boldness much like courage.

lotr01175.name: Goblin Domain
lotr01175.game_text: Search. To play, spot a [Moria] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time a companion is played to site 4 or higher, that companion comes into play exhausted.

lotr01176.name: Goblin Marksman
lotr01176.lore: “Arrows fell among them. One struck Frodo and sprang back. Another pierced Gandalf's hat and stuck there like a black feather.”

lotr01177.name: Goblin Patrol Troop
lotr01177.lore: “As they ran they heard the beat and echo of many hurrying feet behind. A shrill yell went up: they had been seen. There was a ring and clash of steel.”

lotr01178.name: Goblin Runner
lotr01178.game_text: When you play this minion, you may add (2).
lotr01178.lore: ”…a great horn was blown in the hall, and answering horns and harsh cries were heard further off. There was a hurrying sound of many feet.”

lotr01179.name: Goblin Scavengers
lotr01179.game_text: When you play this minion, you may play a weapon from your discard pile on your [Moria] Orc.
lotr01179.lore: ”'The Orcs have often plundered Moria; there is nothing left in the upper halls.'”

lotr01180.name: Goblin Scimitar
lotr01180.game_text: Bearer must be a [Moria] Orc. When you play this possession, you may draw a card.
lotr01180.lore: “Some of the swords were crooked: orcscimitars with blackened blades.”

lotr01181.name: Goblin Sneak
lotr01181.game_text: When you play this minion, you may place a [Moria] Orc from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.
lotr01181.lore: Their limber forms allow the Goblins of Moria to slither past barred doors and collapsed passageways.

lotr01182.name: Goblin Spear
lotr01182.game_text: Bearer must be a [Moria] minion. If bearer kills a companion in a skirmish, add 1 burden (or 2 burdens if that companion was a Hobbit).
lotr01182.lore: Simple creatures with simple weapons can be as deadly as an armoured warrior with a fine sword.

lotr01183.name: Goblin Swarms
lotr01183.game_text: Plays to your support area. Response: If your [Moria] Orc wins a skirmish, discard cards and wounds on that Orc and stack that Orc on this condition. Shadow: Play an Orc stacked here as if played from hand.
lotr01183.lore: “Beyond the fire he saw swarming black figures….”

lotr01184.name: Goblin Wallcrawler
lotr01184.game_text: While at an underground site, this minion is strength +2. While you can spot another [Moria] Orc, the fellowship archery total is -1.
lotr01184.lore: Skittering along the walls of Moria, Goblins attack without warning.

lotr01185.name: Goblin Warrior
lotr01185.game_text: When you play this minion, you may discard a [Dwarven] ally or [Dwarven] condition.
lotr01185.lore: The ancient enmity between Goblins and Dwarves burns brightly still.

lotr01186.name: Guard Commander
lotr01186.game_text: Skirmish: Remove (3) to make a [Moria] Orc strength +2.
lotr01186.lore: “His broad flat face was swart, his eyes were like coals, and his tongue was red….”

lotr01187.name: Host of Thousands
lotr01187.game_text: Shadow: Play a [Moria] Orc from your discard pile.
lotr01187.lore: Killing one is no victory, since a dozen from the warrens below will take his place.

lotr01188.name: The Long Dark
lotr01188.game_text: Plays to your support area. When the fellowship moves to site 4 or 5, add (2) for each Dwarf companion. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make your [Moria] Orc strength +2.
lotr01188.lore: ”'So ended the attempt to retake Moria! It was valiant but foolish. The time is not come yet.'”

lotr01189.name: Lost to the Goblins
lotr01189.game_text: Response: If the Ring-bearer exerts or takes a wound, discard a card from the top of your draw deck for each [Moria] minion you spot. For each Shadow card discarded in this way, add a burden (limit 3 burdens).
lotr01189.lore: Dwarven graves stood open in plundered disarray.

lotr01190.name: Moria Axe
lotr01190.game_text: Bearer must be a [Moria] Orc. Bearer is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert bearer to make him strength +2.
lotr01190.lore: Goblins without scimitars wrest axes from the remains of fallen Dwarves.

lotr01191.name: Moria Scout
lotr01191.game_text: When you play this minion, spot an Elf to add (2).
lotr01191.lore: Like their kindred in the North, the Orcs of Moria have keen noses, often following their prey by scent.

lotr01192.name: Pinned Down
lotr01192.game_text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot a [Moria] archer, the fellowship archery total is -1.
lotr01192.lore: “Arrows whined and whistled down the corridor as he sprang back.”

lotr01193.name: Plundered Armories
lotr01193.game_text: Plays to your support area. Response: If your [Moria] weapon is discarded, play it from your discard pile (that weapon's twilight cost is -1).
lotr01193.lore: The Goblins of Moria have oft plundered the deep armouries of Durin's folk.

lotr01194.name: Relentless
lotr01194.game_text: Search. Response: If a stealth event is played, spot 3 [Moria] minions to cancel that event.
lotr01194.lore: ”'Then dig a hole in the ground,' said Legolas, 'if that is more after the fashion of your kind. But you must dig swift and deep, if you wish to hide from Orcs.'”

lotr01195.name: Relics of Moria
lotr01195.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (2) to play a [Moria] possession from your discard pile.
lotr01195.lore: “By both the doors they could now see that many bones were lying, and among them were broken swords and axe-heads, and cloven shields and helms.”

lotr01196.name: They Are Coming
lotr01196.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Discard 3 cards from hand to play a [Moria] Orc from your discard pile.
lotr01196.lore: ”'The last thing written is in a trailing scrawl of elf-letters: they are coming.'”

lotr01197.name: Threat of the Unknown
lotr01197.game_text: Shadow: Exert your [Moria] Orc to draw 2 cards.
lotr01197.lore: The danger of what lay hidden in the dark was more terrifying than the known perils of Moria.

lotr01198.name: Through the Misty Mountains
lotr01198.game_text: Search. To play, exert a [Moria] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves to site 4, 5, or 6 and contains a Dwarf or Elf, the Free Peoples player discards 2 cards at random from hand.
lotr01198.lore: ”'One must tread the path that need chooses.'”

lotr01199.name: Troll's Keyward
lotr01199.game_text: Cave Troll of Moria's twilight cost is -2.
lotr01199.lore: Though shorter than a Man, the Troll's Keyward is a deadly adversary.

lotr01200.name: The Underdeeps of Moria
lotr01200.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to reveal the bottom card of your draw deck. If it is a [Moria] Orc, take it into hand. Otherwise, discard it.
lotr01200.lore: ”'I am afraid Balin is buried deep, and maybe something else is buried there too.'”

lotr01201.name: Unfamiliar Territory
lotr01201.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Moria] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing an archer).
lotr01201.lore: Knowing the dark terrain of Moria gives Orcs a strategic advantage when attacking their foes.

lotr01202.name: What Is This New Devilry?
lotr01202.game_text: Search. To play, exert a [Moria] Orc. Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 5 or higher, each companion's twilight cost is +2.
lotr01202.lore: ”'This foe is beyond any of you! Run!'”

lotr01203.name: All Blades Perish
lotr01203.game_text: Response: If a Nazgul is about to take a wound, prevent that wound.
lotr01203.lore: ”'…all blades perish that pierce that dreadful King. More deadly to him was the name of Elbereth.'”

lotr01204.name: All Veils Removed
lotr01204.game_text: Skirmish: Make a Nazgul strength +2 (or +5 if the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring).

lotr01205.name: Beauty Is Fading
lotr01205.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgul to discard a Free Peoples possession or Free Peoples condition. If you can spot no such card, discard an ally or companion (except the Ring-bearer) instead.
lotr01205.lore: ”'…the Three will fail, and many fair things will fade and be forgotten.'”

lotr01206.name: Bent on Discovery
lotr01206.game_text: Search. Plays to your support area. At the beginning of each of your Shadow phases, draw 1 card. At the end of each of your Shadow phases, exert a Nazgul or discard this condition.
lotr01206.lore: “The riding figure sat quite still…. From inside the hood came a noise as of someone sniffing….”

lotr01207.name: Black Breath
lotr01207.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgul. Burdens and wounds may not be removed from bearer.
lotr01207.lore: Vile breath infects the living with Shadow.

lotr01208.name: Black Steed
lotr01208.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. While at a plains site, bearer is strength +2. Discard this possession when at an underground site.
lotr01208.lore: ”'…these horses are born and bred to the service of the Dark Lord in Mordor.'”

lotr01209.name: Blade Tip
lotr01209.game_text: Plays to your support area. Response: If your Nazgul wins a skirmish, transfer this condition from your support area to the losing character. Limit 1 per character. Wound bearer at the start of each fellowship phase. (If bearer is the Ring-bearer, add a burden instead )

lotr01210.name: Dark Whispers
lotr01210.game_text: Skirmish: Spot 3 burdens to make a Nazgul strength +1 and damage +1, or spot 6 burdens to make a Nazgul strength +3 and damage +2.

lotr01211.name: Drawn to Its Power
lotr01211.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving a Nazgul, add a burden.

lotr01212.name: Fear
lotr01212.game_text: Search. Maneuver: Exert your Nazgul to discard an ally.
lotr01212.lore: ”'Never has such a thing happened in my time! … Guests unable to sleep in their beds, and good bolsters ruined and all! What are we coming to?'”

lotr01213.name: Frozen by Fear
lotr01213.game_text: Skirmish: Make a Nazgul strength +2 (or +3 if the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish that has not resolved).
lotr01213.lore: ”…he was quaking as if he was bitter cold, but his terror was swallowed up in a sudden temptation to put on the Ring.”

lotr01214.name: In the Ringwraith's Wake
lotr01214.game_text: Response: If a Nazgul wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player chooses to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.
lotr01214.lore: ”'He is fading…. We must get him to my father.'”

lotr01215.name: The Master's Will
lotr01215.game_text: Search. Shadow: Spot X Nazgul to reveal the top X cards of your draw deck. Take into your hand all [Wraith] cards revealed and discard the rest.
lotr01215.lore: ”…something seemed to be compelling him to disregard all warnings, and he longed to yield.”

lotr01216.name: Morgul Blade
lotr01216.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Skirmish: Discard this possession to transfer Blade Tip from your support area or discard pile to a companion bearer is skirmishing.
lotr01216.lore: The gates of Minas Morgul issued Nine Riders into the free lands, a blasphemy to ancient kings.

lotr01217.name: Morgul Gates
lotr01217.game_text: Shadow: Play a Nazgul. His twilight cost is -2.

lotr01218.name: Nazgul Sword
lotr01218.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. While you can spot 3 burdens, bearer is damage +1.
lotr01218.lore: The weapons of the Nine are wielded by unseen hands willed by Sauron's hate.

lotr01219.name: The Nine Servants of Sauron
lotr01219.game_text: Search. Plays to your support area. Each time you play a Nazgul, you may exert a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr01219.lore: ”'That Black Rider was looking for something … or someone - Frodo?'”

lotr01220.name: Not Easily Destroyed
lotr01220.game_text: Plays to your support area. Maneuver or Skirmish: Remove (3) to heal a Nazgul.
lotr01220.lore: ”'They were Kings… great Kings of Men. Sauron gave to them Nine Rings of Power and with them the promise of eternal rule… unending life.'”

lotr01221.name: The Pale Blade
lotr01221.game_text: Bearer must be The Witch-king. He is damage +1. Response: If The Witch-king wins a skirmish, exert him to discard a Free Peoples condition.
lotr01221.lore: In his wretched grip, the Captain raised a Pale Sword.

lotr01222.name: Paths Seldom Trodden
lotr01222.game_text: Search. To play, spot a Nazgul. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to replace the fellowship's site with your version of the same site.
lotr01222.lore: ”'You will have to leave the open road after tonight; for the horsemen will watch it night and day.'”

lotr01223.name: Relentless Charge
lotr01223.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgul to wound every archer companion.
lotr01223.lore: Even the fastest arrows are of no avail against the Black Steeds of the Nine Riders.

lotr01224.name: Return to Its Master
lotr01224.game_text: Response: If the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring at the end of a skirmish phase, cancel all remaining assignments and assign a Nazgul to skirmish the Ring-bearer; The One Ring's game text does not apply during this skirmish.

lotr01225.name: Sword of Minas Morgul
lotr01225.game_text: Bearer must be Ulaire Lemenya. He is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Ulaire Lemenya to discard a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing.
lotr01225.lore: The Morgul hilt seared the flesh that would touch it, but the pierce was painless.

lotr01226.name: Their Power Is in Terror
lotr01226.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgul to wound every ally.
lotr01226.lore: ”'In dark and loneliness they are strongest… and already some in Bree are in their clutch.'”

lotr01227.name: Threshold of Shadow
lotr01227.game_text: Skirmish: Make a Nazgul strength +2 (or +4 if you spot 5 burdens).
lotr01227.lore: ”'They did not need the guidance of their horses any longer: you had become visible to them….”'

lotr01228.name: The Twilight World
lotr01228.game_text: Response: If Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, exert a Nazgul to add 2 burdens.
lotr01228.lore: “Immediately, though everything else remained as before, dim and dark, the shapes became terribly clear. He was able to see beneath their black wrappings.”

lotr01229.name: Ulaire Attea, Keeper of Dol Guldur
lotr01229.subtitle: Keeper of Dol Guldur
lotr01229.game_text: Fierce. Skirmish: Remove (1) to make Ulaire Attea strength +1 (limit +5).
lotr01229.lore: Those that knew the most power as kings were placed in particular ways for the Will of Sauron.

lotr01230.name: Ulaire Cantea, Lieutenant of Dol Guldur
lotr01230.subtitle: Lieutenant of Dol Guldur
lotr01230.game_text: Fierce. Skirmish: Exert Ulaire Cantea to discard a weapon borne by a character he is skirmishing.
lotr01230.lore: The Ringwraith has no semblance to the Man, its being passed into twilight, life spirit into void.

lotr01231.name: Ulaire Enquea, Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01231.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01231.game_text: Fierce. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions (or 5 burdens) and exert Ulaire Enquea to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr01231.lore: The Nine Riders were embodiments of Sauron's will, searching all of Middle-earth for his prize.

lotr01232.name: Ulaire Lemenya, Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01232.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01232.game_text: Each companion or ally who bears a [Wraith] condition is strength -2.
lotr01232.lore: ”'Do you wish them to find you? They are terrible!'”

lotr01233.name: Ulaire Nelya, Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01233.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01233.game_text: Fierce. Shadow: Exert Ulaire Nelya and spot an opponent's site to replace it with your site of the same number.
lotr01233.lore: Many of the Nine were princes of majesty and power.

lotr01234.name: Ulaire Nertea, Messenger of Dol Guldur
lotr01234.subtitle: Messenger of Dol Guldur
lotr01234.game_text: When you play Ulaire Nertea, for each companion over 4, you may play 1 minion from your discard pile.
lotr01234.lore: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.

lotr01235.name: Ulaire Otsea, Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01235.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01235.game_text: Shadow: Exert Ulaire Otsea to make a [Wraith] minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr01235.lore: ”…under their mantles were long grey robes; upon their grey hairs were helms of silver; in their haggard hands were swords of steel.”

lotr01236.name: Ulaire Toldea, Messenger of Morgul
lotr01236.subtitle: Messenger of Morgul
lotr01236.game_text: Fierce. Assignment: Spot 4 burdens to assign a companion (except the Ring-bearer) to skirmish Ulaire Toldea.
lotr01236.lore: ”'Open, in the name of Mordor!' said a voice thin and menacing.”

lotr01237.name: The Witch-king, Lord of Angmar
lotr01237.subtitle: Lord of Angmar
lotr01237.game_text: Fierce. For each other Nazgul you can spot, The Witch-king is strength +2.
lotr01237.lore: ”…his hair was long and gleaming and on his helm was a crown.”

lotr01238.name: Wreathed in Shadow
lotr01238.game_text: To play, spot a Nazgul. Plays to your support area. Archery: Remove (1) to make the fellowship archery total -1.
lotr01238.lore: They are beings in twilight, without form to catch the points of weapons.

lotr01239.name: All Thought Bent on It
lotr01239.game_text: Search. Maneuver: Spot a [Sauron] Orc and 5 companions to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each companion over 4.
lotr01239.lore: ”'…for the Ring yearns, above all else, to return to the hand of its Master: they are one….'”

lotr01240.name: Band of the Eye
lotr01240.game_text: Response: If this minion wins a skirmish, remove (2) to make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from hand.

lotr01241.name: Curse From Mordor
lotr01241.game_text: Shadow: Spot a [Sauron] Orc to discard an [Elven] condition.
lotr01241.lore: The Dark Lord harbors an ancient hatred for descendants of Gil-galad and those that marched with his gleaming host.

lotr01242.name: The Dark Lord's Summons
lotr01242.game_text: Search. To play, spot a [Sauron] Orc. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is a [Sauron] card, take it into hand. Otherwise, discard it and one other card from hand.
lotr01242.lore: Orcs obey the Dark Lord unquestioningly.

lotr01243.name: Despair
lotr01243.game_text: Maneuver: If the total number of burdens and companions in the dead pile is at least 12, spot a [Sauron] Orc to corrupt the Ring-bearer.
lotr01243.lore: ”'The Nameless Enemy has arisen again. Smoke rises once more from Orodruin that we call Mount Doom.'”

lotr01244.name: Desperate Defense of the Ring
lotr01244.game_text: To play, exert a [Sauron] Orc. Plays on a companion. Each time bearer is assigned to a skirmish, the Free Peoples player chooses to either discard 3 cards from hand or add a burden.
lotr01244.lore: The Company must defend the Ring at all costs.

lotr01245.name: Desperate Measures
lotr01245.game_text: Maneuver: Spot a [Sauron] Orc and remove a burden to make the Free Peoples player discard top 5 cards from his draw deck.
lotr01245.lore: ”'Go back, Sam. You can't swim. I'm going to Mordor alone.'”

lotr01246.name: Enduring Evil
lotr01246.game_text: Skirmish: Spot X burdens to make a character skirmishing a [Sauron] Orc strength -X.
lotr01246.lore: ”'The Dark Tower was broken, but its foundations were not removed; for they were made with the power of the Ring, and while it remains they will endure.'”

lotr01247.name: Enheartened Foe
lotr01247.game_text: Response: If a [Sauron] Orc wins a skirmish, make that Orc fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr01247.lore: Orcs feed on their own success. The greater their exploits in battle, the greater their confidence grows.

lotr01248.name: Forces of Mordor
lotr01248.game_text: Shadow: Spot X [Sauron] minions to add (X).
lotr01248.lore: ”'….the Dark Lord is not without allies. The Easterlings and Haradrim now pay tribute to Mordor.'”

lotr01249.name: Gleaming Spires Will Crumble
lotr01249.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each [Sauron] Orc skirmishing a [Gondor] character is strength +2. Discard this condition if your [Sauron] Orc loses a skirmish.
lotr01249.lore: Gondor has long been a target for the wrath of Sauron the Great.

lotr01250.name: Hate
lotr01250.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a [Sauron] Orc to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr01250.lore: Orcs are filled with hatred not only for their foes, but for all that lives.

lotr01251.name: A Host Avails Little
lotr01251.game_text: Search. Maneuver: Spot a [Sauron] Orc and 6 companions to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Do this once for each companion over 5.
lotr01251.lore: ”'Had I a host of Elves in armour of the Elder Days, it would avail little….'”

lotr01252.name: The Irresistible Shadow
lotr01252.game_text: To play, exert a [Sauron] Orc. Plays to your support area. If you can spot 5 burdens and the Free Peoples player has no cards in his or her draw deck, the Ring-bearer is corrupted.
lotr01252.lore: “Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo; but this time it was stronger than before.”

lotr01253.name: Journey Into Danger
lotr01253.game_text: Search. To play, exert a [Sauron] Orc. Plays to your support area. While you can spot 5 companions, each companion's twilight cost is +2.
lotr01253.lore: ”'I do not foretell, for all foretelling is now vain: on the one hand lies darkness, on the other only hope.'”

lotr01254.name: Mordor Enraged
lotr01254.game_text: Plays on a [Sauron] minion. Shadow: Exert bearer to add (1) for each archer companion.
lotr01254.lore: The armies of Elendil and Gil-galad inflamed Sauron's anger and hatred.

lotr01255.name: Mordor's Strength
lotr01255.game_text: Skirmish: Exert a [Sauron] Orc to wound a character he is skirmishing.
lotr01255.lore: ”'It should have ended that day, but evil was allowed to endure.'”

lotr01256.name: Morgul Hunter
lotr01256.game_text: For each companion you can spot, this minion is strength +1.
lotr01256.lore: Sauron's hatred lives in the hearts of his minions.

lotr01257.name: Morgul Skirmisher
lotr01257.game_text: Maneuver: Remove (3) to exert a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr01257.lore: The Orcs of Mordor, heartened by the promise of blood and plunder, are dangerous foes in battle.

lotr01258.name: Morgul Skulker
lotr01258.game_text: When you play this minion, you may shuffle up to 2 [Wraith] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lotr01258.lore: Sly servants of the Ringwraiths of Morgul Vale, Morgul Orcs are alert to the desires of their masters.

lotr01259.name: Morgul Warden
lotr01259.game_text: For each other [Sauron] Orc you can spot, Morgul Warden is strength +1.
lotr01259.lore: With blind devotion, the Orcs of Mordor follow orders issued from the Dark Tower.

lotr01260.name: The Number Must Be Few
lotr01260.game_text: Search. Plays to your support area. While you can spot 7 companions, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1).
lotr01260.lore: ”'The number must be few, since your hope is in speed and secrecy.'”

lotr01261.name: Orc Ambusher
lotr01261.game_text: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [Sauron] minion you play is -1. Response: If a Free Peoples regroup event is played, exert this minion to cancel that event.
lotr01261.lore: ”'Orcs will often pursue foes for many leagues….'”

lotr01262.name: Orc Assassin
lotr01262.game_text: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [Sauron] minion you play is -1. Assignment: Spot 2 Hobbit companions to make the Free Peoples player assign a Hobbit to skirmish this minion.

lotr01263.name: Orc Banner
lotr01263.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish that involves a [Sauron] Orc, each [Sauron] Orc is strength +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr01263.lore: Tribes of Orcs from throughout Mordor rally to the banner of the Dark Tower.

lotr01264.name: Orc Bowmen
lotr01264.game_text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot a [Sauron] Orc, add 1 to the minion archery total.
lotr01264.lore: Where volleys of Orcish arrows fly, the defenders of the West fall.

lotr01265.name: Orc Butchery
lotr01265.game_text: Response: If a companion is killed by a [Sauron] Orc, the Free Peoples player must discard 3 cards from the top of his draw deck for each card in the dead pile.
lotr01265.lore: For sport, Orcs hew cruelly at the bodies of those they slay.

lotr01266.name: Orc Chieftain
lotr01266.game_text: When you play a weapon on this minion, add (2) (limit once per turn).
lotr01266.lore: Orc chieftains are the most cruel of a heartless race. Both strength and malice are needed to lead such followers.

lotr01267.name: Orc Hunters
lotr01267.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character he is skirmishing.
lotr01267.lore: Bred for battle, Sauron's soldiers live for the thrill of the fight - and the spoils of victory.

lotr01268.name: Orc Inquisitor
lotr01268.game_text: When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from hand.
lotr01268.lore: Cruel questioners of Mordor tore the secret from poor Gollum, that Sauron's most prized possession once again was found.

lotr01269.name: Orc Scimitar
lotr01269.game_text: Bearer must be a [Sauron] Orc. Skirmish: Remove (1) to make bearer strength +1 (limit +3).
lotr01269.lore: An Orc's weapon reflects his passion for war and cruelty.

lotr01270.name: Orc Scouting Band
lotr01270.game_text: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [Sauron] minion you play is -1. Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character it is skirmishing.
lotr01270.lore: The cunning ambushes of the Orc armies rely upon scouts first finding the enemy.

lotr01271.name: Orc Soldier
lotr01271.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character he is skirmishing.
lotr01271.lore: Bearing cruel weapons, Orcs go forth from Mordor to serve the Eye.

lotr01272.name: Orc War Band
