lotr03014.name: Erestor, Chief Advisor to Elrond
lotr03014.subtitle: Chief Advisor to Elrond
lotr03014.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. Response: If an Elf is about to take a wound from a [Sauron] minion or [Sauron] event, exert Erestor to prevent that wound.
lotr03014.lore: ”'Then there are but two courses… to hide the Ring for ever, or to unmake it.'”

lotr03015.name: Forests of Lothlorien
lotr03015.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot 3 [Elven] allies to wound a minion.

lotr03016.name: Friends of Old
lotr03016.game_text: Fellowship: Reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Heal X [Elven] allies, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lotr03016.lore: ”'You have been summoned here to answer the threat of Mordor.'”

lotr03017.name: Galadriel, Lady of the Golden Wood
lotr03017.subtitle: Lady of the Golden Wood
lotr03017.game_text: At the start of each of your turns, you may heal an Elf. Fellowship: Exert Galadriel to play the fellowship's next site if it is a forest (replacing opponent's site if necessary).
lotr03017.lore: ”'There is in her and in this land no evil, unless a man bring it hither himself. Then let him beware!'”

lotr03018.name: Galdor, Councilor From the West
lotr03018.subtitle: Councilor From the West
lotr03018.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. Regroup: Exert Galdor and spot a minion to return that minion to its owner's hand.
lotr03018.lore: ”'My heart tells me that Sauron will expect us to take the western way, when he learns what has befallen. He soon will.'”

lotr03019.name: Gift of the Evenstar
lotr03019.game_text: To play, spot Arwen. Bearer must be Aragorn. Skirmish: Exert Aragorn or discard 2 cards from hand to make a minion skirmishing Aragorn strength -1.
lotr03019.lore: ”'It is mine to give to whom I will… like my heart.'”

lotr03020.name: Golradir, Councilor of Imladris
lotr03020.subtitle: Councilor of Imladris
lotr03020.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Golradir to make an Orc strength -1.
lotr03020.lore: Their stay at Rivendell provided the Fellowship with counsel from many sources.

lotr03021.name: Long-knives of Legolas
lotr03021.game_text: Bearer must be Legolas. Each Orc or Uruk-hai skirmishing Legolas is strength -2.
lotr03021.lore: Sharp, bone-handled knives defend the Elves of Mirkwood at close quarters.

lotr03022.name: Master of Healing
lotr03022.game_text: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot Elrond (or 2 [Elven] allies) to heal a companion or ally.
lotr03022.lore: ”'Elrond has cured you: he has tended you for days, ever since you were brought in.'”

lotr03024.name: Phial of Galadriel
lotr03024.game_text: To play, exert an Elf. Bearer must be the Ring-bearer. Bearer's resistance is +2.
lotr03024.lore: ”'May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out. Remember Galadriel and her Mirror!'”

lotr03025.name: Saelbeth, Elven Councilor
lotr03025.subtitle: Elven Councilor
lotr03025.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Saelbeth to make an Uruk-hai strength -1.
lotr03025.lore: The wisdom of Saelbeth prepared the Company for the dangers they would face.

lotr03026.name: Something Draws Near
lotr03026.game_text: Fellowship or Maneuver: Exert an Elf to discard an [Isengard] possession or [Isengard] artifact.
lotr03026.lore: ”'We have hunted and slain many Orcs in the woods….'”

lotr03028.name: Voice of Nimrodel
lotr03028.game_text: Tale. Skirmish: Exert an Elf at a river or forest to cancel a skirmish involving that Elf.
lotr03028.lore: ”'Beside the falls of Nimrodel, / By water clear and cool, / Her voice as falling silver fell / Into the shining pool.'”

lotr03029.name: Betrayal of Isengard
lotr03029.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time an opponent draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the Shadow phase, you may remove (1). Maneuver: Exert Gandalf to wound Saruman twice.
lotr03029.lore: ”'There is only one Lord of the Ring.'”

lotr03030.name: Deep in Thought
lotr03030.game_text: Spell. Maneuver: Spot Gandalf and 4 twilight tokens to discard all Shadow conditions.
lotr03030.lore: “He was… trying to recall every memory of his former journey in the Mines, and considering anxiously the next course that he should take….”

lotr03031.name: Depart Silently
lotr03031.game_text: Stealth. Maneuver: At sites 1 to 5, spot Gandalf to prevent Hobbits from being assigned to skirmishes until the regroup phase. At any other site, spot Gandalf to make a Hobbit strength +3 until the regroup phase.

lotr03032.name: Fireworks
lotr03032.game_text: Spell. Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to shuffle up to 2 [Gandalf] or up to 2 [Shire] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lotr03032.lore: ”'The finest rockets ever seen: / they burst in stars of blue and green….'”

lotr03033.name: His First Serious Check
lotr03033.game_text: Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. You may add (X) to discard that card, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lotr03033.lore: ”…a false turn now might be disastrous.”

lotr03035.name: Trust Me as You Once Did
lotr03035.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert Gandalf to make a companion strength +1 for each companion with the Gandalf signet you can spot (limit +3).
lotr03035.lore: ”'Do not take me for some conjurer of cheap tricks! I am not trying to rob you. I am trying to help you.'”

lotr03036.name: Unknown Perils
lotr03036.game_text: Plays to your support area. Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, spot 4 twilight tokens and exert Gandalf to prevent that wound.
lotr03036.lore: “Suddenly he stopped as if listening. Frodo became aware that all was very quiet, inside and outside.”

lotr03037.name: Answering the Cries
lotr03037.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard a [Gondor] tale from hand to make a [Gondor] companion strength +2.
lotr03037.lore: “Drawing his bright sword and crying Elendil! Elendil! he crashed through the trees.”

lotr03038.name: Aragorn, Heir to the White City
lotr03038.subtitle: Heir to the White City
lotr03038.game_text: Ranger. Each time the fellowship moves during the fellowship phase, remove (2).
lotr03038.lore: ”'…his hood was cast back, and his dark hair was blowing in the wind, a light was in his eyes: a king returning from exile in his own land.'”

lotr03039.name: Banner of the White Tree
lotr03039.game_text: Tale. Maneuver: Exert a [Gondor] companion to make that companion strength +3 and defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr03039.lore: ”'Many Elves and many mighty Men, and many of their friends, had perished in the war.'”

lotr03040.name: Citadel of Minas Tirith
lotr03040.game_text: Plays to your support area. You may heal a [Gondor] companion at the end of each turn during which no companion or ally lost a skirmish.
lotr03040.lore: ”'One day our paths will lead us there, and the Tower guards shall take up the call - The Lords of Gondor have returned.'”

lotr03041.name: Gondor Bowmen
lotr03041.game_text: Tale. Plays to your support area. Archery: Exert a [Gondor] companion and discard this condition to make the fellowship archery total +2.
lotr03041.lore: Arrows of the Last Alliance brought death to Sauron's forces.

lotr03042.name: Horn of Boromir
lotr03042.game_text: Bearer must be Boromir. Maneuver: Exert Boromir and spot an ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
lotr03042.lore: “On a baldric he wore a great horn tipped with silver….”

lotr03043.name: Might of Numenor
lotr03043.game_text: Tale. Maneuver: Spot a [Gondor] companion to reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Heal X companions, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lotr03043.lore: ”'But the lords of Minas Tirith still fight on….'”

lotr03044.name: The Shards of Narsil
lotr03044.game_text: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Stack a [Gondor] card from hand here. Fellowship: Add (1) to take a card stacked here into hand.
lotr03044.lore: ”'…Narsil was broken and its light extinguished, and it had not yet been forged again.'”

lotr03045.name: Some Who Resisted
lotr03045.game_text: Tale. Maneuver: Spot a [Gondor] companion to make the twilight cost of each maneuver event +2.
lotr03045.lore: ”'In the south the realm of Gondor long endured; and for a while its splendour grew….'”

lotr03046.name: Still Sharp
lotr03046.game_text: Skirmish: Spot The Shards of Narsil to make a [Gondor] companion strength +3 and damage +1.
lotr03046.lore: ”'The shards of Narsil… the blade that cut the Ring from Sauron's hand.'”

lotr03047.name: Voice of Rauros
lotr03047.game_text: Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to make each companion with the Aragorn signet damage +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr03047.lore: “As he ran the cries came louder, but fainter now and desperately the horn was blowing.”

lotr03048.name: We Must Go Warily
lotr03048.game_text: Response: If the fellowship moves in the regroup phase, exert a [Gondor] companion twice to make each minion's twilight cost +1 until the next regroup phase.
lotr03048.lore: ”'This is the lawn of Parth Galen: a fair place in the summer days of old. Let us hope that no evil has yet come here.'”

lotr03049.name: Abandoning Reason for Madness
lotr03049.game_text: Shadow: Spot an [Isengard] minion to discard up to 3 cards from hand and draw an equal number of cards.
lotr03049.lore: ”'And why not, Gandalf?… Why not? The Ruling Ring? If we could command that, then the power would pass to us.'”

lotr03050.name: Can You Protect Me From Yourself?
lotr03050.game_text: Maneuver: Spot an [Isengard] minion to exhaust Aragorn. The Free Peoples player may add 2 burdens to prevent this.
lotr03050.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set3/lotr03050/Can You Protect Me From Yourself_ (3R50).jpg

lotr03051.name: Coming for the Ring
lotr03051.game_text: Regroup: Reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Heal X [Isengard] minions, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lotr03051.lore: ”'This evil cannot be concealed by the power of the Elves….'”

lotr03052.name: A Fell Voice on the Air
lotr03052.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert Saruman to play an [Isengard] weather condition from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is -2.
lotr03052.lore: ”'He's trying to bring down the mountain!'”
lotr03052.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set3/lotr03052/A Fell Voice on the Air (3R52).jpg

lotr03053.name: Hate and Anger
lotr03053.game_text: Shadow: Spot an Uruk-hai and a [Moria] minion to draw 3 cards.
lotr03053.lore: The frenzy of Uruks is born of the fear of the very Goblins that work the pits.

lotr03054.name: Hollowing of Isengard
lotr03054.game_text: To play, spot an [Isengard] Orc. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Discard this condition to add (3).

lotr03055.name: Isengard Axe
lotr03055.game_text: Bearer must be an [Isengard] Orc. When you play this weapon, add (1).
lotr03055.lore: Axes eat into the forests of Isengard as well as the victims of Saruman's Orcs.

lotr03056.name: Isengard Forger
lotr03056.game_text: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (1).
lotr03056.lore: ”'I looked on it and saw that, whereas it had once been green and fair, it was now filled with pits and forges.'”

lotr03057.name: Isengard Retainer
lotr03057.game_text: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lotr03057.lore: ”'…the Eagles of the mountain went far and wide, and they saw many things: the gathering of wolves and the mustering of Orcs….'”

lotr03058.name: Isengard Servant
lotr03058.game_text: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lotr03058.lore: The servants of Isengard worked tirelessly to spread the influence of their master.

lotr03059.name: Isengard Shaman
lotr03059.game_text: Response: If an [Isengard] Orc is about to take a wound, remove (2) to prevent that wound.
lotr03059.lore: ”'Over all his works a dark smoke hung and wrapped itself about the sides of Orthanc.'”

lotr03060.name: Isengard Smith
lotr03060.game_text: Regroup: Exert this minion to discard a weapon (or all Free Peoples possessions if you can spot 5 companions).
lotr03060.lore: ”'No other folk make such a trampling….'”

lotr03061.name: Isengard Warrior
lotr03061.game_text: While you can spot another [Isengard] Orc, no player may use archery special abilities. Regroup:Exert this minion and spot 3 wounds on the Ring-bearer to exert every companion.
lotr03061.lore: ”'There is evil afoot in Isengard, and the West is no longer safe.'”

lotr03062.name: Isengard Worker
lotr03062.game_text: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lotr03062.lore: ”'They were Elves once. Taken by the dark powers - tortured and mutilated….'”

lotr03063.name: One of You Must Do This
lotr03063.game_text: Maneuver: Exert an [Isengard] minion to make the Free Peoples player exert X companions, where X is the number of these races you can spot in the fellowship: Dwarf, Elf, Man, and Wizard.
lotr03063.lore: ”'And if we fail, what then? What happens when Sauron takes back what is his?'”
lotr03063.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set3/lotr03063/One of You Must Do This (3C63).jpg

lotr03064.name: Orc Commander
lotr03064.game_text: Each other [Isengard] Orc is strength +1. Regroup: Exert Orc Commander to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lotr03064.lore: ”'It seems their delight to slash and beat down growing things that are not even in their way.'”

lotr03065.name: Orc Overseer
lotr03065.game_text: Regroup: Exert Orc Overseer twice to exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr03065.lore: ”'What orders from Mordor, my Lord? What does the Eye command?'”

lotr03066.name: Orthanc Berserker
lotr03066.game_text: Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot 5 burdens and exert Orthanc Berserker twice to exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr03066.lore: The voice of Saruman compels his minions to stop at nothing to earn his favor.

lotr03068.name: Saruman, Keeper of Isengard
lotr03068.subtitle: Keeper of Isengard
lotr03068.game_text: Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. Uruk-hai are fierce. Response: If an Uruk-hai is about to take a wound, exert Saruman to prevent that wound.

lotr03069.name: Saruman, Servant of the Eye
lotr03069.subtitle: Servant of the Eye
lotr03069.game_text: Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. Assignment: Exert Saruman to assign an [Isengard] minion to a companion (except the Ring-bearer). That companion may exert to prevent this.

lotr03070.name: Servants to Saruman
lotr03070.game_text: Skirmish: Make an [Isengard] Orc strength +2 (or +3 if you have fewer than 3 cards in hand).
lotr03070.lore: ”'This is grievous news concerning Saruman… for we trusted him and he is deep in all our counsels.'”

lotr03071.name: Tower of Orthanc
lotr03071.game_text: To play, spot an [Isengard] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot an exhausted companion to add (3).

lotr03072.name: Trapped and Alone
lotr03072.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each character skirmishing an [Isengard] Orc loses all damage bonuses from weapons.
lotr03072.lore: ”'…I had no chance of escape, and my days were bitter.'”

lotr03073.name: The Trees Are Strong
lotr03073.game_text: Regroup: Discard X [Isengard] Orcs to make the Free Peoples player wound X companions.

lotr03074.name: Uruk Raider
lotr03074.game_text: Damage +1. While an ally is in the dead pile, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.
lotr03074.lore: There is no safety where Saruman's emblem is shown.

lotr03075.name: Uruk Ravager
lotr03075.game_text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may spot Saruman to add (2).
lotr03075.lore: ”'…a ruined and terrible form of life.'”

lotr03076.name: Dangerous Gamble
lotr03076.game_text: Shadow: Spot a [Moria] minion to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Add (X), where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lotr03076.lore: “Almost they began to hope that they would escape.”

lotr03077.name: Depths of Moria
lotr03077.game_text: To play, spot a [Moria] Orc. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, add (2).
lotr03077.lore: ”…a great fissure had opened. Out of it a fierce red light came, and now and again flames licked at the brink…. Wisps of dark smoke wavered in the hot air.”

lotr03078.name: Hide and Seek
lotr03078.game_text: Search. Skirmish: Spot 2 [Shire] companions to make a [Moria] minion damage +1.

lotr03079.name: Malice
lotr03079.game_text: Archery: Spot a [Moria] Orc and a [Sauron] Orc to wound an archer.
lotr03079.lore: Fueled by Sauron's hatred of living things, Orcs searched for the Ring of Power.

lotr03080.name: Such a Little Thing
lotr03080.game_text: Maneuver: Spot a [Moria] minion to wound Boromir 3 times. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 Free Peoples possessions to prevent this.

lotr03081.name: Gates of the Dead City
lotr03081.game_text: To play, spot a Nazgul. Plays to your support area. Each time a [Wraith] card adds a burden, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion.
lotr03081.lore: ”'…and they took Minas Ithil and abode in it, and they made it into a place of dread….'”

lotr03082.name: News of Mordor
lotr03082.game_text: Skirmish: Spot an [Isengard] minion to make a Nazgul damage +1.
lotr03082.lore: ”'Build me an army worthy of Mordor.'”

lotr03083.name: The Ring Draws Them
lotr03083.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, add (1) for each burden you can spot. At the end of each of your Shadow phases, exert a Nazgul or discard this condition.
lotr03083.lore: ”'If I move I shall be seen and hunted!'”

lotr03084.name: They Will Never Stop Hunting You
lotr03084.game_text: Maneuver: Spot a Nazgul to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Exert a companion bearing a ranged weapon X times, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lotr03084.lore: ”'They're looking for Baggins, and if they mean well, then I'm a hobbit.'”
lotr03084.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set3/lotr03084/They Will Never Stop Hunting You (3C84).jpg

lotr03085.name: Too Great and Terrible
lotr03085.game_text: Maneuver: Spot a Nazgul to wound Gandalf twice. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 [Gandalf] cards from hand to prevent this.
lotr03085.lore: “His eyes flashed and his face was lit as by a fire within. 'Do not tempt me! For I do not wish to become like the Dark Lord himself.'”

lotr03086.name: Ulaire Otsea, Ringwraith in Twilight
lotr03086.subtitle: Ringwraith in Twilight
lotr03086.game_text: Twilight. Each time Ulaire Otsea wins a skirmish, you may exert him to transfer Blade Tip from your support area to the Ring-bearer.
lotr03086.lore: ”'…at all times they smell the blood of living things, desiring and hating it.'”

lotr03087.name: The Dark Lord Advances
lotr03087.game_text: Regroup: Exert a [Sauron] minion to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. That player must discard X cards from hand, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lotr03087.lore: ”'A power was there that we have not felt before.'”

lotr03088.name: Get Off the Road!
lotr03088.game_text: Search. Shadow: Spot a [Sauron] minion and a Nazgul to make the Free Peoples player discard a card from the top of his or her deck for each burden you can spot.
lotr03088.lore: ”'The Morgul-lord and his Black Riders have come forth. War is preparing!'”

lotr03089.name: Gleaming in the Snow
lotr03089.game_text: Regroup: Exert a [Sauron] Orc and spot a [Gondor] companion to add a burden.
lotr03089.lore: ”'A Ring of Power looks after itself…. It may slip off treacherously, but its keeper never abandons it.'”

lotr03090.name: Hand of Sauron
lotr03090.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a [Sauron] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from his or her hand.
lotr03090.lore: ”'The power of the Ring could not be undone.'”

lotr03091.name: His Cruelty and Malice
lotr03091.game_text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a [Sauron] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard the top card from his or her draw deck.
lotr03091.lore: ”'Into this Ring he poured his cruelty, his malice, and his will to dominate all life.'”

lotr03092.name: Massing in the East
lotr03092.game_text: Regroup: Exert a [Sauron] minion to discard a card from the top of the Free Peoples player's draw deck for each of these races you can spot in the fellowship: Dwarf, Elf, Man, and Wizard.
lotr03092.lore: ”'The power of the Black Land grows….'”

lotr03093.name: Morgul Slayer
lotr03093.game_text: Regroup: Exert this minion to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr03093.lore: ”'Sauron was diminished, but not destroyed. His Ring was lost but not unmade.'”

lotr03094.name: Orc Butcher
lotr03094.game_text: For each [Sauron] condition you can spot, this minion is strength +1.
lotr03094.lore: ”'And yet we see that Sauron can torture and destroy the very hills.'”

lotr03095.name: Orc Guard
lotr03095.game_text: Maneuver: Exert this minion and discard your [Sauron] condition to discard a Free Peoples condition.
lotr03095.lore: The malice of the Dark Tower thins the hopes of Men.

lotr03096.name: Orc Pillager
lotr03096.game_text: For each Free Peoples card borne by a character this minion is skirmishing, that character is strength -1.
lotr03096.lore: Weapons of the West are often powerless against the threat of Sauron.

lotr03097.name: Orc Slayer
lotr03097.game_text: Regroup: Exert this minion to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr03097.lore: “For it is a long tale, full of deeds great and terrible….”

lotr03098.name: Orc Swordsman
lotr03098.game_text: While this minion bears a weapon, he is strength +2.
lotr03098.lore: ”'Many evil things there are that your strong walls and bright swords do not stay.'”

lotr03099.name: Orc Trooper
lotr03099.game_text: For each card in your hand, this minion is strength +1.
lotr03099.lore: The Dark Lord's power grows in unseen ways.

lotr03100.name: Orc Veteran
lotr03100.game_text: Skirmish: Discard your [Sauron] condition to make a character skirmishing this minion strength -1.
lotr03100.lore: ”'There was war, and the land was laid waste….'”

lotr03101.name: Orc Warrior
lotr03101.game_text: Maneuver: Exert this minion and discard your [Sauron] condition to make the Free Peoples player discard the top 2 cards from his or her draw deck.
lotr03101.lore: “Orcs were multiplying again in the mountains.”

lotr03102.name: Our List of Allies Grows Thin
lotr03102.game_text: To play, exert a [Sauron] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, add (1) for each ally you can spot.
lotr03102.lore: ”'The enemy is moving…. His eye is fixed on Rivendell. And Saruman, you tell me, has betrayed us.'”
lotr03102.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set3/lotr03102/Our List of Allies Grows Thin (3R102).jpg

lotr03103.name: Terrible as the Dawn
lotr03103.game_text: Maneuver: Spot a [Sauron] minion to wound Galadriel 3 times. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 Elves to prevent this.
lotr03103.lore: ”'In the place of the Dark Lord, you would have a Queen… All shall love me and despair!'”

lotr03104.name: Tower of Barad-dur
lotr03104.game_text: To play, exert a [Sauron] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must discard a card from hand.
lotr03104.lore: “The Dark Tower had been rebuilt, it was said. From there the power was spreading….”

lotr03105.name: Why Shouldn't I Keep It?
lotr03105.game_text: Maneuver: Spot a [Sauron] minion to discard Bilbo. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 Free Peoples conditions to prevent this.
lotr03105.lore: ”'No, wait, it's here in my pocket. Isn't that… isn't that odd now?'”

lotr03106.name: Bill the Pony
lotr03106.game_text: Bearer must be a Hobbit companion. The Shadow number of each site is -1. Discard Bill the Pony when at an underground site.
lotr03106.lore: ”'That animal can nearly talk…. He gave me a look as plain as Mr. Pippin could speak….'”

lotr03107.name: Frodo's Pipe
lotr03107.game_text: Bearer must be Frodo. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to heal a companion with the Frodo signet X times.
lotr03107.lore: ”'All the same, observations that I have made on my own many journeys south have convinced me that the weed itself is not native to our parts of the world.'”

lotr03108.name: Frying Pan
lotr03108.game_text: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Skirmish: Exert bearer to wound an Orc he or she is skirmishing.
lotr03108.lore: ”'I think I'm getting the hang of this!'”

lotr03109.name: Meant to Be Alone
lotr03109.game_text: Fellowship: Spot a Hobbit companion (except the Ring-bearer) to reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Remove (X), where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
lotr03109.lore: ”'You are a Ring-bearer, Frodo… to bear a Ring of Power is to be alone.'”

lotr03110.name: Melilot Brandybuck, Merry Dancer
lotr03110.subtitle: Merry Dancer
lotr03110.game_text: Response: If a burden is about to be added by a Shadow card, exert Melilot Brandybuck to prevent that burden.
lotr03110.lore: “Master Everard Took and Miss Melilot Brandybuck got on a table and with bells in their hands began to dance the Springle-ring: a pretty dance, but rather vigorous.”

lotr03111.name: Old Noakes, Purveyor of Wisdoms
lotr03111.subtitle: Purveyor of Wisdoms
lotr03111.game_text: Each time a Shadow card makes you discard a card from hand, you may also discard a minion or Shadow condition.
lotr03111.lore: ”'There's been some strange folk crossing the Shire - Dwarves and others of a less than savoury nature.'”

lotr03112.name: Seek and Hide
lotr03112.game_text: Stealth. Skirmish: Spot 2 [Shire] companions to make a minion lose all damage bonuses.
lotr03112.lore: A Hobbit's best friends in Moria are the very pillars that support its structure.

lotr03113.name: The Shire Countryside
lotr03113.game_text: To play, spot 2 [Shire] companions. Plays to your support area. Each time you remove a burden (except by a Hobbit's game text), you may heal a companion.
lotr03113.lore: ”'Life in the wide world goes on… scarcely even aware of the existence of hobbits….'”

lotr03114.name: Three Monstrous Trolls
lotr03114.game_text: Tale. Plays to your support area. Response: If a Shadow card is about to add any number of twilight tokens, exert a Hobbit ally to prevent this.
lotr03114.lore: ”'Great big nasty twenty foot high smelly things _- and they're arguing… arguing about how they were going to cook us!'”

lotr03115.name: Caras Galadhon
lotr03115.game_text: Forest. Sanctuary. While the fellowship is at Caras Galadhon, no more than one minion may be assigned to each skirmish.

lotr03116.name: Eregion Hills
lotr03116.game_text: When the fellowship moves to Eregion Hills, add a burden.

lotr03117.name: Gates of Argonath
lotr03117.game_text: River. Maneuver events may not be played.

lotr03118.name: The Great River
lotr03118.game_text: River. While the fellowship is at The Great River, cards may not be played from draw decks or discard piles.

lotr03119.name: House of Elrond
lotr03119.game_text: Sanctuary. When the fellowship moves to House of Elrond, the Free Peoples player may spot 2 Elves to remove a burden.

lotr03120.name: Wastes of Emyn Muil
lotr03120.game_text: Maneuver: Spot 4 companions and exert your [Isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

lotr03121.name: Legolas, Son of Thranduil
lotr03121.subtitle: Son of Thranduil
lotr03121.game_text: Archer. While Legolas is at a river or forest, add 1 to the fellowship archery total.
lotr03121.lore: ”'Praised be the bow of Galadriel, and the hand and eye of Legolas!… That was a mighty shot in the dark, my friend!'”

lotr03122.name: Boromir, Defender of Minas Tirith
lotr03122.subtitle: Defender of Minas Tirith
lotr03122.game_text: Ranger. Fellowship: Add (2) to heal Boromir.
lotr03122.lore: ”…seated a little apart was a tall man with a fair and noble face… proud and stern of glance.”

lotr04001.name: The One Ring, Answer To All Riddles
lotr04001.subtitle: Answer To All Riddles
lotr04001.game_text: While wearing The One Ring, the Ring-bearer is strength +2, and each time he is about to take a wound in a skirmish, add a burden instead. Skirmish: Add a burden to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.
lotr04001.lore: ”'…thought to have perished from the world.'”
lotr04001.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set4/lotr04001/The One Ring, Answer To All Riddles (4R1).jpg

lotr04002.name: The One Ring, The Ruling Ring
lotr04002.subtitle: The Ruling Ring
lotr04002.game_text: Response: If bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he wears The One Ring until the regroup phase. While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, add a burden instead.
lotr04002.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set4/lotr04002/The One Ring, The Ruling Ring (4C2).jpg

lotr04003.name: Anger
lotr04003.game_text: Skirmish: Spot 3 [Dunland] minions or a site you control to make a [Dunland] Man fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr04003.lore: Rage filled the hearts of the Dunlending attackers.

lotr04004.name: Band of Wild Men
lotr04004.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may make it fierce until the regroup phase.

lotr04005.name: Burn Every Village
lotr04005.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Dunland] Man strength +2 (or +4 if you control a site).
lotr04005.lore: ”'Take your rabble through the Westemnet; take back the lands they stole from you.'”

lotr04006.name: Constantly Threatening
lotr04006.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: If the fellowship has moved more than once this turn, remove (2) to play a [Dunland] Man from your discard pile.
lotr04006.lore: The men of Dunland have hated the Rohirrim for many years.

lotr04007.name: Dark Fury
lotr04007.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Dunland] Man strength +2 (or +4 if at a sanctuary).
lotr04007.lore: “Dunland and Dunlendings are the names that the Rohirrim gave to them, because they were swarthy and dark-haired….”

lotr04008.name: Death to the Strawheads
lotr04008.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Dunland] Man strength +1 for each companion you spot.
lotr04008.lore: The dark Dunlendings called their fairhaired enemies from Rohan “Strawheads.”

lotr04009.name: Dunlending Arsonist
lotr04009.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [Dunland] Man from hand; his twilight cost is -2. That Man is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr04009.lore: ”'They bring fire… and they are burning as they come, rick, cot, and tree.'”

lotr04010.name: Dunlending Brigand
lotr04010.lore: ”'This was a rich vale and had many homesteads. Alas for my folk!'”

lotr04011.name: Dunlending Looter
lotr04011.game_text: When this minion wins a skirmish, you may stack him on a site you control. Shadow: If stacked on a site you control, play this minion. His twilight cost is -2.
lotr04011.lore: ”…the Dunlendings raided often over the Isen.”

lotr04012.name: Dunlending Madman
lotr04012.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may make him strength +2 and fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr04012.lore: ”'They hate us, and they are glad; for our doom seems certain to them.'”

lotr04013.name: Dunlending Pillager
lotr04013.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may discard a Free Peoples possession (or 2 possessions if you spot 6 companions).
lotr04013.lore: ”'Not in half a thousand years have they forgotten their grievance that the lords of Gondor gave the Mark to Eorl the Young and made alliance with him.'”

lotr04014.name: Dunlending Ransacker
lotr04014.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may spot another [Dunland] Man to take control of a site.
lotr04014.lore: ”'Yet there are many that cry in the Dunland tongue.'”

lotr04015.name: Dunlending Ravager
lotr04015.game_text: While skirmishing a [Rohan] Man, this minion is strength +2. Assignment: Spot an ally to make that ally participate in skirmishes and assign this minion to skirmish that ally.

lotr04016.name: Dunlending Robber
lotr04016.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may make him strength +2 and fierce until the regroup phase.

lotr04017.name: Dunlending Savage
lotr04017.lore: The Dunlendings' fury could only end in the death of the king of Rohan.

lotr04018.name: Dunlending Warrior
lotr04018.game_text: Assignment: Spot an ally to make that ally participate in skirmishes and assign this minion to skirmish that ally.
lotr04018.lore: “These were a remnant of the peoples that had dwelt in the vales of the White Mountains in ages past.”

lotr04019.name: Hides
lotr04019.game_text: Plays to your support area. When you play this possession, you may draw a card. Response: If a [Dunland] Man is about to take a wound, remove (2) or discard this possession to prevent that wound.
lotr04019.lore: Only heavy animal skins armored the Dunlendings.

lotr04020.name: Hill Chief
lotr04020.game_text: Shadow: Spot a site you control and exert Hill Chief to draw 3 cards.
lotr04020.lore: ”'…Saruman has armed the wild hillmen and herdfolk of Dunland beyond the rivers, and these also he loosed upon us.'”

lotr04021.name: Hillman Band
lotr04021.game_text: Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot another [Dunland] Man to take control of a site.
lotr04021.lore: As in years past, the Dunlendings marched in force to the west.

lotr04022.name: Hillman Horde
lotr04022.game_text: While you control 2 sites, skip the archery phase. While you control 3 sites, each of your [Dunland] Men is fierce. While you control 4 sites, each of your [Dunland] Men is damage +1.

lotr04023.name: Hillman Mob
lotr04023.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [Dunland] Man from hand; his twilight cost is -2. That Man is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.

lotr04024.name: Hillman Rabble
lotr04024.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may stack it on a site you control. Shadow: If stacked on a site you control, play this minion. Its twilight cost is -2.
lotr04024.lore: The relentless fury of the Dunlendings consumed one village after another.

lotr04025.name: Hillman Tribe
lotr04025.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may spot another [Dunland] minion to take control of a site.
lotr04025.lore: ”'They will not quail at the sun… the wild men of the hills.'”

lotr04026.name: Iron Axe
lotr04026.lore: Saruman armed the Dunlendings with weapons forged by his Orcs in Isengard.

lotr04027.name: Living Off Rock
lotr04027.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a [Dunland] Man wins a skirmish involving a [Rohan] Man, you may make that minion strength +2 and fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr04027.lore: ”'The Horsemen took your land; they drove your people into the hills to scratch living off rock.'”

lotr04028.name: No Defense
lotr04028.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to place a [Dunland] token here. Skirmish: Spot a [Dunland] Man and remove a [Dunland] token from this card. A character skirmishing that [Dunland] Man does not gain strength bonuses from possessions.

lotr04029.name: No Refuge
lotr04029.game_text: Plays to your support area. While a [Dunland] Man is stacked on a site, the Shadow number of each site is +5.
lotr04029.lore: As their homes were ravaged by the wild men, refugees fled to the safety of Helm's Deep.

lotr04030.name: No Retreat
lotr04030.game_text: Plays on a site you control. Regroup: Spot 2 [Dunland] Men and discard this condition to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn (if the move limit allows).
lotr04030.lore: Hordes from Dunland laid waste to villages as their numbers grew.

lotr04031.name: Over the Isen
lotr04031.game_text: Plays to your support area. Assignment: Spot a site you control and remove (2) to assign a [Dunland] Man to an unbound companion.
lotr04031.lore: Like their ancestors years before, the Dunlendings came down from Isengard.

lotr04032.name: Ravage the Defeated
lotr04032.game_text: Response: If your [Dunland] Man wins a skirmish, discard all Free Peoples cards borne by the companion or ally he was skirmishing.
lotr04032.lore: What the Dunlendings cannot steal, they destroy.

lotr04033.name: Saruman, Rabble-rouser
lotr04033.subtitle: Rabble-rouser
lotr04033.game_text: Saruman may not be assigned to a skirmish. Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion for each [Dunland] Man you can spot. Skirmish: Exert Saruman to make a [Dunland] Man strength +2.

lotr04034.name: Secret Folk
lotr04034.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving a [Dunland] Man, you may place a [Dunland] token on this card. Maneuver: Discard a Free Peoples possession for each [Dunland] token here (limit 3). Discard this condition.

lotr04035.name: Wake of Destruction
lotr04035.game_text: Maneuver: Spot 2 sites you control to make each of your [Dunland] Men fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr04035.lore: The anger of the wild men increased with every home they pillaged.

lotr04036.name: War Club
lotr04036.game_text: Bearer must be a [Dunland] Man. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may discard 2 Free Peoples possessions.
lotr04036.lore: The wooden weapons of the wild men slew scores of unarmed villagers.

lotr04037.name: War Cry of Dunland
lotr04037.game_text: Response: If a [Dunland] Man wins a skirmish, make him fierce and strength +4 until the regroup phase.

lotr04038.name: Wild Man of Dunland
lotr04038.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [Dunland] Man from hand; his twilight cost is -2. That Man is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr04038.lore: ”'By our blood… we swear to fight for you….'”

lotr04039.name: Wild Man Raid
lotr04039.game_text: Maneuver: Spot 3 [Dunland] Men to discard a Free Peoples possession or condition.
lotr04039.lore: Not even the smallest of trinkets was safe from the destruction of the Dunlendings.

lotr04040.name: Wulf, Dunlending Chieftain
lotr04040.subtitle: Dunlending Chieftain
lotr04040.game_text: Fierce. Response: If another [Dunland] Man wins a skirmish, exert Wulf to take control of a site.

lotr04041.name: Axe of Erebor
lotr04041.game_text: Bearer must be Gimli. He is damage +1. Skirmish: Discard a [Dwarven] condition or a card stacked on a [Dwarven] condition to make Gimli strength +1.
lotr04041.lore: ”'…wherever thou goest my thought goes with thee. But have a care to lay thine axe to the right tree!'”

lotr04042.name: Best Company
lotr04042.game_text: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 if at a battleground).
lotr04042.lore: “An axe swung and swept back. Two Orcs fell headless. The rest fled.”

lotr04043.name: Come Here Lad
lotr04043.game_text: Fellowship: Stack the top 2 cards from your draw deck on a [Dwarven] condition that has a card already stacked on it.
lotr04043.lore: ”'You are the canniest, luckiest, most reckless fool I've ever met! Bless you.'”

lotr04044.name: Courtesy of My Hall
lotr04044.game_text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, stack a card from your discard pile here. Fellowship: Discard a Free Peoples card stacked here to heal a Dwarf.
lotr04044.lore: ”'Now my guests, come!… Come and take such refreshment as haste allows.'”

lotr04045.name: Dwarven Foresight
lotr04045.game_text: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to take a Free Peoples card stacked on a [Dwarven] condition into hand.
lotr04045.lore: ”'I would guess that the burned bones of the hobbits are now mingled with the Orcs'.'”

lotr04046.name: Ever My Heart Rises
lotr04046.game_text: Tale. Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, reveal the top 6 cards of your draw deck and stack them here. Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf and discard the top card of your draw deck to take a Free Peoples card stacked here into hand.

lotr04047.name: From the Armory
lotr04047.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf and stack a Free Peoples card from hand here to prevent all wounds to that Dwarf.
lotr04047.lore: ”'It's a bit tight around the chest.'”

lotr04048.name: Gimli, Lockbearer
lotr04048.subtitle: Lockbearer
lotr04048.game_text: Damage +1. Gimli is strength +1 for each unbound Hobbit companion you can spot.
lotr04048.lore: ”'You speak evil of that which is fair beyond the reach of your thought, and only little wit can excuse you.'”

lotr04049.name: Gimli, Unbidden Guest
lotr04049.subtitle: Unbidden Guest
lotr04049.game_text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Gimli to make an unbound companion strength +1 (or +2 if that companion is Legolas).
lotr04049.lore: “But a small dark figure that none had observed sprang out of the shadows”

lotr04050.name: Here Is Good Rock
lotr04050.game_text: Tale.Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Stack a Free Peoples card from hand here to make a Dwarf damage +1.
lotr04050.lore: ”'Give me a year and a hundred of my kin and I would make this a place that armies would break upon like water.'”

lotr04051.name: Khazad Ai-menu
lotr04051.game_text: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or strength +3 and damage +1 if you spot Legolas).
lotr04051.lore: ”'The Orcs are behind the wall. Ai-oi! Come, Legolas! There are enough for both of us.'”

lotr04052.name: My Axe Is Notched
lotr04052.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, place a [Dwarven] token on this card. While you can spot X [Dwarven] tokens on this card and the same number of [Elven] tokens on Final Count, Gimli is strength +X (limit +3).

lotr04053.name: Quick As May Be
lotr04053.game_text: Maneuver: Spot a Dwarf companion and an Elf companion to wound a minion.
lotr04053.lore: ”'I think, nonetheless, that we no longer need any trail to tell us which way to go.'”

lotr04054.name: Rest by Blind Night
lotr04054.game_text: Regroup: Shuffle any number of [Dwarven] conditions (and all cards stacked on them) into your draw deck.
lotr04054.lore: ”'And yet even I, Dwarf of many journeys… cannot run all the way to Isengard without any pause….'”

lotr04055.name: Restless Axe
lotr04055.game_text: Regroup: Exert a Dwarf to shuffle a [Dwarven] condition (and all cards stacked on it) into your draw deck. Exert a minion for each card shuffled into your draw deck.
lotr04055.lore: ”'Give me a row of orc-necks and room to swing and all weariness will fall from me!'”

lotr04056.name: Search Far and Wide
lotr04056.game_text: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf and discard the top card of your draw deck to draw 2 cards.
lotr04056.lore: ”'We have been set many riddles since we came to Tol Brandir, but this is the hardest to unravel.'”

lotr04057.name: Stout and Strong
lotr04057.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a Dwarf wins a skirmish, you may place a [Dwarven] token on this card. Skirmish: Make an unbound companion strength +1 for each [Dwarven] token here (limit +3). Discard this condition.
lotr04057.lore: ”'Never did I see an axe so wielded.'”

lotr04058.name: Alliance Reforged
lotr04058.game_text: Tale. Fellowship: Draw a card for each Elf companion you spot.
lotr04058.lore: ”'If we do not trust the strength of Men, then we trust to the victory of Sauron.'”

lotr04059.name: Arrow and Blade
lotr04059.game_text: Skirmish: Exert X Elf companions to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -X.
lotr04059.lore: The Elven bow and the sword of Man fought together as one weapon.

lotr04060.name: Blades Drawn
lotr04060.game_text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Plays to your support area. For each wound on each minion, that minion is strength -2. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lotr04060.lore: The sword skills of the Elven archers were unexpected.

lotr04061.name: Company of Archers
lotr04061.game_text: Archery: Spot 2 Elf companions to discard a condition.

lotr04062.name: Elven Bow
lotr04062.game_text: Bearer must be an Elf. Bearer is an archer.
lotr04062.lore: No finer bows could defend Helm's Deep than those of the Golden Wood.

lotr04063.name: Elven Brooch
lotr04063.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. Bearer must be a companion. Response: If another possession borne by bearer is about to be discarded by a Shadow card, discard this possession instead.

lotr04064.name: Elven Sword
lotr04064.game_text: Bearer must be an Elf. Skirmish: Exert bearer or discard 2 cards from hand to make a minion skirmishing bearer strength -1.
lotr04064.lore: Fine blades forged by Elven smiths are centuries-old heirlooms.

lotr04065.name: Erethon, Naith Lieutenant
lotr04065.subtitle: Naith Lieutenant
lotr04065.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. While Erethon bears a ranged weapon, he is strength +1 and damage +1, and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.

lotr04066.name: Feathered
lotr04066.game_text: Skirmish: Make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -2 for each wound on that minion.
lotr04066.lore: Elven swords found the same targets as their arrows.

lotr04067.name: Fereveldir, Son of Thandronen
lotr04067.subtitle: Son of Thandronen
lotr04067.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Fereveldir and discard an [Elven] token from your condition to wound a minion Fereveldir is skirmishing.

lotr04068.name: Ferevellon, Son of Thandronen
lotr04068.subtitle: Son of Thandronen
lotr04068.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Ferevellon to make a minion skirmishing him strength -2.
lotr04068.lore: The Uruks at Helm's Deep fell to his blade as easily as Goblins from the mountains.

lotr04069.name: Final Count
lotr04069.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may place an [Elven] token on this card. While you can spot X [Elven] tokens on this card and the same number of [Dwarven] tokens on My Axe Is Notched, Legolas is strength +X (limit +3).

lotr04070.name: Flashing Steel
lotr04070.game_text: Skirmish: Exert an Elf to make a minion skirmishing that Elf strength -3.
lotr04070.lore: ”'Good!… But my count is now two dozen. It has been knife-work up here.'”

lotr04071.name: Haldir, Emissary of the Galadhrim
lotr04071.subtitle: Emissary of the Galadhrim
lotr04071.game_text: While no opponent controls a site, Haldir is strength +2. Regroup: Exert Haldir at a battleground and exert another Elf to liberate a site.
lotr04071.lore: ”'In days of old, my people stood beside the King of Gondor - we come to honor that allegiance.'”

lotr04072.name: Killing Field
lotr04072.game_text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Plays to your support area. Each wounded minion is prevented from being fierce. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lotr04072.lore: The courage of the defenders blunted the Uruk assaults.

lotr04073.name: Legolas, Dauntless Hunter
lotr04073.subtitle: Dauntless Hunter
lotr04073.game_text: Archer. The twilight cost of each Shadow event and Shadow condition is +1 for each unbound Hobbit you can spot.
lotr04073.lore: ”'They are far, far away…. I know in my heart that they have not rested this night.'”

lotr04074.name: Legolas, Elven Comrade
lotr04074.subtitle: Elven Comrade
lotr04074.game_text: Archer. Skirmish: Exert Legolas to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -1 (or -2 if that companion is Gimli).
lotr04074.lore: ”'Come, you shall sit behind me, friend Gimli.'”

lotr04075.name: Lembas
lotr04075.game_text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Bearer must be a companion. Regroup: Discard this possession to reconcile your hand.
lotr04075.lore: “Sam thought that it tasted far better, somehow, than it had for a good while….”

lotr04076.name: Lorien Guardian
lotr04076.game_text: Regroup: Exert this companion to make a Shadow player wound a minion.
lotr04076.lore: Haldir's Elven bowmen were experienced defenders of the borders of the Golden Wood

lotr04077.name: Lorien Is Most Welcome
lotr04077.game_text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Plays to your support area. Each wounded minion loses all damage bonuses. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lotr04077.lore: ”'We are proud to fight alongside Men once more….'”

lotr04078.name: Lorien Swordsman
lotr04078.game_text: Each minion skirmishing this companion is strength -2 for each wound on that minion.
lotr04078.lore: Long, curved Elven steel cut down Uruks already weakened by Elven arrows.

lotr04079.name: Night Without End
lotr04079.game_text: Response: If an Elf wins a skirmish, exert that Elf to liberate a site or wound a minion.
lotr04079.lore: ”'Would that this night would end, and I could have better light for shooting.'”

lotr04080.name: Ordulus, Young Warrior
lotr04080.subtitle: Young Warrior
lotr04080.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. The twilight cost of each ranged weapon played on Ordulus is -1.
lotr04080.lore: Ordulus always has an arrow nocked and a full quiver too.

lotr04081.name: Pengedhel, Naith Warrior
lotr04081.subtitle: Naith Warrior
lotr04081.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. While Pengedhel bears a ranged weapon, he is strength +2 and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lotr04081.lore: Pengedhel can wield an arrow like a short spear.

lotr04082.name: Strength of Arms
lotr04082.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time an Elf wins a skirmish, you may place an [Elven] token on this card. Skirmish: Make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -1 for each [Elven] token here (limit -3). Discard this condition.
lotr04082.lore: Elvish weapons were more than a match for the Uruks.

lotr04083.name: Supporting Fire
lotr04083.game_text: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +3 if you spot 3 Elf companions).
lotr04083.lore: Sword-work is made easier with archery support.

lotr04084.name: Sword-wall
lotr04084.game_text: Skirmish or Regroup: Spot 3 Elf companions to liberate a site or exert a minion.
lotr04084.lore: A fixed line of Elven blades can hold off great numbers of the Enemy's hordes.

lotr04085.name: Thandronen, Veteran Protector
lotr04085.subtitle: Veteran Protector
lotr04085.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. Regroup: Exert Thandronen to discard a minion stacked on a condition or stacked on a site.
lotr04085.lore: The twin sons of Thandronen marched with their father to defend Helm's Deep.

lotr04086.name: Thonnas, Naith Captain
lotr04086.subtitle: Naith Captain
lotr04086.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. While Thonnas bears a ranged weapon, each minion skirmishing him is strength -2 and Thonnas does not add to the fellowship archery total.

lotr04087.name: Valor
lotr04087.game_text: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +3 if skirmishing a wounded minion).
lotr04087.lore: An Elf avoids taking up arms, but once committed to the fray, his will is resolute.

lotr04088.name: Behold the White Rider
lotr04088.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time Gandalf wins a skirmish, you may place a [Gandalf] token here. Skirmish: Wound a minion skirmishing Gandalf for each [Gandalf] token here. Discard this condition.

lotr04089.name: Gandalf, Greyhame
lotr04089.subtitle: Greyhame
lotr04089.game_text: Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, add (2) to play a character from your discard pile.
lotr04089.lore: ”'Dangerous!… And so am I, very dangerous; more dangerous than anything you will ever meet….'”

lotr04090.name: Gandalf, The White Wizard
lotr04090.subtitle: The White Wizard
lotr04090.game_text: While you can spot 3 twilight tokens, Gandalf is strength +3.
lotr04090.lore: ”'Behold, I am not Gandalf the Grey, whom you betrayed. I am Gandalf the White, who has returned from death.'”

lotr04092.name: Grown Suddenly Tall
lotr04092.game_text: Spell. Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to discard all conditions.
lotr04092.lore: “His hood and grey rags were flung away. His white garments shone.”

lotr04093.name: Have Patience
lotr04093.game_text: Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to heal an unbound companion twice.
lotr04093.lore: ”'Go where you must go, and hope!'”

lotr04094.name: Hearken to Me
lotr04094.game_text: Spell. To play, spot Gandalf. Bearer must be Theoden. Discard all Shadow conditions on Theoden. Shadow conditions may not be played on Theoden.
lotr04094.lore: ”'Not all is dark. Take courage, Lord of the Mark; for better help you will not find.'”

lotr04095.name: Into Dark Tunnels
lotr04095.game_text: Spell. Response: If you play a [Gandalf] event, exert Gandalf twice to place that event in your hand instead of your discard pile.
lotr04095.lore: ”'Even Sauron knows them not. They are older than he. Now I have walked there, but I will bring no report to darken the light of day.'”

lotr04096.name: Keep Your Forked Tongue
lotr04096.game_text: Skirmish: Spot Gandalf and 3 twilight tokens to prevent all wounds to a companion who has the Gandalf signet.

lotr04097.name: Long I Fell
lotr04097.game_text: Spell. Skirmish: Spot Gandalf to prevent all wounds to him. Any Shadow player may make you wound a minion to prevent this.
lotr04097.lore: ”'His fire was about me. I was burned.'”

lotr04098.name: Mithrandir, Mithrandir!
lotr04098.subtitle: Mithrandir!
lotr04098.game_text: Spell. Maneuver: Exert Gandalf to wound each minion who has strength of 6 or less.
lotr04098.lore: “The wild men fell on their faces before him.”

lotr04099.name: Roll of Thunder
lotr04099.game_text: Fellowship or Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to discard a Shadow possession or Shadow artifact.
lotr04099.lore: ”'I have not passed through fire and death to bandy crooked words with a serving-man till the lightning falls.'”

lotr04100.name: Shadowfax
lotr04100.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Discard any hand weapon he bears. Gandalf may not bear a hand weapon. At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, each minion skirmishing him must exert.
lotr04100.lore: ”'He is the chief of the Mearas, lords of horses….'”

lotr04101.name: Stump and Bramble
lotr04101.game_text: Maneuver: Spot an [Isengard] minion and an Ent ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is damage +2 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
lotr04101.lore: ”'Many of those trees were my friends… many had voices of their own that are lost for ever now.'”

lotr04102.name: Task Was Not Done
lotr04102.game_text: Spell. Regroup: Exert Gandalf to discard up to 2 wounded minions.
lotr04102.lore: ”'Naked I was sent back - for a brief time, until my task is done. And naked I lay upon the mountain-top.'”

lotr04103.name: Treebeard, Earthborn
lotr04103.subtitle: Earthborn
lotr04103.game_text: Unhasty. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is about to be discarded, stack him here instead. Fellowship: Exert Treebeard and add(1) to play an unbound Hobbit stacked here.
lotr04103.lore: ”'Do not be hasty, that is my motto.'”

lotr04104.name: Treebeard, Oldest Living Thing
lotr04104.subtitle: Oldest Living Thing
lotr04104.game_text: Unhasty. Fellowship: Exert Treebeard and discard an unbound companion from hand to heal an unbound companion.
lotr04104.lore: ”'No, I am not tired. I do not easily get tired. And I do not sit down. I am not very, hm, bendable.'”

lotr04105.name: Under the Living Earth
lotr04105.game_text: Skirmish: Make Gandalf strength +1 for each twilight token you spot (limit +5).
lotr04105.lore: ”'Thither I came at last, to the uttermost foundations of stone. He was with me still.'”

lotr04106.name: Well Met Indeed
lotr04106.game_text: Fellowship: Spot an Elf, a [Gondor] Man, and a Dwarf to play Gandalf from your dead pile.
lotr04106.lore: ”'And what may you be doing in these parts? An Elf, a Man, and a Dwarf, all clad in elvish fashion.'”

lotr04107.name: Windows in a Stone Wall
lotr04107.game_text: To play, exert an Ent. Plays on that Ent. Response: If an [Isengard] minion is killed, discard this condition to reveal the top 10 cards of an opponent's draw deck. Discard 1 Shadow card and 1 Free Peoples card revealed. Your opponent reshuffles that deck.

lotr04108.name: Wizardry Indeed
lotr04108.game_text: Maneuver: If you can spot more minions than companions, exert Gandalf to make an opponent discard a minion.
lotr04108.lore: “The hosts of Isengard roared, swaying this way and that, turning from fear to fear.”

lotr04109.name: Aragorn, Heir of Elendil
lotr04109.subtitle: Heir of Elendil
lotr04109.lore: ”'Sauron fears you, Aragorn, he fears what you may become.'”

lotr04110.name: Arrows Thick in the Air
lotr04110.game_text: Archery or Skirmish: Exert 2 Ring-bound Men to wound each roaming minion.
lotr04110.lore: “He came to rest in the fern a few feet away, face downward, green arrow-feathers sticking from his neck below a golden collar.”

lotr04111.name: Boromir, My Brother
lotr04111.subtitle: My Brother
lotr04111.game_text: Bearer must be Faramir. Skirmish: Discard a [Gondor] card from hand to make a Ringbound Man strength +1.
lotr04111.lore: ”'Where is thy horn? Whither goest thou? O Boromir! But he was gone.'”

lotr04112.name: Boromir's Gauntlets
lotr04112.game_text: Bearer must be a [Gondor] Man. Skirmish: Exert bearer to cancel a skirmish involving bearer. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.
lotr04112.lore: ”'…now Boromir has taken his road, and we must make haste to choose our own.'”

lotr04113.name: Curse Them
lotr04113.game_text: Skirmish: Exert a Ring-bound Man to cancel a skirmish involving a roaming minion.
lotr04113.lore: ”'It is close on ten leagues hence to the eastshore of Anduin… and we seldom come so far afield.'”

lotr04114.name: Damrod, Ranger of Ithilien
lotr04114.subtitle: Ranger of Ithilien
lotr04114.game_text: Ring-bound. Ranger. To play, spot a Ring-bound Man. Skirmish: Exert Damrod to exhaust a Man he is skirmishing.
lotr04114.lore: ”'I doubt not that the days of Gondor are numbered, and the walls of Minas Tirith are doomed, so great is His strength and malice.'”

lotr04115.name: Defend It and Hope
lotr04115.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a [Gondor] Man to wound a minion once (or twice if that minion is an Uruk-hai).
lotr04115.lore: ”'Is it not said that no foe has ever taken the Hornburg, if men defended it?'”

lotr04116.name: Faramir, Captain of Gondor
lotr04116.subtitle: Captain of Gondor
lotr04116.game_text: Ring-bound. Ranger. The twilight cost of each other [Gondor] Man in your starting fellowship is -1. While skirmishing a roaming minion, Faramir is strength +2.
lotr04116.lore: ”'He leads us now in all perilous ventures.'”

lotr04117.name: Faramir, Son of Denethor
lotr04117.subtitle: Son of Denethor
lotr04117.game_text: Ring-bound. Ranger. An opponent may not play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities during skirmishes involving Faramir.
lotr04117.lore: “He could see Faramir's face, which was now unmasked; it was stern and commanding, and a keen wit lay behind his searching glance.”

lotr04118.name: Faramir's Bow
lotr04118.game_text: Bearer must be Faramir. He is an archer. Skirmish: If Faramir is skirmishing a Man or a roaming minion, exert Faramir to wound that minion.
lotr04118.lore: ”'Were I as hasty as you, I might have slain you long ago.'”

lotr04119.name: Faramir's Cloak
lotr04119.game_text: Bearer must be Faramir. Each roaming minion skirmishing a Ring-bound Man is strength -1.
lotr04119.lore: Captain Faramir and his rangers were clad in green and brown of varied hues, better to walk unseen in the glades of Ithilien.

lotr04120.name: Forbidden Pool
lotr04120.game_text: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 6T, each Ring-bound Man takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase. Fellowship: Add (2) and discard this condition to heal a Ring-bound Man.
lotr04120.lore: ”'…tonight you have come where it is death to come.'”

lotr04121.name: Forests of Ithilien
lotr04121.game_text: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 5T, the site number of each Man in a skirmish is +2. Regroup: Discard this condition and exert a Ring-bound Man to liberate a site.
lotr04121.lore: ”…a fair country of climbing woods and swift-falling streams.”

lotr04122.name: Gondorian Ranger
lotr04122.game_text: Ring-bound. Ranger. The site number of each minion assigned to skirmish a Ring-bound Man is +2.
lotr04122.lore: “Green gauntlets covered their hands, and their faces were hooded and masked with green, except for their eyes, which were very keen and bright.”

lotr04123.name: Hard Choice
lotr04123.game_text: Fellowship: Spot Aragorn to heal a companion who has the Aragorn signet twice.
lotr04123.lore: ”'Shall we rest by night, or shall we go on while our will and strength hold?'”

lotr04124.name: Help in Doubt and Need
lotr04124.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert an unbound [Gondor] Man to make a [Rohan] companion strength +2, or exert a [Rohan] companion to make an unbound [Gondor] Man strength +2.
lotr04124.lore: ”'The Heir of Elendil would be a strength indeed to the Sons of Eorl in this evil tide.'”

lotr04125.name: Henneth Annun
lotr04125.game_text: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 6T, each roaming minion skirmishing a Ring-bound companion is strength -2. Skirmish: Spot a [Gondor] Man and discard this condition to wound a roaming minion.
lotr04125.lore: ”'This is the Window of the Sunset….'”

lotr04126.name: Ithilien Trap
lotr04126.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a [Gondor] Man wins a skirmish, you may place a [Gondor] token here. Maneuver: Exert a minion for each [Gondor] token here (limit 3). Discard this condition.
lotr04126.lore: “He was glad he could not see the dead face.”

lotr04127.name: Mablung, Soldier of Gondor
lotr04127.subtitle: Soldier of Gondor
lotr04127.game_text: Ring-bound. Ranger. To play, spot a Ring-bound Man. Skirmish: Exert Mablung to exhaust a roaming minion he is skirmishing.
lotr04127.lore: ”'…we have a new errand on this journey….'”

lotr04128.name: New Errand
lotr04128.game_text: Skirmish: Spot a Ring-bound Man to make a minion's site number +2. If that minion loses this skirmish, you may wound a minion.
lotr04128.lore: ”'…we come to ambush the Men of Harad.'”

lotr04129.name: Pathfinder
lotr04129.game_text: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot a ranger to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).
lotr04129.lore: ”'If you take my counsel, you will not turn eastward yet. Go straight on, for thus you will have the cover of the woodland for many miles.'”

lotr04130.name: Ranger of Ithilien
lotr04130.game_text: Ring-bound. Ranger. When this companion is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. While skirmishing a roaming minion, this companion is strength +2.
lotr04130.lore: ”…they were goodly men, pale-skinned, dark of hair, with grey eyes and faces sad and proud.”

lotr04131.name: Ranger's Bow
lotr04131.game_text: Bearer must be Ring-bound Man. Skirmish: If bearer is skirmishing a Man or a roaming minion, exert bearer to wound that minion.
lotr04131.lore: “Two had great bows, almost of their own height, and great quivers of long green-feathered arrows.”

lotr04132.name: Ranger's Sword, Blade of Aragorn
lotr04132.subtitle: Blade of Aragorn
lotr04132.game_text: Bearer must be Aragorn. While skirmishing an Uruk-hai, Aragorn is strength +2.

lotr04133.name: Ruins of Osgiliath
lotr04133.game_text: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 7T, each Ring-bound Man is defender +1. Skirmish: Spot a Ringbound Man and discard this condition to wound an opponent's Man.
lotr04133.lore: The Citadel of the Stars had fallen into ruin.

lotr04134.name: Sword of Gondor
lotr04134.game_text: Bearer must be a [Gondor] Man. While skirmishing a Man or a roaming minion, bearer is damage +1.
lotr04134.lore: “Four tall Men stood there…. All had swords at their sides….”

lotr04135.name: War and Valor
lotr04135.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Gondor] Man strength +2 (or +3 and damage +1 if skirmishing a roaming minion).
lotr04135.lore: ”'So even was my brother, Boromir: a man of prowess, and for that he was accounted the best man in Gondor.'”

lotr04136.name: Advance Uruk Patrol
lotr04136.game_text: Damage +1. While at a battleground, this minion is fierce. While you control a battleground, this minion is strength +4.
lotr04136.lore: ”'This is no rabble of mindless Orcs.'”

lotr04137.name: Attack on Helm's Deep
lotr04137.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Play an Uruk-hai to place an [Isengard] token on this card. Regroup: Remove 3 [Isengard] tokens from this card and discard an Uruk-hai to take control of a site.

lotr04138.name: Band of Uruk Bowmen
lotr04138.game_text: Archer. Damage +1. While you control a site, the minion archery total is +1.
lotr04138.lore: Taking the high ground provides a better field of fire.

lotr04139.name: Banished
lotr04139.game_text: To play, exert Saruman or an [Isengard] Man. Plays on a Free Peoples Man. Each time another ally or companion loses a skirmish, bearer must exert.
lotr04139.lore: ”'Oh, but this is not from me - it comes from the King. He signed it this morning.'”

lotr04140.name: Beyond All Hope
lotr04140.game_text: Maneuver: Exert 2 Uruk-hai to add a burden for each card in the dead pile.
lotr04140.lore: ”'How shall any tower withstand such numbers and such reckless hate?'”

lotr04141.name: Beyond Dark Mountains
lotr04141.game_text: Response: If a companion or ally is killed, exert an [Isengard] minion to add a burden (or 2 burdens if Aragorn, Gandalf, or Theoden is killed).
lotr04141.lore: “Where now was the Ring-bearer? How thin indeed was the thread upon which doom still hung!”

lotr04142.name: Broad-bladed Sword
lotr04142.game_text: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Bearer may not take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
lotr04142.lore: “They were armed with short broad-bladed swords, not with the curved scimitars usual with Orcs….”

lotr04143.name: Brought Back Alive
lotr04143.game_text: Search. Assignment: Exert an [Isengard] tracker to assign it to an unbound companion. That companion may exert to prevent this (unless that companion is a Hobbit).
lotr04143.lore: ”'What are they wanted for?… Why alive? Do they give good sport?'”

lotr04144.name: Burning of Westfold
lotr04144.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: If you control a site, play an Uruk-hai to discard a Free Peoples condition.
lotr04144.lore: ”'We have found many of our folk lying slain as they fled….'”

lotr04145.name: Cloud of Arrows
lotr04145.game_text: Archery: Exert an [Isengard] archer to make the minion archery total +1 and the fellowship archery total -1.
lotr04145.lore: “Behind them orc-archers crowded, sending a hail of darts against the bowmen on the walls.”

lotr04146.name: Come Down
lotr04146.game_text: Plays to your support area. Archery: Spot 2 [Isengard] archers to make allies take wounds from archery fire instead of companions.
lotr04146.lore: ”'We are the fighting Uruk-hai…. Bring out your skulking king!'”

lotr04147.name: Covering Fire
lotr04147.game_text: To play, spot 2 [Isengard] archers. Plays to your support area. The Free Peoples player may not play archery events or use archery special abilities. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lotr04147.lore: Archers cowered on the walls, unable to reply.

lotr04148.name: Down to the Last Child
lotr04148.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving an Uruk-hai, place an [Isengard] token on this card. Shadow: Remove 2 [Isengard] tokens from this card to take control of a site.
lotr04148.lore: The Uruks brought death to the villages of Rohan.

lotr04149.name: Driven Back
lotr04149.game_text: Archery: Spot 2 [Isengard] archers to make the minion archery total +1 for each card in the dead pile.
lotr04149.lore: With each fallen defender, the morale of the attacking army rose.

lotr04150.name: Elite Crossbowmen
lotr04150.game_text: Archer. Damage +1. Archery: Exert Elite Crossbowmen to make the Free Peoples player wound an unbound companion; this minion does not add to the minion archery total.
lotr04150.lore: The best archers were held in reserve, awaiting the final assault.

lotr04151.name: Ferocity
lotr04151.game_text: Skirmish: Make an Uruk-hai strength +2 (or +3 if at a battleground).
lotr04151.lore: Uruk savagery remained despite their battle training.

lotr04152.name: Get Back
lotr04152.game_text: Assignment: Prevent an [Isengard] tracker from being assigned to a skirmish by any player.
lotr04152.lore: ”'We do not answer to Mordor scum!'”

lotr04153.name: Grima, Son of Galmod
lotr04153.subtitle: Son of Galmod
lotr04153.game_text: Each unbound companion (or ally) bearing a Shadow condition is strength -1.
lotr04153.lore: ”'Did I not counsel you, lord, to forbid his staff?'”

lotr04154.name: Grima, Wormtongue
lotr04154.subtitle: Wormtongue
lotr04154.game_text: Maneuver: Exert Grima and spot an unbound companion bearing 3 or more cards to return each Free Peoples card that companion bears to its owner's hand.
lotr04154.lore: ”'I care for you and yours as best I may. But do not weary yourself, or tax too heavily your strength.'”

lotr04155.name: Haunting Her Steps
lotr04155.game_text: Response: If a special ability of an ally or unbound companion is used, exert Grima to cancel that action.
lotr04155.lore: ”'What was the promised price? When all the men were dead, you were to pick your share of the treasure and take the woman you desire?'”

lotr04156.name: Kill Them Now
lotr04156.game_text: Skirmish: Make an [Isengard] tracker strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a character bearing a search card).
lotr04156.lore: ”'They're a cursed nuisance, and we're in a hurry.'”

lotr04157.name: Leechcraft
lotr04157.game_text: Spell. To play, exert Saruman or an [Isengard] Man. Plays on a Free Peoples Man. Special abilities in bearer's game text may not be used.
lotr04157.lore: ”'Your leechcraft ere long would have had me walking on all fours like a beast.'”

lotr04158.name: Lieutenant of Orthanc
lotr04158.game_text: Damage +1. Maneuver: Exert Lieutenant of Orthanc to make another Uruk-hai fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr04158.lore: ”'Do you wish to see the greatness of our army? We are the fighting Uruk-hai.'”

lotr04159.name: Many Riddles
lotr04159.game_text: Search. To play, exert an [Isengard] tracker. Plays on a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Assignment: Exert an [Isengard] tracker and remove (2) to assign that tracker to bearer. Bearer may exert to prevent this.
lotr04159.lore: ”'It will be hard news for Frodo….'”

lotr04160.name: Mauhur, Patrol Leader
lotr04160.subtitle: Patrol Leader
lotr04160.game_text: Tracker. Fierce. Skirmish: Remove (2) to prevent an [Isengard] tracker from taking wounds.
lotr04160.lore: ”forest, and they should turn up any time now.'”

lotr04161.name: Men Will Fall
lotr04161.game_text: Skirmish: Spot Saruman or an [Isengard] Man to make an unbound companion strength -2.
lotr04161.lore: ”'The Ring of Barahir. So, Gandalf Greyhame thinks he has found Isildur's heir, the Lost King of Gondor… Fool! That line was broken years ago.'”

lotr04162.name: New Power Rising
lotr04162.game_text: Regroup: Spot Saruman or an [Isengard] Man, reveal your hand, and discard all Free Peoples cards revealed to take an [Isengard] card into hand from your discard pile.
lotr04162.lore: ”'For those who aid the Great Eye there will be rich reward.'”

lotr04163.name: No Dawn for Men
lotr04163.game_text: Maneuver: Exert an Uruk-hai to exert X unbound companions, where X is the number of sites you control.
lotr04163.lore: ”'This night, the land will be stained with the blood of Rohan….'”

lotr04164.name: Orthanc Champion
lotr04164.game_text: Damage +1. Assignment: Exert Orthanc Champion to assign it to an unbound companion. That companion may exert to prevent this.
lotr04164.lore: A warrior trained in single combat, he tore a swath through the defenders.

lotr04165.name: Orthanc Warrior
lotr04165.lore: The Uruk-hai bred by Saruman are stronger and more fell than Orcs of Mordor.

lotr04166.name: The Palantir of Orthanc, Seventh Seeing-stone
lotr04166.subtitle: Seventh Seeing-stone
lotr04166.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set4/lotr04166/The Palantir of Orthanc, Seventh Seeing-stone (4R166).jpg

lotr04167.name: Pillage of Rohan
lotr04167.game_text: Plays on a site you control. While an Uruk-hai is stacked on this site, the Free Peoples player may not play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities.
lotr04167.lore: Rumor of plunder swelled the ranks of the Isengarders.

lotr04168.name: Race Across the Mark
lotr04168.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Spot a site you control and remove (2) to cancel a skirmish involving an Uruk-hai.
lotr04168.lore: ”'But in the meantime, the Uruk-hai of Isengard can do the dirty work as usual.'”

lotr04169.name: Ranged Commander
lotr04169.game_text: Archer. The twilight cost of each [Isengard] archer is -1. Archery: Exert Ranged Commander to make the Free Peoples player wound an unbound companion; this minion does not add to the minion archery total.

lotr04170.name: Ranks Without Number
lotr04170.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns an ally to a skirmish, you may play an [Isengard] minion from your discard pile. That minion's twilight cost is -2.

lotr04171.name: Rest While You Can
lotr04171.game_text: Search. To play, spot an [Isengard] tracker. Plays on a companion. Limit 1 per companion. If bearer is killed, reveal the top 10 cards of opponent's draw deck and discard 1 Shadow card and 1 Free Peoples card. Your opponent reshuffles that deck.

lotr04172.name: Rohan Is Mine
lotr04172.game_text: To play, spot Saruman or an [Isengard] Man. Plays on a Free Peoples Man. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns bearer to a skirmish, exert each ally.
lotr04172.lore: ”'You have no power here, Gandalf the Grey.'”

lotr04173.name: Saruman, Black Traitor
lotr04173.subtitle: Black Traitor
lotr04173.game_text: Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. When you play Saruman, you may discard a condition. Shadow: Exert Saruman to play Saruman's Staff from your discard pile.

lotr04175.name: Still They Came
lotr04175.game_text: Skirmish: Exert an Uruk-hai who is not assigned to a skirmish to make another Uruk-hai strength +3.
lotr04175.lore: “Before the wall's foot the dead and broken were piled like shingle in a storm; ever higher rose the hideous mounds….”

lotr04176.name: Ugluk, Servant of Saruman
lotr04176.subtitle: Servant of Saruman
lotr04176.game_text: Tracker. Fierce. The roaming penalty for each [Isengard] tracker you play is -2. While you can spot 2 [Isengard] trackers, Ugluk is strength +3. While you can spot 3 [Isengard] trackers, Ugluk is damage +1.

lotr04177.name: Ugluk's Sword
lotr04177.game_text: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Shadow: If bearer is Ugluk, exert it and discard a minion from hand to play a minion. Its twilight cost is -3.

lotr04178.name: Unferth, Grima's Bodyguard
lotr04178.subtitle: Grima's Bodyguard
lotr04178.game_text: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns a companion or ally to an [Isengard] Man, that companion or ally must exert.

lotr04179.name: Uruk Assault Band
lotr04179.game_text: Damage +1. To play, spot an Uruk-hai. While at a battleground, this minion is fierce. While you control a battleground, this minion is strength +6. While you control 2 battlegrounds, this minion may not take wounds.

lotr04180.name: Uruk Besieger
lotr04180.game_text: Damage +1. Regroup: Stack this minion on a site you control. Shadow: If stacked on a site you control, play this minion. Its twilight cost is -1.
lotr04180.lore: Fresh troops awaited to attack any weakness.

lotr04181.name: Uruk Chaser
lotr04181.game_text: Tracker. Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +2.
lotr04181.lore: ”'Now we'll have to leg it double quick.'”

lotr04182.name: Uruk Crossbow Troop
lotr04182.game_text: Archer. When you play this minion, you may place an [Isengard] token on a machine.
lotr04182.lore: Bolts from the Uruk crossbows shattered the shields of the defenders.

lotr04183.name: Uruk Crossbowman
lotr04183.game_text: Archer. Archery: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound an unbound companion; this minion does not add to the minion archery total.
lotr04183.lore: Both the weapon and its wielder were foul creations of Saruman.

lotr04184.name: Uruk Defender
lotr04184.game_text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert this minion at a battleground to make another Uruk-hai strength +2.
lotr04184.lore: Saruman's Uruk army trained in formation tactics.

lotr04185.name: Uruk Fanatic
lotr04185.game_text: Damage +1. If there are at least 3 cards in the dead pile, this minion is fierce.
lotr04185.lore: Despite intensive training, the smell of blood still enraged the Uruk warriors.

lotr04186.name: Uruk Follower
lotr04186.game_text: Tracker. Fierce. Unbound Hobbits may not be discarded. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is killed, exert this minion to add a burden.

lotr04187.name: Uruk Foot Soldier
lotr04187.game_text: Tracker. Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +3 and damage +1.
lotr04187.lore: ”'Evening's coming on, and we ought to get a move on.'”

lotr04188.name: Uruk Hunter
lotr04188.game_text: Tracker. Fierce. Unbound Hobbits may not be discarded. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is killed, exert this minion twice to exhaust a companion.
lotr04188.lore: ”'We came out of Isengard, and led you here, and we shall lead you back the way we choose.'”

lotr04189.name: Uruk Plains Runner
lotr04189.game_text: Tracker. Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +3 and damage +1.
lotr04189.lore: ”'Run! Or you'll never see your beloved holes again!'”

lotr04190.name: Uruk Pursuer
lotr04190.game_text: Tracker. Fierce. Unbound Hobbits may not be discarded. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is killed, exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound an unbound companion.

lotr04191.name: Uruk Rear Guard
lotr04191.game_text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert this minion at a battleground to make another Uruk-hai strength +1.
lotr04191.lore: Promised a fair share of plunder, they defended against possible reinforcements.

lotr04192.name: Uruk Regular
lotr04192.game_text: Damage +1. Shadow: Exert this minion to play an Uruk-hai; its twilight cost is -1 for each other Uruk-hai you can spot.
lotr04192.lore: ”'We are the Uruk-hai; we do not stop the fight for night or day, for fair weather or for storm.'”

lotr04193.name: Uruk Runner
lotr04193.game_text: Tracker. Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +2.
lotr04193.lore: ”'Run, curse you! Run while night lasts!'”

lotr04194.name: Uruk Searcher
lotr04194.game_text: Tracker. Fierce. While skirmishing a character bearing a search card, this minion is strength +2 and damage +1.
lotr04194.lore: ”'Why don't we search them and find out?'”

lotr04195.name: Uruk Seeker
lotr04195.game_text: Tracker. Fierce. While skirmishing a character bearing a search card, this minion is strength +2 and damage +1.
lotr04195.lore: ”'No crying out, no trying to escape.'”

lotr04196.name: Uruk Spear
lotr04196.game_text: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Maneuver: Exert bearer to discard a Free Peoples mount.
lotr04196.lore: The Uruk-hai braced their long pikes to challenge the oncoming Riders.

lotr04197.name: Uruk Stalker
lotr04197.game_text: Damage +1. While an ally is in the dead pile, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.
lotr04197.lore: “A moment they hesitated, and then on they came.”

lotr04198.name: Uruk Stormer
lotr04198.game_text: Damage +1. Each time a companion or ally is killed during a skirmish involving an Uruk-hai, you may take control of a site.
lotr04198.lore: “They wavered, broke, and fled back; and then charged again, broke and charged again; and each time, like the incoming sea, they halted at a higher point.”

lotr04199.name: Uruk Trooper
