lotr04199.game_text: Damage +1. Regroup: Stack this minion on a site you control. Shadow: If stacked on a site you control, play this minion. Its twilight cost is -1.
lotr04199.lore: Thousands of Uruk-hai came to take the Hornburg.

lotr04200.name: Uruk Vanguard
lotr04200.game_text: Damage +1 (or damage +2 if at a battleground). To play, spot an Uruk-hai. While at a battleground, this minion is fierce.
lotr04200.lore: ”'These are Uruk-hai - their armour is thick, their shields broad.'”

lotr04201.name: Uruk Veteran
lotr04201.game_text: Damage +1. Regroup: Stack this minion on a site you control. Shadow: If stacked on a site you control, play this minion. Its twilight cost is -1.
lotr04201.lore: ”'We come to kill, by sun or moon.'”

lotr04202.name: Uruk-hai Band
lotr04202.game_text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +2 for each site you control.
lotr04202.lore: “There were four… of greater stature, swart, slant-eyed, with thick legs and broad hands.”

lotr04203.name: Uruk-hai Horde
lotr04203.game_text: Damage +1. The twilight cost of this minion is -1 for each site you control.
lotr04203.lore: “The rumour of war grew behind them.”

lotr04204.name: Uruk-hai Marauder
lotr04204.game_text: Damage +1. The twilight cost of this minion is -1 for each site you control.

lotr04205.name: Uruk-hai Mob
lotr04205.game_text: Damage +1. The twilight cost of this minion is -1 for each site you control.
lotr04205.lore: ”'Let the fighting Uruk-hai do the work, as usual.'”

lotr04206.name: Uruk-hai Patrol
lotr04206.game_text: Damage +1(or damage +2 while you control a site).
lotr04206.lore: ”'We are the servants of Saruman the Wise….'”

lotr04207.name: Uruk-hai Raiding Party
lotr04207.lore: Bands of Uruks crossed the plains of Rohan.

lotr04208.name: Vengeance
lotr04208.game_text: Skirmish: Make an [Isengard] tracker strength +2 for each card borne by the character it is skirmishing.
lotr04208.lore: Saruman instilled a spirit for revenge in his fighting brood.

lotr04209.name: Volley Fire
lotr04209.game_text: Archery: Discard 2 [Isengard] archers to exhaust an unbound companion.
lotr04209.lore: Defenders on the walls made perfect targets for the Isengard crossbowmen.

lotr04210.name: We Are the Fighting Uruk-hai
lotr04210.game_text: Skirmish: Make an Uruk-hai strength +2 (and damage +1 if you control a site).
lotr04210.lore: ”'But for us you'd all have run away.'”

lotr04211.name: Weapons of Isengard
lotr04211.game_text: Machine. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Play an [Isengard] archer to place an [Isengard] token on this card. Archery: Remove 2 [Isengard] tokens from this card to make the minion archery total +2. Discard this condition.
lotr04211.lore: Crossbowmen arrived with munitions from Isengard.

lotr04212.name: Weary
lotr04212.game_text: Search. Plays on a companion or ally. Limit 1 per character. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns bearer to skirmish an [Isengard] tracker, bearer must exert.

lotr04213.name: What Did You Discover?
lotr04213.game_text: Search. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may discard 2 cards from hand to take an [Isengard] tracker from your discard pile into hand.
lotr04213.lore: ”'The scouts have come back at last.'”

lotr04214.name: Where Has Grima Stowed It?
lotr04214.game_text: Maneuver: Spot Grima to discard a possession borne by an ally or unbound companion.
lotr04214.lore: ”'Loth was he to render up the keys. Many other things are there which men have missed.'”

lotr04215.name: Wounded
lotr04215.game_text: To play, exert an [Isengard] Man. Plays on a Free Peoples Man. When you play this condition, exert bearer. Wounds may not be removed from bearer.

lotr04216.name: Arrow From the South
lotr04216.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving a [Raider] Man, you may place a [Raider] token here. Archery: Heal a [Raider] archer for each [Raider] token here. Discard this condition.
lotr04216.lore: Haradrim is the Gondorian name for Southrons.

lotr04217.name: Desert Lancers
lotr04217.game_text: Southron. To play, spot a [Raider] Man. Regroup: Exert Desert Lancers twice to take control of a site.
lotr04217.lore: ”'Mordor has allied itself with… the cruel Haradrim….'”

lotr04218.name: Desert Legion
lotr04218.game_text: Southron. Ambush (1). While you can spot 4 burdens, this minion is strength +5. While you can spot 5 burdens, this minion is fierce. While you can spot 6 burdens, this minion is damage +1.

lotr04219.name: Desert Lord
lotr04219.game_text: Southron. Archer. Archery: Exert Desert Lord to exert a companion (except the Ring-bearer); Desert Lord does not add to the minion archery total.
lotr04219.lore: Southron legends tell of powerful warrior leaders and the kingdoms they have conquered.

lotr04220.name: Desert Soldier
lotr04220.game_text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove (3) to wound a companion or ally he is skirmishing.
lotr04220.lore: ”'Not nice; very cruel wicked Men they look.'”

lotr04221.name: Desert Spearman
lotr04221.game_text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove (3) to wound a companion or ally he is skirmishing.
lotr04221.lore: Long spears are used by Southrons to attack while riding desert beasts.

lotr04222.name: Desert Warrior
lotr04222.game_text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove (3) to wound a companion or ally he is skirmishing.
lotr04222.lore: The Haradrim wear cloaks and head wraps to survive the deserts of their homeland.

lotr04223.name: Discovered
lotr04223.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a [Raider] Man to discard a Free Peoples condition (or 2 Free Peoples conditions if you spot 3 burdens).
lotr04223.lore: “The voices and the clink of weapons and harness were very close.”

lotr04224.name: Easterling Axeman
lotr04224.game_text: Easterling. While you can spot 2 burdens, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.
lotr04224.lore: Poleaxes wielded by tall Easterling warriors cut through armor and bone.

lotr04225.name: Easterling Captain
lotr04225.game_text: Easterling. Fierce. Skirmish: Spot 2 burdens and remove (2) to make an Easterling strength +2. Skirmish: Spot 4 burdens and remove (2) to make an Easterling strength +3. Skirmish: Spot 6 burdens and remove (2) to make an Easterling strength +4.

lotr04226.name: Easterling Guard
lotr04226.game_text: Easterling. Each time this minion is assigned to an unbound companion, you may exert him to add a burden.
lotr04226.lore: Armored Easterlings protect their commanders from enemy assaults.

lotr04227.name: Easterling Infantry
lotr04227.game_text: Easterling. While you can spot 3 burdens, this minion is fierce and damage +1.

lotr04228.name: Easterling Lieutenant
lotr04228.game_text: Easterling. Each time this minion is assigned to an unbound companion, you may exert him to add a burden.
lotr04228.lore: ”'Easterlings… have passed through the Black Gate….'”

lotr04229.name: Easterling Skirmisher
lotr04229.game_text: Easterling. When you play this minion, you may spot another Easterling to add (1) for each burden (limit (4)).
lotr04229.lore: Enemy formations are threatened by the spears of Easterling light troops.

lotr04230.name: Easterling Trooper
lotr04230.game_text: Easterling. While you can spot 3 burdens, this minion is fierce and damage +1.
lotr04230.lore: Trained Easterling fighters formed ranks of axes and spears to charge the knights of Gondor.

lotr04231.name: Eastern Emyn Muil
lotr04231.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each Ring-bound companion moving from site 2T must exert twice. Maneuver: Discard this condition and exert a [Raider] Man to exert a Ringbound companion.
lotr04231.lore: The Emyn Muil was a strange, twisted knot of hills.

lotr04232.name: Elite Archer
lotr04232.game_text: Southron. Archer. Archery: Exert this minion to exert a companion (except the Ring-bearer); this minion does not add to the minion archery total.
lotr04232.lore: Veteran bowmen are highly valued in the kingdoms of the South.

lotr04233.name: Fearless
lotr04233.game_text: Skirmish: Make a Southron strength +1 for each burden you spot (limit +5), or make a [Raider] Man strength +2.
lotr04233.lore: Despite their foreign ways, the Men from the South and East were formidable fighters.

lotr04234.name: Flanking Attack
lotr04234.game_text: Maneuver or Skirmish: Exert a Southron to add (3).
lotr04234.lore: ”'Our scouts report more Haradrim making their way up here….'”

lotr04235.name: Gathering to the Summons
lotr04235.game_text: Skirmish: Spot a [Raider] Man skirmishing a Ring-bound companion to add a burden.
lotr04235.lore: “These were Men of other race, out of the wide Eastlands….”

lotr04236.name: Howl of Harad
lotr04236.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving a Southron, you may remove (4) to make the Free Peoples Player wound a Ring-bound companion.
lotr04236.lore: Blood-curdling cries rout the Southrons' enemies from the battlefield.

lotr04237.name: Ithilien Wilderness
lotr04237.game_text: Plays to your support area. At the end of each phase during which the fellowship moved to site 7T, 8T, or 9T and the twilight pool has fewer than 7 twilight tokens, you may add (8). Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [Raider] Man strength +2.

lotr04238.name: Men of Harad
lotr04238.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Spot a site you control, spot 3 Southrons, and remove (2) to draw a card.
lotr04238.lore: The savage Haradrim, men from the kingdoms south of Gondor and Mordor, were called Southrons.

lotr04239.name: Men of Rhun
lotr04239.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Raider] Man strength +3 (or +4 if you spot 4 burdens).

lotr04240.name: New Fear
lotr04240.game_text: Regroup: Exert a [Raider] Man to add a burden for each companion over 4. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 companions (except the Ring-bearer) to prevent this.
lotr04240.lore: “They heard singing and coarse shouting. At first it seemed a long way off, but it drew nearer….”

lotr04241.name: On the March
lotr04241.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Raider] Man strength +3 (or +5 if you spot 6 companions).
lotr04241.lore: Easterlings traveled up the ancient roads of Gondor to swell the hosts of the Dark Tower.

lotr04242.name: Raiders From the East
lotr04242.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) and exert a [Raider] Man to place a [Raider] token here. Maneuver: Remove a [Raider] token here to add (1).
lotr04242.lore: The Easterlings raid their enemies to gather supplies and equipment.

lotr04243.name: Rapid Fire
lotr04243.game_text: Archery: Exert a [Raider] archer to make the minion archery total +1 for each burden (limit +5).
lotr04243.lore: Wars between the southern kingdoms taught speed and precision to the archers of the Haradrim.

lotr04244.name: Regiment of Haradrim
lotr04244.game_text: Southron. To play, spot a [Raider] Man. Regroup: Exert Regiment of Haradrim twice to take control of a site.
lotr04244.lore: ”'One of their regiments is due by our reckoning to pass by, some time ere noon….'”

lotr04245.name: Southron Archer
lotr04245.game_text: Southron. Archer. While you can spot another Southron, the minion archery total is +1 for each site you control.
lotr04245.lore: ”'They have passed on to the Black Gate; but more may follow.'”

lotr04246.name: Southron Assassin
lotr04246.game_text: Southron. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving a Southron, you may remove (1) to make the Free Peoples player wound a Ring-bound companion.
lotr04246.lore: ”'Some of the Southrons have broken from the trap and are flying from the road.'”

lotr04247.name: Southron Bow
lotr04247.game_text: Bearer must be a [Raider] Man. Bearer is an archer. While you can spot another [Raider] Man, the minion archery total is +1.
lotr04247.lore: Volleys from Southron bows are deadly in large numbers.

lotr04248.name: Southron Bowman
lotr04248.game_text: Southron. Archer. Archery: Exert this minion to exert a companion (except the Ring-bearer); this minion does not add to the minion archery total.
lotr04248.lore: The Southron armies deploy archers to harass enemy troop formations.

lotr04249.name: Southron Commander
lotr04249.game_text: Southron. Ambush (1). Assignment: Spot 6 companions to assign this minion to the Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may discard an unbound companion to prevent this.
lotr04249.lore: ”'Almost as bad as Orcs, and much bigger.'”

lotr04250.name: Southron Explorer
lotr04250.game_text: Southron. Regroup: Exert this minion and remove (5) to take control of a site.
lotr04250.lore: Scouts find oases for Southron armies as they cross the deserts of Harad.

lotr04251.name: Southron Fighter
lotr04251.game_text: Southron. Ambush (1). Maneuver: Exert this minion and spot 5 companions to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion.
lotr04251.lore: ”'…they have come out of the South beyond the Great River's end….'”

lotr04252.name: Southron Scout
lotr04252.lore: ”'They have black eyes, and long black hair, and gold rings in their ears….'”

lotr04253.name: Southron Sentry
lotr04253.game_text: Southron. Maneuver: Exert this minion to add (2) for each site you control.
lotr04253.lore: Pickets guarded the borders of the Southron encampment.

lotr04254.name: Southron Soldier
lotr04254.lore: The kingdoms of Harad fight countless wars and train thousands of warriors.

lotr04255.name: Southron Spear
lotr04255.game_text: Bearer must be a Southron. Skirmish: Remove (4) and exert bearer to wound a companion or ally bearer is skirmishing.
lotr04255.lore: Long pikes defend the Southrons against the armored knights of Gondor.

lotr04256.name: Southron Troop
lotr04256.game_text: Southron. Archer. Ambush (1). To play, spot a Southron. Assignment: Spot 7 companions to assign this minion to the Ringbearer. The Free Peoples player may make you discard a companion (except the Ring-bearer) to prevent this.

lotr04257.name: Southron Veterans
lotr04257.game_text: Southron. Ambush (1). Maneuver: Exert this minion and spot 6 companions to make the Free Peoples player exert 2 companions.
lotr04257.lore: “He caught a glimpse of swarthy men… running down the slope some way off….”

lotr04258.name: Southron Wanderer
lotr04258.game_text: Southron. Ambush (1). Assignment: Exert this minion and spot 5 companions to assign this minion to the Ringbearer. The Free Peoples player may add (4) to prevent this.
lotr04258.lore: Some desert warriors have no allegiance and work for any faction that will pay them.

lotr04259.name: Vision From Afar
lotr04259.game_text: Assignment: Assign an Easterling to the Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to prevent this.
lotr04259.lore: “Then he knew that the hope that had for one wild moment stirred in his heart was vain.”

lotr04260.name: Whirling Strike
lotr04260.game_text: Skirmish: Wound a companion or ally skirmishing a [Raider] Man.
lotr04260.lore: The Southrons fight with tactics the men of Gondor have never before seen.

lotr04261.name: Wrath of Harad
lotr04261.game_text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot a [Raider] Man, each Free Peoples event that spots or exerts a ranger gains this cost: 'wound a companion.' Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [Raider] Man strength +2.
lotr04261.lore: Massed Southron troops prepared to attack Gondor.

lotr04262.name: Aldor, Soldier of Edoras
lotr04262.subtitle: Soldier of Edoras
lotr04262.game_text: Archery: Exert Aldor and spot a villager to make the fellowship archery total +1.
lotr04262.lore: Fighting to defend his people, Aldor found courage to replace his youth.

lotr04263.name: Brego
lotr04263.game_text: To play, spot a [Rohan] Man. Bearer must be a Man, Elf, or Wizard. When you play Brego, you may heal bearer. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
lotr04263.lore: Brego was named for the second King of Rohan.

lotr04264.name: Ceorl, Weary Horseman
lotr04264.subtitle: Weary Horseman
lotr04264.game_text: Response: If your opponent is about to take control of a site, exert Ceorl and a villager to prevent this.
lotr04264.lore: ”'We were driven back yesterday over the Isen with great loss; many perished at the crossing.'”

lotr04265.name: Elite Rider
lotr04265.game_text: When this companion is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. While skirmishing a wounded minion, this companion is strength +2.
lotr04265.lore: “After him they rode: a long line of mailclad men, swift, shining, fell and fair to look upon.”

lotr04266.name: Eomer, Sister-son of Theoden
lotr04266.subtitle: Sister-son of Theoden
lotr04266.game_text: While you can spot a [Rohan] Man, Eomer's twilight cost is -1. At the start of each turn, you may heal a [Rohan] ally.
lotr04266.lore: ”'Now indeed there is hope of victory!'”

lotr04267.name: Eomer, Third Marshal of Riddermark
lotr04267.subtitle: Third Marshal of Riddermark
lotr04267.game_text: While you can spot a [Rohan] Man, Eomer's twilight cost is -1. Eomer is strength +2 for each wound on each minion he is skirmishing.
lotr04267.lore: “Then one rode forward, a tall man, taller than the rest; from his helm as a crest a white horsetail flowed.”

lotr04268.name: Eomer's Spear
lotr04268.game_text: Bearer must be a [Rohan] Man. If bearer is Eomer and he is mounted, Eomer is damage +2.
lotr04268.lore: “He advanced until the point of his spear was within a foot of Aragorn's breast.”

lotr04269.name: Eothain, Scout of the Mark
lotr04269.subtitle: Scout of the Mark
lotr04269.game_text: Each time the fellowship moves to a plains site, each minion must exert.
lotr04269.lore: ”'Time is pressing…. We must hasten south, lord.'”

lotr04270.name: Eowyn, Lady of Rohan
lotr04270.subtitle: Lady of Rohan
lotr04270.game_text: Valiant. Response: If an unbound companion is about to take a wound, exert Eowyn and add (1) to prevent that wound.
lotr04270.lore: “Thus Aragorn…… and thought her fair, fair and cold, like a morning of pale spring that is not yet come to womanhood.”

lotr04271.name: Eowyn, Sister-daughter of Theoden
lotr04271.subtitle: Sister-daughter of Theoden
lotr04271.game_text: Valiant. Response: If Eowyn is exhausted and about to take a wound in a skirmish, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent that wound.
lotr04271.lore: “Slender and tall she was… but strong she seemed and stern as steel, a daughter of kings.”

lotr04272.name: Eowyn's Sword
lotr04272.game_text: Bearer must be Eowyn. While you can spot a villager, Eowyn is damage +1.
lotr04272.lore: ”…the sword was set upright before her, and her hands were laid upon the hilt.”

lotr04273.name: Fight for the Villagers
lotr04273.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Rohan] Man strength +2 (or +3 if you spot a villager).
lotr04273.lore: ”'Bar the gates, set a watch on the surrounds, and get the women and children to the caves.'”

lotr04274.name: Firefoot
lotr04274.game_text: Bearer must be a [Rohan] Man. If bearer is Eomer, he is defender +1. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.

lotr04275.name: Forth Eorlingas!
lotr04275.game_text: Maneuver: Exert Theoden to make a companion who has the Theoden signet defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr04275.lore: “Behind them from the Deep came the stern cries of men issuing from the caves, driving forth the enemy.'”

lotr04276.name: Fortress Never Fallen
lotr04276.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a [Rohan] Man wins a skirmish, you may place a [Rohan] token on this card. Regroup: Discard a Shadow condition for each [Rohan] token here. Discard this condition.
lotr04276.lore: ”'…it was the spirit of your people that held it strong.'”

lotr04277.name: Guma, Plains Farmer
lotr04277.subtitle: Plains Farmer
lotr04277.game_text: Villager. Discard Guma if an opponent controls his home site. Fellowship: Exert Guma to heal a [Rohan] Man.
lotr04277.lore: Foodstores swelled as refugees like Guma brought provisions to the Hornburg.

lotr04278.name: Heavy Chain
lotr04278.game_text: Bearer must be a Man. Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
lotr04278.lore: What Man of an earlier age wore this chain? Was his end worth a song?

lotr04279.name: Helm! Helm!
lotr04279.game_text: Regroup: Spot 2 mounted [Rohan] Men to liberate a site or draw 3 cards.
lotr04279.lore: “And with that shout the king came. His horse was white as snow, golden was his shield, and his spear was long.”

lotr04280.name: Herugrim
lotr04280.game_text: Bearer must be Theoden. He is damage +1.
lotr04280.lore: ”'Here, lord, is Herugrim, your ancient blade….'”

lotr04281.name: Hlafwine, Village Farmhand
lotr04281.subtitle: Village Farmhand
lotr04281.game_text: Villager. Discard Hlafwine if an opponent controls his home site. Skirmish: Exert Hlafwine to make a [Rohan] Man strength +2.
lotr04281.lore: Too old to fight, Hlafwine prepared meals for the defenders.

lotr04282.name: An Honorable Charge
lotr04282.game_text: Skirmish: Make an unbound companion strength +1 for each [Rohan] Man you spot (limit +3).
lotr04282.lore: ”'A time may come when there will be a need for valour without renown….'”

lotr04283.name: Horse of Rohan
lotr04283.game_text: To play, spot a [Rohan] Man. Bearer must be a Man, Elf, or Wizard. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
lotr04283.lore: “Very swift were the horses of Rohan.”

lotr04284.name: King's Mail
lotr04284.game_text: Bearer must be a [Rohan] Man. Bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase. If bearer is Theoden, he may not take wounds except during a skirmish involving him.
lotr04284.lore: “Now men came bearing raiment of war from the king's hoard….”

lotr04285.name: Leod, Westfold Herdsman
lotr04285.subtitle: Westfold Herdsman
lotr04285.game_text: Villager. Discard Leod if an opponent controls his home site. Skirmish: Exert Leod to make a mounted companion strength +2.

lotr04286.name: Rider of Rohan
lotr04286.game_text: Skirmish: If this companion is mounted, exert him to exert a minion skirmishing an unbound companion.
lotr04286.lore: ”'They are proud and wilful, but they are true-hearted, generous in thought and deed….'”

lotr04287.name: Rider's Mount
lotr04287.game_text: Bearer must be a [Rohan] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
lotr04287.lore: “Their horses were of great stature, strong and clean-limbed; their grey coats glistened, their long tails flowed in the wind….”

lotr04288.name: Rider's Spear
lotr04288.game_text: Bearer must be a [Rohan] Man. If bearer is mounted, bearer is damage +1.
lotr04288.lore: “Shafts of the sun flared above the eastern hills and glimmered on their spears.”

lotr04289.name: Simbelmyne
lotr04289.game_text: Fellowship: Spot 2 [Rohan] Men (or 1 valiant [Rohan] Man) to play a [Rohan] character or [Rohan] possession from your draw deck.
lotr04289.lore: ”'How fair are the bright eyes in the grass! Evermind they are called… for they blossom in all seasons of the year, and grow where dead men rest.'”

lotr04290.name: Supplies of the Mark
lotr04290.game_text: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Add (2) and place a villager from hand beneath your draw deck to heal a [Rohan] ally.
lotr04290.lore: ”'This is all we could save, my Lady.'”

lotr04291.name: Sword of Rohan
lotr04291.game_text: Bearer must be a [Rohan] Man. While bearer is skirmishing an Uruk-hai, bearer is damage +1.
lotr04291.lore: ”'This is a good sword, Haleth… there is always hope.'”

lotr04292.name: Theoden, Son of Thengel
lotr04292.subtitle: Son of Thengel
lotr04292.game_text: Regroup: Spot a [Rohan] ally and exert Theoden to liberate a site.
lotr04292.lore: ”'I myself will go to war, to fall in the front of the battle, if it must be.'”

lotr04293.name: Valleys of the Mark
lotr04293.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time your opponent plays a roaming minion, you may spot a villager to exert that minion.
lotr04293.lore: ”'Where is the hand on the harpstring, and the red fire glowing? / Where is the spring and the harvest and the tall corn growing?'”

lotr04294.name: Weapon Store
lotr04294.game_text: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Exert a [Rohan] Man to play a hand weapon from your discard pile.
lotr04294.lore: ”'And to you my other guests I will offer such things as may be found in my armoury.'”

lotr04295.name: Weland, Smith of the Riddermark
lotr04295.subtitle: Smith of the Riddermark
lotr04295.game_text: Villager. Discard Weland if an opponent controls his home site. Fellowship: Exert Weland to heal a mounted companion.
lotr04295.lore: A tender of horses, Weland found much work at Helm's Deep.

lotr04296.name: Well Stored
lotr04296.game_text: Plays to your support area. At the start of each fellowship phase, you may heal a villager.
lotr04296.lore: ”'Behind us in the caves of the Deep are… old and young, children and women. But great store of food, and many beasts and their fodder, have also been gathered there.'”

lotr04297.name: Work for the Sword
lotr04297.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Rohan] Man strength +2 (and damage +2 if mounted).
lotr04297.lore: ”'The Orcs are destroyed. We slaughtered them during the night.'”

lotr04298.name: Brace of Coneys
lotr04298.game_text: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard this possession to remove a burden.
lotr04298.lore: ”'He let them stew for close on an hour, testing them now and again with his fork, and tasting the broth.'”

lotr04299.name: Cliffs of Emyn Muil
lotr04299.game_text: Plays to your support area. When the fellowship moves from site 1T, remove up to 2 burdens. Skirmish: Discard this condition to wound a minion a Hobbit companion is skirmishing.

lotr04300.name: Escape
lotr04300.game_text: Stealth. Bearer must be an unbound Hobbit. Limit 1 per character. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to cancel a skirmish involving him. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.
lotr04300.lore: “Suddenly Merry and Pippin realized that without moving they were now outside the circle….”

lotr04301.name: Frodo, Courteous Halfling
lotr04301.subtitle: Courteous Halfling
lotr04301.game_text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). While you can spot 3 unbound companions, Shadow cards may not discard cards from your hand or from the top of your draw deck.
lotr04301.lore: ”'But as for us, we are Hobbits of the Shire, far to the North and West, beyond many rivers.'”

lotr04302.name: Frodo, Tired Traveller
lotr04302.subtitle: Tired Traveller
lotr04302.game_text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Fellowship: Play a Ring-bound companion to remove a burden.
lotr04302.lore: ”'We have come by long ways - out of Rivendell, or Imladris as some call it.'”

lotr04303.name: Frodo's Cloak
lotr04303.game_text: Bearer must be Frodo. Skirmish: At sites 1T to 4T, add a burden and discard this possession to cancel a skirmish involving Frodo. At any other site, discard this possession to remove a burden and heal Frodo.
lotr04303.lore: Neither weather nor searching eyes found Frodo.

lotr04304.name: Get On and Get Away
lotr04304.game_text: Fellowship: Add 2 burdens to play the fellowship's next 2 sites (replacing opponent's sites if necessary).
lotr04304.lore: ”'The Dead can't be really there! Is it some devilry hatched in the Dark Land?'”

lotr04305.name: Good Work
lotr04305.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a Hobbit wins a skirmish, you may place a [Shire] token here. Fellowship: Remove a burden for each [Shire] token here (limit 3). Discard this condition.
lotr04305.lore: ”'You seem to have been doing well, Master Took.'”

lotr04306.name: Hobbit Sword
lotr04306.lore: Although the Ranger had never before seen a Hobbit, he recognized the swords they carried.

lotr04307.name: Impatient and Angry
lotr04307.game_text: Skirmish: Exert Sam to make him strength +3. If Sam wins this skirmish, you may remove a burden.
lotr04307.lore: “He planted himself… as if he was addressing a young hobbit who had offered him what he called 'sauce' when questioned about visits to the orchard.”

lotr04308.name: Knocked on the Head
lotr04308.game_text: Regroup: Play an unbound Hobbit from your discard pile.
lotr04308.lore: ”'I wonder if poor Merry is much hurt.'”

lotr04309.name: Light Shining Faintly
lotr04309.game_text: Fellowship: Add a burden to heal a Ring-bound companion twice.
lotr04309.lore: ”'He's like that, and sometimes it shines through, somehow.'”

lotr04310.name: Merry, Learned Guide
lotr04310.subtitle: Learned Guide
lotr04310.game_text: Skirmish: Exert the Ring-bearer to discard Merry. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.
lotr04310.lore: ”'I don't suppose you have much notion where we are; but I spent my time at Rivendell rather better.'”

lotr04311.name: Merry, Unquenchable Hobbit
lotr04311.subtitle: Unquenchable Hobbit
lotr04311.game_text: Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, discard him to remove a [Sauron] Orc from a skirmish involving an unbound companion.
lotr04311.lore: ”'All Wizards should have a hobbit or two in their care - to teach them the meaning of the word, and to correct them.'”

lotr04312.name: Mind Your Own Affairs
lotr04312.game_text: Skirmish: Spot Frodo and add a burden to wound a minion skirmishing a companion who has the Frodo signet.
lotr04312.lore: ”'Yet those who claim to oppose the Enemy would do well not to hinder it.'”

lotr04313.name: Pippin, Just a Nuisance
lotr04313.subtitle: Just a Nuisance
lotr04313.game_text: Skirmish: If Pippin is not assigned to a skirmish, discard him to remove an Uruk-hai from a skirmish involving an unbound companion.
lotr04313.lore: ”'What good have I been?… a passenger, a piece of luggage.'”

lotr04314.name: Pippin, Woolly-footed Rascal
lotr04314.subtitle: Woolly-footed Rascal
lotr04314.game_text: Skirmish: Add a burden to discard Pippin. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.
lotr04314.lore: ”'We had foul fare with the Orcs, and little enough for days before that. It seems a long while since we could eat to heart's content.'”

lotr04315.name: Sam, Frodo's Gardener
lotr04315.subtitle: Frodo's Gardener
lotr04315.game_text: Ring-bound. Fellowship: Play Sam's Pack from your draw deck. Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lotr04315.lore: ”'I am only a hobbit, and gardening's my job at home, sir, if you understand me….'”

lotr04316.name: Sam, Samwise the Brave
lotr04316.subtitle: Samwise the Brave
lotr04316.game_text: Ring-bound. Response: If a Shadow card is about to add any number of burdens, spot Frodo and exert Sam to prevent this. Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lotr04316.lore: ”'Frodo wouldn't have got far without Sam….'”

lotr04317.name: Sam's Pack
lotr04317.game_text: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. At the start of each turn, you may add (2) to heal a Ring-bound companion.
lotr04317.lore: “He still hopefully carried some of his gear in his pack….”

lotr04318.name: Seven We Had
lotr04318.game_text: Fellowship: Add a burden to discard a condition borne by a Hobbit.
lotr04318.lore: ”'…one we lost at Moria, the others we left at Parth Galen above Rauros….'”

lotr04319.name: Severed His Bonds
lotr04319.game_text: Stealth. Skirmish: At sites 1T to 4T, cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

lotr04320.name: Store-room
lotr04320.game_text: Regroup: Heal an unbound Hobbit once (or twice if you spot Gandalf).
lotr04320.lore: ”'Saruman kept enough wisdom not to trust his Orcs. He had Men to guard his gates…. Anyway, they were favoured and got good provisions.'”

lotr04321.name: Swiftly and Softly
lotr04321.game_text: Stealth. Skirmish: At sites 1T to 5T, cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, prevent a Hobbit from taking more than 1 wound.
lotr04321.lore: “In the deep of night under hard clear stars they set off.”

lotr04322.name: Warmed Up a Bit
lotr04322.game_text: Stealth. Skirmish: Discard an unbound Hobbit.
lotr04322.lore: ”'…we shall be able to stand again, and walk.'”

lotr04323.name: East Wall of Rohan
lotr04323.game_text: When the fellowship moves from East Wall of Rohan, add (2).

lotr04324.name: Eastemnet Downs
lotr04324.game_text: Each time you play a companion here, you must discard 2 cards from hand.

lotr04325.name: Eastemnet Gullies
lotr04325.game_text: Fellowship: Exert 2 unbound companions to play Legolas from your draw deck.

lotr04326.name: Horse-country
lotr04326.game_text: Plains. While you can spot a [Rohan] mount at Horse-country, the move limit is +1 for this turn.

lotr04327.name: Plains of Rohan
lotr04327.game_text: Plains. Fellowship: Exert 2 unbound companions to play Gimli from your draw deck.

lotr04328.name: The Riddermark
lotr04328.game_text: Plains. Fellowship: Exert 2 unbound companions to play Aragorn from your draw deck.

lotr04329.name: Western Emyn Muil
lotr04329.game_text: When the Fellowship moves from Western Emyn Muil, each Ring-bound companion must exert.

lotr04330.name: Derndingle
lotr04330.game_text: Forest. While you can spot an unbound Hobbit at Derndingle, the move limit is +1 for this turn.

lotr04331.name: Eastfold
lotr04331.game_text: Plains. Shadow: Spot 3 [Isengard] trackers to prevent the fellowship from moving again this turn.

lotr04332.name: Fangorn Forest
lotr04332.game_text: Forest. Fellowship: Play Treebeard from your draw deck.

lotr04333.name: Plains of Rohan Camp
lotr04333.game_text: Plains. At the start of each fellowship phase, heal up to 3 wounds from companions.

lotr04334.name: Rohirrim Village
lotr04334.game_text: Each [Dunland] Man may not take wounds during the archery phase.

lotr04335.name: Uruk Camp
lotr04335.game_text: Plains. Battleground. Each time an Uruk-hai is played, that minion must exert.

lotr04336.name: Wold of Rohan
lotr04336.game_text: Plains. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns a companion or ally to a skirmish, add (1).

lotr04337.name: Barrows of Edoras
lotr04337.game_text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Place your hand beneath your draw deck and draw 4 cards.

lotr04338.name: Golden Hall
lotr04338.game_text: Sanctuary. When the fellowship moves to Golden Hall, all Free Peoples weapons must be discarded.

lotr04339.name: Stables
lotr04339.game_text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Exert a [Rohan] Man to play a [Rohan] mount from your draw deck (limit once per turn).

lotr04340.name: Streets of Edoras
lotr04340.game_text: Sanctuary. Each [Rohan] ally may not participate in archery fire or skirmishes at Streets of Edoras.

lotr04341.name: Throne Room
lotr04341.game_text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play Theoden from your draw deck.

lotr04342.name: Westemnet Plains
lotr04342.game_text: Plains. Sanctuary. Each [Dunland] Man may not take wounds during the archery phase.

lotr04343.name: Ered Nimrais
lotr04343.game_text: Mountain. The twilight cost of each companion and ally played at Ered Nimrais is +3.

lotr04344.name: Westemnet Hills
lotr04344.game_text: Plains. When the fellowship moves to Westemnet Hills, heal each mounted companion and mounted ally.

lotr04345.name: White Mountains
lotr04345.game_text: Mountain. When the fellowship moves to White Mountains, Theoden or 2 companions must exert.

lotr04346.name: White Rocks
lotr04346.game_text: Battleground. The Shadow number of this site is +1 for each mounted companion.

lotr04347.name: Deep of Helm
lotr04347.game_text: Plains. Battleground. The twilight cost of the first Uruk-hai played at Deep of Helm each turn is -3.

lotr04348.name: Deeping Wall
lotr04348.game_text: Battleground. Shadow: Play Saruman from your draw deck.

lotr04349.name: Helm's Gate
lotr04349.game_text: Battleground. Each companion and minion bearing a hand weapon is strength +2.

lotr04350.name: Hornburg Courtyard
lotr04350.game_text: Battleground. While you can spot Aragorn, the Shadow number of Hornburg Courtyard is -2.

lotr04351.name: Hornburg Parapet
lotr04351.game_text: Battleground. The fellowship archery total is +1. The minion archery total is -1.

lotr04352.name: Caves of Aglarond
lotr04352.game_text: Underground. Sanctuary. Maneuver: Spot your Uruk-hai and remove (2) to make one of your Uruk-hai fierce until the regroup phase.

lotr04353.name: Great Hall
lotr04353.game_text: Sanctuary. Battleground. Each [Rohan] ally may participate in archery fire and skirmishes at Great Hall.

lotr04354.name: Hornburg Armory
lotr04354.game_text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play a possession to draw a card.

lotr04355.name: Cavern Entrance
lotr04355.game_text: Underground. Skirmish events may not be played and skirmish special abilities may not be used.

lotr04356.name: Hornburg Causeway
lotr04356.game_text: Battleground. The minion archery total is +2 for each unbound companion over 3

lotr04357.name: King's Room
lotr04357.game_text: When the fellowship moves to King's Room without a [Rohan] companion, each unbound companion must exert.

lotr04358.name: Ring of Isengard
lotr04358.game_text: Shadow: Play a [Dunland] minion to draw a card.

lotr04359.name: Wizard's Vale
lotr04359.game_text: At the start of the first Shadow phase, if the twilight pool has fewer than 9 twilight tokens, add (4) (limit once per turn).

lotr04360.name: Fortress of Orthanc
lotr04360.game_text: Battleground. The Shadow number of Fortress of Orthanc is +2 for each companion over 4.

lotr04361.name: Orthanc Balcony
lotr04361.game_text: Battleground. Shadow: Play Saruman from your discard pile; his twilight cost is -2.

lotr04362.name: Orthanc Library
lotr04362.game_text: When the fellowship moves to Orthanc Library, each Shadow player may draw a card for each companion over 4.

lotr04363.name: Palantir Chamber
lotr04363.game_text: Shadow: Remove 2 burdens to play a minion from your discard pile.

lotr04364.name: Aragorn, Wingfoot
lotr04364.subtitle: Wingfoot
lotr04364.game_text: Ranger. Each time the fellowship moves, you may wound a minion for each unbound Hobbit you spot.
lotr04364.lore: ”'Forty leagues and five you have measured ere the fourth day is ended! Hardy is the race of Elendil!'”

lotr04365.name: Theoden, Lord of the Mark
lotr04365.subtitle: Lord of the Mark
lotr04365.game_text: Fellowship: Play a [Rohan] possession on a [Rohan] companion to heal that companion (limit once per turn).
lotr04365.lore: ”'Every man and strong lad able to bear arms, all who have horses, let them be ready in the saddle at the gate ere the second hour from noon!'”

lotr05001.name: Dunlending Rampager
lotr05001.game_text: When you play this minion, the Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards from hand to discard him.
lotr05001.lore: To kill and destroy was the mission of the wild hillmen.

lotr05002.name: Dunlending Renegade
lotr05002.game_text: When you play this minion, the Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards from hand to discard him.
lotr05002.lore: The strength of the hillmen was driven by passion and anger.

lotr05003.name: Leaping Blaze
lotr05003.game_text: Shadow: Spot 3 [Dunland] minions to shuffle your hand into your draw deck and draw 8 cards. The Free Peoples player may discard 3 cards from hand to prevent this.
lotr05003.lore: ”…they saw torches, countless points of fiery light upon the black fields behind, scattered like red flowers, or winding up from the lowlands….”

lotr05004.name: Wild Men of the Hills
lotr05004.game_text: The twilight cost of this minion is -2 during the skirmish phase. When you play this minion, the Free Peoples player may discard 4 cards from hand to discard it.
lotr05004.lore: The swarm of Dunlendings destroyed everything in its path.

lotr05005.name: Baruk Khazad
lotr05005.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to wound a minion. You may take the next maneuver action.
lotr05005.lore: ”…a small dark figure that none had observed sprang out of the shadows and gave a hoarse shout….”

lotr05006.name: Defending the Keep
lotr05006.game_text: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to Draw a card or play a [Dwarven] condition from your discard pile.
lotr05006.lore: ”'I have fought many wars, master Dwarf. I know how to defend my own Keep.'”

lotr05007.name: Gimli, Skilled Defender
lotr05007.subtitle: Skilled Defender
lotr05007.game_text: Damage +1. Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion assigned to skirmish an unbound companion.
lotr05007.lore: preparations, Gimli found it necessary to warn him of the advancing Uruk army.

lotr05008.name: Horn of Helm
lotr05008.game_text: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf companion to make each minion at a battleground lose all damage bonuses until the regroup phase.
lotr05008.lore: ”…sudden and terrible, from the tower above, the sound of the great horn of Helm rang out.”

lotr05009.name: More to My Liking
lotr05009.game_text: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Stack the top card from your draw deck here (limit once per phase). Maneuver: Spot a Dwarf and discard a card stacked on a [Dwarven] condition to take a Free Peoples card stacked here into hand.

lotr05010.name: Balglin, Elven Warrior
lotr05010.subtitle: Elven Warrior
lotr05010.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. While skirmishing a wounded minion, Balglin takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase.
lotr05010.lore: He is a strong fighter. He asks for no quarter and gives none.

lotr05011.name: Break the Charge
lotr05011.game_text: Archery: Exert 3 Elf companions to make the fellowship archery total +2.
lotr05011.lore: A storm of white arrows answered the attacking hand of Isengard.

lotr05012.name: Legolas' Sword
lotr05012.game_text: Bearer must be Legolas. Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot a wounded minion to heal Legolas.
lotr05012.lore: Legolas wielded a longsword to strike from horseback.

lotr05013.name: Taurnil, Sharp-eyed Bowman
lotr05013.subtitle: Sharp-eyed Bowman
lotr05013.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. While Taurnil bears a ranged weapon, the twilight cost of each Shadow possession is +2, and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lotr05013.lore: Taurnil's careful aim can disarm his enemies at long range.

lotr05014.name: That Is No Orc Horn
lotr05014.game_text: Regroup: Spot 3 Elf companions to heal a companion and liberate a site.
lotr05014.lore: Anxious defenders cheered the welcome sound of Elvish trumpets.

lotr05015.name: Birchseed, Tall Statesman
lotr05015.subtitle: Tall Statesman
lotr05015.game_text: Unhasty. Assignment: Exert an unbound Hobbit or discard 2 cards from hand to allow Birchseed to skirmish. Fellowship: Exert Birchseed to Heal an unbound Hobbit.
lotr05015.lore: Slender and royal, he presided over many Entmoots.

lotr05016.name: Down From the Hills
lotr05016.game_text: Spell. Maneuver: Exert Gandalf 3 times to make an unbound companion with the Gandalf signet strength +5, defender +1, damage +2, and unable to take wounds until the regroup phase.

lotr05017.name: Forest Guardian
lotr05017.game_text: Unhasty. Assignment: Exert an unbound Hobbit or discard 2 cards from hand to allow this companion to skirmish.
lotr05017.lore: ”'We keep off strangers and the foolhardy; and we train and we teach, we walk and we weed.'”

lotr05018.name: Fury of the White Rider
lotr05018.game_text: Spell. Maneuver: Spot 3 twilight tokens and exert Gandalf to wound a minion twice.
lotr05018.lore: ”The White Rider was upon them, and the terror of his coming filled the enemy with madness.”

lotr05019.name: Lindenroot, Elder Shepherd
lotr05019.subtitle: Elder Shepherd
lotr05019.game_text: Unhasty. Assignment: Exert an unbound Hobbit or discard 2 cards from hand to allow Lidenroot to skirmish. Skirmish: Exert Lidenroot to wound an [Isengard] minion he is skirmishing.
lotr05019.lore: A most well-founded and considerate Ent.

lotr05020.name: Turn of the Tide
lotr05020.game_text: Spell. Maneuver: Exert Gandalf to discard up to 2 shadow possessions. Any Shadow player may discard a minion to prevent this.
lotr05020.lore: ”'Indeed my friends, none of you have any weapon that could hurt me.'”

lotr05021.name: Be Back Soon
lotr05021.game_text: Maneuver: Discard Smeagol to discard a minion. An opponent may exert a minion twice to prevent this.
lotr05021.lore: ”'Now I wonder where he's got to?'”

lotr05022.name: Evil-smelling Fens
lotr05022.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each site on the adventure path is a marsh. Shadow: Exert Gollum twice and discard this condition to play a minion from your discard pile.
lotr05022.lore: ”'No birds here. There are snakeses, wormses, things in the pools. Lots of things, lots of nasty things.'”

lotr05023.name: Follow Smeagol
lotr05023.game_text: Plays on Smeagol. Regroup: Exert Smeagol or Gollum to play the fellowship's next site ( replacing opponent's site if necessary ).

lotr05024.name: Gollum, Nasty Treacherous Creature
lotr05024.subtitle: Nasty Treacherous Creature
lotr05024.game_text: Regroup: Discard Gollum to exert a companion or ally.
lotr05024.lore: ”'…we won't let you go, either. You're full of wickedness and mischief, Gollum.'”

lotr05025.name: Gollum, Stinker
lotr05025.subtitle: Stinker
lotr05025.game_text: Gollum is strength +1 for each burden. Each times Gollum wins a skirmish, you may add a burden.
lotr05025.lore: ”'Still he's a Baggins, my precious, yes, a Baggins. A Baggins stole it. He found it and he said nothing. We hates Bagginses.'”

lotr05026.name: Look at Him
lotr05026.game_text: Shadow: Spot Smeagol or Gollum to add (1) for each burden.
lotr05026.lore: ”'That's what it is. It's that Gollum! Snakes and adders! And to think I thought that we'd puzzle him with our bit of a climb!'”

lotr05027.name: Poor Wretch
lotr05027.game_text: Plays on Smeagol. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make Smeagol damage +1.
lotr05027.lore: ”'Throttle us in our sleep, that's his plan.'”

lotr05028.name: Smeagol, Old Noser
lotr05028.subtitle: Old Noser
lotr05028.game_text: Ring-bound. To play add a burden. Regroup: Exert Smeagol (or Gollum) twice to reveal the top 4 cards of your draw deck. Wound a minion for each Shadow card revealed. Place those 4 cards beneath your draw deck in any order.
lotr05028.lore: ”'Could you find anything fit for a hungry hobbit?'”

lotr05030.name: We Must Have It
lotr05030.game_text: Shadow: Play Gollum from your draw deck or your discard pile. Skirmish: Discard a card at random from hand to make Gollum strength +3.
lotr05030.lore: ”'No, sweet one. See, my precious: if we has it, then we can escape, even from Him, eh?'”

lotr05031.name: Alcarin, Warrior of Lamedon
lotr05031.subtitle: Warrior of Lamedon
lotr05031.game_text: Knight. The twilight cost of each other knight in your starting fellowship is -1. Assignment: Assign Alcarin to a minion bearing a [Gondor] fortification to heal Alcarin.
lotr05031.lore: Named for a mighty king, Alcarin is determined to prove himself in battle.

lotr05032.name: Citadel of the Stars
lotr05032.game_text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert a [Gondor] Man or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [Gondor] Man.
lotr05032.lore: The city of Osgiliath was the first capital of Gondor.

lotr05033.name: City Wall
lotr05033.game_text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert a [Gondor] Man or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [Gondor] Man.
lotr05033.lore: The war-weary defenses of Osgiliath still protected the Men of Gondor.

lotr05034.name: Fall Back
lotr05034.game_text: Skirmish: Discard all Shadow cards borne by a minion bearing a [Gondor] fortification.
lotr05034.lore: Osgiliath's defenses protected the Gondorian troops.

lotr05035.name: Gondorian Knight
lotr05035.lore: Soldiers of Gondor share a long heritage of defending their borders against Sauron's attackers.

lotr05036.name: Knight of Gondor
lotr05036.game_text: Knight. Fellowship: Discard a [Gondor] condition to heal this companion.
lotr05036.lore: The brave men of Gondor's army were well-armed and armored.

lotr05037.name: Men of Numenor
lotr05037.game_text: Skirmish: Wound a minion bearing a [Gondor] fortification.
lotr05037.lore: ”'…I do not love the bright sword for its sharpness, nor the arrow for its swiftness, nor the warrior for his glory….'”

lotr05038.name: Rally Point
lotr05038.game_text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a knight to transfer a [Gondor] fortification borne by a minion to your support area.
lotr05038.lore: A strategic fallback helps Gondorian knights to plan their counterattack.

lotr05039.name: Stone Tower
lotr05039.game_text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert 2 [Gondor] Men to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [Gondor] Man.
lotr05039.lore: The battlements of Osgiliath provided some defense against Sauron's attackers.

lotr05040.name: Take Cover
lotr05040.game_text: Fellowship: Exert a knight to play a [Gondor] fortification from your discard pile.
lotr05040.lore: Gondor forces at Osgiliath were too few to fight the advancing armies in the field.

lotr05041.name: These Are My People
lotr05041.game_text: Fellowship: Exert Aragorn twice to play any number of possessions from your discard pile onto companions with the Aragorn signet.
lotr05041.lore: ”'…I will die as one of them.'”

lotr05042.name: Turgon, Man of Belfalas
lotr05042.subtitle: Man of Belfalas
lotr05042.game_text: Knight. To play, spot a knight. Maneuver: Exert Turgon to wound a minion bearing a [Gondor] fortification.
lotr05042.lore: He hopes to someday become one of the knights of Dol Amroth.

lotr05043.name: War Must Be
lotr05043.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Gondor] Man strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a minion bearing a [Gondor] fortification).
lotr05043.lore: ”'…we defend ourselves against a destroyer who would devour all….'”

lotr05044.name: Battering Ram
lotr05044.game_text: Machine. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai to place an [Isengard] token on this card. Skirmish: Spot 5 companions and an [Isengard] token here to make an Uruk-hai damage +1. Discard this condition.
lotr05044.lore: “The trees… smote the timbers with a rending boom.”

lotr05045.name: Berserk Rager
lotr05045.game_text: Damage +1. Berserk Rager is strength +1 for each wound on a character in its skirmish. Skirmish: Remove 3 [Isengard] tokens from a machine and exert Berserk Rager twice to wound every ally twice.
lotr05045.lore: Their mission at Helm's Deep was to clear the walls.

lotr05046.name: Berserk Savage
lotr05046.game_text: Damage +1. Berserk Savage is strength +1 for each wound on a character in its skirmish. Skirmish: Remove 4 [Isengard] tokens from a machine and exert Berserk Savage twice to make it strength +8.
lotr05046.lore: Skull-like helmets are distinctive to the Berserkers.

lotr05047.name: Berserk Slayer
lotr05047.game_text: Damage +1. Berserk Slayer is strength +2 for each wound on a character in its skirmish. Skirmish: Remove 5 [Isengard] tokens from a machine and exert Berserk Slayer twice to wound every companion.
lotr05047.lore: Berserkers are the first wave of Uruks sent to battle.

lotr05048.name: Black Shapes Crawling
lotr05048.game_text: Maneuver: Spot X Uruk-hai. The Free Peoples player may assign X wounds to your minions. Play X [Isengard] weapons from your discard pile.
lotr05048.lore: Some were squat and broad, some were tall and grim, with high helms and sable shields.

lotr05049.name: Devilry of Orthanc
lotr05049.game_text: Machine. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert an Uruk-Hai to place an [Isengard] token on this card. Maneuver: Spot 8 [Isengard] tokens to exert every character. Discard this condition.
lotr05049.lore: ”'They have a blasting fire, and… they took the Wall.'”

lotr05050.name: Foul Horde
lotr05050.game_text: Warg-rider. While Foul Horde is not exhausted, it is fierce. While Foul Horde has at least 3 vitality, it is ambush (1). While Foul Horde has at least 4 vitality, it is damage + 1.

lotr05051.name: Grima, Chief Counselor
lotr05051.subtitle: Chief Counselor
lotr05051.game_text: Maneuver: Spot 4 Free Peoples cultures and exert Grima to return an unbound companion, and all cards on him or her, to their owners' hands.
lotr05051.lore: ”'I care for you and yours as best I may…. Let others deal with these irksome guests.'”

lotr05052.name: Isengard Flanker
lotr05052.game_text: Warg-rider. While this minion is not exhausted, he is fierce.
lotr05052.lore: Sharku used his warg-riders to scout and defend.

lotr05053.name: Isengard Rider
lotr05053.game_text: Warg-rider. While this minion is not exhausted, he is fierce.
lotr05053.lore: ”'He has taken Orcs into his service, and Wolf-riders, and evil Men….'”

lotr05054.name: Isengard Scimitar
lotr05054.game_text: Bearer must be an [Isengard] Orc. When you play this weapon, you may add (1) for each site you control.
lotr05054.lore: Orcs from Isengard favor a short, curved sword when mounted.

lotr05055.name: Isengard Scout Troop
lotr05055.game_text: Warg-rider. While this minion is not exhausted, it is fierce. Each time an [Isengard] Orc wins a skirmish, you may exert this minion to control a site.
lotr05055.lore: ”'…where the warg howls, there also the orc prowls.'”

lotr05056.name: Saruman, Master of Foul Folk
lotr05056.subtitle: Master of Foul Folk
lotr05056.game_text: Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. Each time the fellowship moves, you may heal each [Isengard] Orc twice. Shadow: Exert Saruman to play an [Isengard] possession from your discard pile.

lotr05057.name: Scaling Ladder
lotr05057.game_text: Machine. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai to place an [Isengard] token on this card. Skirmish: Spot an [Isengard] token here to heal an Uruk-hai. Discard this condition.
lotr05057.lore: “Hundreds of long ladders were lifted up. Many were cast down in ruin, but many more replaced them….”

lotr05058.name: Sharku, Warg-captain
lotr05058.subtitle: Warg-captain
lotr05058.game_text: Warg-rider. While Sharku is not exhausted, he is fierce. Each time you play an [Isengard] mount, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion (except a Hobbit).
lotr05058.lore: Only Sharku commanded enough respect to control Saruman's warg-riders.

lotr05059.name: Sharku's Warg
lotr05059.game_text: Bearer must be a warg-rider. If bearer is Sharku, he is damage +1. Response: If a skirmish special ability is used in a skirmish involving bearer, exert bearer to cancel that action.
lotr05059.lore: The warg-captain picked the fastest and strongest mount.

lotr05060.name: Siege Engine
lotr05060.game_text: Machine. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Play an Uruk-hai to place an [Isengard] token on a machine. Response: If one or more machines are about to be discarded by an opponent, discard this condition to prevent that.

lotr05061.name: Uruk Engineer
lotr05061.game_text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may place an [Isengard] token on a machine.
lotr05061.lore: Trained Uruk-hai operated Saruman's siege engines at Helm's Deep.

lotr05062.name: Uruk Sapper
lotr05062.game_text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may place an [Isengard] token on a machine.
lotr05062.lore: The destruction of the Hornburg fortifications was the task of Saruman's engineer troops.

lotr05063.name: Uruk-hai Berserker
lotr05063.game_text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each wound on a character in its skirmish.
lotr05063.lore: Goatskins full of blood poured upon berserkers before battle instill their bloodlust.

lotr05064.name: War-warg
lotr05064.game_text: Bearer must a warg-rider. Response: If a skirmish special abiliy is used in a skirmish involving bearer, exert bearer to cancel that action.
lotr05064.lore: Bigger and stronger wargs were ridden into battle.

lotr05065.name: Warg
lotr05065.game_text: Bearer must a warg-rider. Response: If a skirmish special abiliy is used in a skirmish involving bearer, exert bearer to cancel that action.
lotr05065.lore: ”'Tell him there is no hope ahead. He should return to Edoras before the wolves of Isengard come there.'”

lotr05066.name: Warg-master
lotr05066.game_text: Warg-rider. When you play this minion, you may play an [Isengard] mount from your discard pile. While this minion is not exhausted, he is fierce.
lotr05066.lore: ”'…yet I feared that wolf-riders and plunderers might ride nonetheless to Meduseld, while it was undefended.'”

lotr05067.name: Warg-rider
lotr05067.game_text: Warg-rider. While this minion is not exhausted, he is fierce.
lotr05067.lore: “Swiftly a scout rode back and reported that wolf-riders were abroad in the valley….”

lotr05068.name: Wolf-voices
lotr05068.game_text: Skirmish: Make an [Isengard] Orc strength +2 (and heal it if mounted).

lotr05069.name: Wolves of Isengard
lotr05069.game_text: Plays on a plains site you control. Regroup: Exert an [Isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lotr05069.lore: Saruman's warg-riders traveled the plains faster than even the Riders of Rohan.

lotr05070.name: Army of Haradrim
lotr05070.game_text: Southron. Skirmish: Remove (3) to play a [Raider] mount from your discard pile.
lotr05070.lore: The desert lords of Harad support their huge forces with mammoth war beasts.

lotr05071.name: Company of Haradrim
lotr05071.game_text: Southron. Regroup: Remove (9) and spot antother Southron to make the move limit -1 for this turn ( to a minimum of 1 ).
lotr05071.lore: The quick movements of Southron soldiers cut off all paths of retreat.

lotr05072.name: Desert Stalker
lotr05072.game_text: Southron. Ambush (2). Maneuver: Exert this minion and spot 4 free peoples cultures to exert every companion.
lotr05072.lore: They strike only when their prey is haggard and tired.

lotr05073.name: Mumak
lotr05073.game_text: Bearer must be a Southron. Bearer is fierce. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may add (2).
lotr05073.lore: “Sam saw a vast shape crash out of the trees and come careening down the slope.”

lotr05074.name: Southron Marcher
lotr05074.game_text: Southron. Ambush (2). While you can spot a Southron, this minion's twilight cost is - 2.
lotr05074.lore: Hardy desert warriors needed little rest.

lotr05075.name: Southron Runner
lotr05075.game_text: Southron. Ambush (2). While you can spot a Southron, this minion's twilight cost is - 2.
lotr05075.lore: Swift scouts track enemy movements to set up surprise attacks.

lotr05076.name: Southron Traveler
lotr05076.game_text: Southron. Ambush (2). Response: If a Southron is about to take a wound, remove (3) to prevent that wound.
lotr05076.lore: Men of Harad were used to long journeys.

lotr05077.name: Strength in Numbers
lotr05077.game_text: To play, spot a Southron. Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Discard this condition to add (1) for each Man with ambush you spot.
lotr05077.lore: Lacking arms and armor, the Haradrim use swift movements to outnumber their opponents.

lotr05078.name: War Mumak
lotr05078.game_text: Bearer must be a Southron. Bearer is fierce. Each time bearer overwhelms a character, you may add (5).
lotr05078.lore: “Big as a house, much bigger than a house, it looked to him, a grey-clad moving hill.”

lotr05079.name: Armory
lotr05079.game_text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Spot 2 [Rohan] Men to remove 2 tokens from a machine or to take a [Rohan] possession into hand from your discard pile. Discard this condition.
lotr05079.lore: ”'Choose from these ere we go, and may they serve you well!'”

lotr05080.name: Arrow-slits
lotr05080.game_text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Spot 2 [Rohan] Men to discard a possession or a machine. Discard this condition.
lotr05080.lore: “Here and there were clefts in the stone through which men could shoot.”

lotr05081.name: Ecglaf, Courageous Farmer
lotr05081.subtitle: Courageous Farmer
lotr05081.game_text: Villager. Fellowship: Exert Ecglaf and spot 2 valiant Men to play a [Rohan] possession from your discard pile.
lotr05081.lore: Like many of the Rohirrim, Ecglaf no longer had a home awaiting his return.

lotr05082.name: Gamling, Warrior of Rohan
lotr05082.subtitle: Warrior of Rohan
lotr05082.game_text: Valiant. To play spot a [Rohan] Man. Skirmish: Play a [Rohan] possession on Gamling to make him strength +2 and damage +1.

lotr05083.name: Household Guard
lotr05083.lore: “The king and the men of his household were in the Hornburg….”

lotr05084.name: I Am Here
lotr05084.game_text: Fellowship: Exert Theoden twice to heal every other companion with the Theoden signet twice.
lotr05084.lore: ”'The last host of the Eorlingas has ridden forth. It will not return without battle.'”

lotr05085.name: Let Us Be Swift
lotr05085.game_text: Regroup: Spot 3 valiant Men to discard up to 2 conditions and liberate a site.
lotr05085.lore: ”'Let us drive through such foes as are already between us and the fastness.'”

lotr05086.name: No Rest for the Weary
lotr05086.game_text: Maneuver: Spot 3 valiant Men to make one of those Men defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr05086.lore: ”'We must draw all our forces now behind the walls.'”

lotr05087.name: Parapet
lotr05087.game_text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. Archery: Spot 2 [Rohan] Men to remove 2 tokens from a machine or to make the minion archery total -3. Discard this condition.
lotr05087.lore: Upon the spur of rock from the cliff stood high walls of ancient stone.

lotr05088.name: Rohirrim Bow
lotr05088.game_text: Bearer must be a [Rohan] Man. Archery: Exert bearer and discard this possession to wound a minion.
lotr05088.lore: ”'The Rohirrim have good bowmen after their fashion, but there are too few here, too few.'”

lotr05089.name: Rohirrim Helm
lotr05089.game_text: Bearer must be [Rohan] Man. Skirmish: Discard this possession to cancel a skirmish involving bearer. A minion in this skirmish may exert to prevent this.
lotr05089.lore: The armory of Helm's Deep provided raiment of war for her defenders.

lotr05090.name: Rohirrim Scout
lotr05090.game_text: Valiant. Regroup: Exert this companion and spot a [Rohan] possession to return that possession to hand.
lotr05090.lore: ”…scouts rode out far ahead, passing like shadows in the folds of the land.”

lotr05091.name: Rohirrim Shield
lotr05091.game_text: Bearer must be a [Rohan] Man. The minion archery total is -1. Regroup: Discard this possession to heal bearer.
lotr05091.lore: The Rohirrim carried round wooden shields, usable on foot and on horseback.

lotr05092.name: Sigewulf, Brave Volunteer
lotr05092.subtitle: Brave Volunteer
lotr05092.game_text: Villager. Regroup: Exert Sigewulf and spot 5 valiant Men to discard a minion.
lotr05092.lore: The courage of Sigewulf and other Rohirrim like him will not be forgotten.

lotr05093.name: Theoden, King of the Golden Hall
lotr05093.subtitle: King of the Golden Hall
lotr05093.game_text: Valiant. Maneuver: Play a [Rohan] possession on Theoden to heal a [Rohan] ally.
lotr05093.lore: ”'You thought I remained in Meduseld bent like an old tree under winter snow…. But a west wind has shaken the boughs.'”

lotr05094.name: Thundering Host
lotr05094.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a mounted [Rohan] Man strength +3 (and heal that Man if at a plains).
lotr05094.lore: ”…with a rush like the sudden onset of a great wind the last host of Rohan rode thundering into the West.”

lotr05095.name: Dead Marshes
lotr05095.game_text: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 4T, Ring-bound companions skirmishing [Sauron] orcs are strength -1. Maneuver: Spot 2 [Sauron] Orcs to play up to 2 [Sauron] conditions from your discard pile. Discard this condition.

lotr05096.name: Eye of Barad-Dur
lotr05096.game_text: Skirmish: Make a companion or ally skirmishing a [Sauron] Orc strength -1 for each ring-bound companion. Response: If a free people player reveals this card from your hand, discard this card to add 2 burdens.
lotr05096.lore: The Lidless Eye looked out from Sauron's fortress.

lotr05097.name: Gate Soldier
lotr05097.game_text: When you play a [Sauron] condition, you may exert this minion and remove (2) to draw a card.
lotr05097.lore: ”…a host of orcs lurked, ready at a signal to issue forth like black ants going to war.”

lotr05098.name: Gate Trooper
lotr05098.game_text: When you play this minion, you may exert him and spot 5 burdens to draw a card.
lotr05098.lore: “Another dreadful day of fear and toil had come to Mordor; and the night-guards were summoned….”

lotr05099.name: Gate Veteran
lotr05099.game_text: When you play this minion, you may exert him and spot 6 companions to draw a card.
lotr05099.lore: ”…the day-guards, evil-eyed and fell, were marching to their posts.”

lotr05100.name: Grishnakh, Orc Captain
lotr05100.subtitle: Orc Captain
lotr05100.game_text: Tracker. The site number of each [Sauron] Orc is -3. Shadow: Exert Grishnakh twice and spot another [Sauron] Orc to draw 3 cards. The Free Peoples player may add 2 burdens to prevent this.

lotr05101.name: I'd Make You Squeak
lotr05101.game_text: To play, exert 2 [Sauron] Orcs. Plays to your support area. The Shadow number of each site is +1 for each wound on a Hobbit (limit +3).
lotr05101.lore: ”'If I had my way, you'd wish you were dead now.'”

lotr05102.name: Morannon
lotr05102.game_text: Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of the first [Sauron] Orc played at site 4T is -3. Shadow: Spot 2 [Sauron] Orcs and discard 4 cards from hand to draw 3 cards. Discard this condition.
lotr05102.lore: The black gate of Mordor was called the Morannon.

lotr05103.name: Orc Captain
lotr05103.game_text: When you play this minion, you may spot a [Sauron] condition to draw a card for each site you control (limit 3).
lotr05103.lore: ”…far away from hidden holds and outposts in the hills came answering calls….”

lotr05104.name: Orc Cutthroat
lotr05104.game_text: Tracker. The site number of each [Sauron] Orc is -3. Skirmish: Discard another [Sauron] Orc and exert Orc Cutthroat to wound a companion he is skirmishing.
lotr05104.lore: A few Orc casualties were of no concern to him.

lotr05105.name: Orc Fighter
lotr05105.game_text: Regroup: Spot a [Sauron] condition and exert this minion to take control of a site.
lotr05105.lore: The Orcs of Mordor extended the will of Sauron to control the weak Men of the East.

lotr05106.name: Orc Infantry
lotr05106.game_text: Regroup: Spot a [Sauron] condition and discard this minion to take control of a site.

lotr05107.name: Orc Patrol
lotr05107.game_text: Tracker. The site number of each [Sauron] Orc is -3. Maneuver: Exert Orc Patrol twice and spot another [Sauron] Orc to discard a condition.
lotr05107.lore: Sauron's Orcs ranged far and wide, searching for Baggins and the Ring.

lotr05108.name: Orc Pursuer
lotr05108.game_text: Tracker. The site number of each [Sauron] Orc is -1. When you play this minion, you may exert him and remove (2) to draw a card.
lotr05108.lore: ”'…why not kill them now? They're a cursed nuisance, and we're in a hurry.'”

lotr05109.name: Orc Runner
lotr05109.game_text: Tracker. The site number of each [Sauron] Orc is -1. When you play this minion you may exert him and discard 2 cards from hand to draw a card.
lotr05109.lore: ”'There's no time to kill them properly…. No time for play on this trip.'”

lotr05110.name: Teeth of Mordor
lotr05110.game_text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Spot a [Sauron] Orc and remove (3) to stack that minion here. Shadow: Play a [Sauron] Orc stacked here as if played from hand.
lotr05110.lore: “None could pass the Teeth of Mordor and not feel their bite….”

lotr05111.name: Frodo, Master of the Precious
lotr05111.subtitle: Master of the Precious
lotr05111.game_text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Fellowship: Add a burden to play Smeagol from your discard pile.

lotr05112.name: No Help for It
lotr05112.game_text: Regroup: Spot Sam and discard Smeagol or Gollum to remove 3 burdens.
lotr05112.lore: ”'…he'll come back, you'll see. The promise will hold yet a while. And he won't leave his Precious, anyway.'”

lotr05113.name: No Use That Way
lotr05113.game_text: Skirmish: Add 3 burdens to wound a minion skirmishing a companion who has the Frodo signet twice.

lotr05114.name: Rare Good Ballast
lotr05114.game_text: Plays on Sam. Response: If a regroup special ability is used, discard Smeagol or Gollum to cancel that action.
lotr05114.lore: ”'What a hobbit needs with coney… is some herbs and roots, especially taters - not to mention bread.'”

lotr05115.name: Sam, Nice Sensible Hobbit
lotr05115.subtitle: Nice Sensible Hobbit
lotr05115.game_text: Ring-bound. While you can spot Frodo and Smeagol, Sam may not be overwhelmed unless is strength is tripled. Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

lotr05116.name: Sting, Baggins Heirloom
lotr05116.subtitle: Baggins Heirloom
lotr05116.game_text: Bearer must be Frodo. Skirmish: Exert Frodo to make Smeagol strength +2 or Gollum strength -2.
lotr05116.lore: ”'This is Sting. You have seen it before once upon a time.'”

lotr05117.name: You Must Help Us
lotr05117.game_text: Fellowship: Play Smeagol from your discard pile to heal each Ring-bound Hobbit twice.
lotr05117.lore: ”'You will have to come with us, that's all, while we keep an eye on you.'”

lotr05118.name: Hornburg Wall
lotr05118.game_text: Regroup: Spot your minion and remove (9) to make the fellowship move again this turn (if the move limit allows).

lotr05119.name: Nan Curunir
lotr05119.game_text: Plains. Response: If your mounted minion is about to take a wound, remove (2) to prevent that wound.

lotr05120.name: Caverns of Isengard
lotr05120.game_text: Underground. The Free Peoples player wins the game only if the Ring-bearer survives until Shadow players reconcile.

lotr05121.name: Legolas, Archer of Mirkwood
lotr05121.subtitle: Archer of Mirkwood
lotr05121.game_text: Archer. Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may heal a Dwarf companion or another Elf companion.
lotr05121.lore: ”'…even more would I give for a hundred good archers of Mirkwood. We shall need them.'”

lotr05122.name: Eowyn, Daughter of Eomund
lotr05122.subtitle: Daughter of Eomund
lotr05122.game_text: Valiant. Maneuver: Play a [Rohan] possession on Eowyn to heal her.

lotr05123.name: Baruk Khazad (AI)
lotr05123.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to wound a minion. You may take the next maneuver action.
lotr05123.lore: “Axes of the Dwarves!” cried Gimli in the secret tongue of his kin.

lotr05124.name: Break the Charge (AI)
lotr05124.game_text: Archery: Exert 3 Elf companions to make the fellowship archery total +2.
lotr05124.lore: A wall of Elven arrows met the attackers before they reached the Hornburg itself.

lotr05125.name: Foul Horde (AI)
lotr05125.game_text: Warg-rider. While Foul Horde is not exhausted, it is fierce. While Foul Horde has at least 3 vitality, it is ambush (1). While Foul Horde has at least 4 vitality, it is damage + 1.

lotr05126.name: Army of Haradrim (AI)
lotr05126.game_text: Southron. Skirmish: Remove (3) to play a [Raider] mount from your discard pile.
lotr05126.lore: Lacking shields and armor, Southron forces rely on speed and numbers.

lotr05127.name: Rohirrim Helm (AI)
lotr05127.game_text: Bearer must be [Rohan] Man. Skirmish: Discard this possession to cancel a skirmish involving bearer. A minion in this skirmish may exert to prevent this.
lotr05127.lore: A helm split by an Uruk blade often still saves the rider who wears it.

lotr05128.name: Thundering Host (AI)
lotr05128.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a mounted [Rohan] Man strength +3 (and heal that man if at a plains).
lotr05128.lore: The roar of hooves was enough to rout the Uruk-hai without sword or spear.

lotr06001.name: Bound By Rage
lotr06001.game_text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot 2 [Dunland] Men to place 2 [Dunland] tokens here. Response: If a [Dunland] Man is about to take a wound, discard this condition or remove a [Dunland] token from here to prevent that wound.

lotr06002.name: Dunlending Elder
lotr06002.game_text: While you control 2 sites, this minion is strength +5, fierce and damage +1.
lotr06002.lore: Hatred of the Rohirrim is passed from generation to generation.

lotr06003.name: Dunlending Footmen
lotr06003.game_text: The twilight cost of this minion during a skirmish phase is -2.
lotr06003.lore: Driven by Saruman's ranting, waves of Dunlendings descended upon the holdings of Rohan.

lotr06004.name: Dunlending Headman
lotr06004.game_text: When you play this minion, you may spot 2 other [Dunland] Men to take control of a site. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards from hand to prevent this.
lotr06004.lore: The diminished Rohirrim offered little resistance to the advancing Dunland horde.

lotr06005.name: Dunlending Reserve
lotr06005.game_text: The twilight cost of this minion during a skirmish phase is -2.
lotr06005.lore: The relentless campaign of the hillmen drove citizens of the Westfold to the shelter of their capital.

lotr06006.name: Hill Clan
lotr06006.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [Dunland] Man from hand. That Man is fierce and damage +2 until the regroup phase.

lotr06007.name: Ready to Fall
lotr06007.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Spot 2 sites you control and remove (2) to play a [Dunland] Man from your discard pile.
lotr06007.lore: ”'Why do you lay these troubles on an already troubled mind?'”

lotr06008.name: Too Long Have These Peasants Stood
lotr06008.game_text: Response: If a [Dunland] Man wins a skirmish, discard all conditions.
lotr06008.lore: The rabble of Dunland pillaged their way across the Mark.
lotr06008.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set6/lotr06008/Too Long Have These Peasants Stood (6U8).jpg

lotr06009.name: Lend Us Your Aid
lotr06009.game_text: Maneuver: Exert Gimli twice to make him and each Elf companion strength +3 until the regroup phase.
lotr06009.lore: “He hewed a two-handed stroke and laid the last Orc before his feet. 'Now my count passes Master Legolas again.'”

lotr06010.name: Suspended Palaces
lotr06010.game_text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot a Dwarf to place 2 [Dwarven] tokens here. Fellowship: Discard this condition or remove a [Dwarven] token from here to stack the top card of your draw deck on a [Dwarven] condition that has a card stacked on it.

lotr06011.name: Toss Me
lotr06011.game_text: While this card is stacked on a [Dwarven] condition, Gimli is strength +1. Fellowship: Place this card or another [Dwarven] card from hand on top of or beneath your draw deck.

lotr06012.name: Agility
lotr06012.game_text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot an Elf to place 2 [Elven] tokens here. Skirmish: Discard this condition or remove an [Elven] token from here to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -1.
lotr06012.lore: Elves rely upon more than strength in combat.

lotr06013.name: Arwen, Evenstar of Her People
lotr06013.subtitle: Evenstar of Her People
lotr06013.game_text: Skirmish: Exert an Elf to make a minion skirmishing Arwen strength -1.
lotr06013.lore: ”'If you trust nothing else, trust this… trust us.'”

lotr06014.name: Banner of Elbereth
lotr06014.game_text: Bearer must be an Elf companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may draw a card. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this possession to liberate a site.
lotr06014.lore: ”'First name the four, the free peoples: / Eldest of all, the elf-children…'”

lotr06015.name: Elrond, Keeper of Vilya
lotr06015.subtitle: Keeper of Vilya
lotr06015.game_text: At the start of each turn, heal Elrond. Fellowship: Exert Elrond to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [Elven] card, you may take it into hand and heal an Elf companion.
lotr06015.lore: ”'You have foreseen it. War is coming… many will die.'”

lotr06016.name: Forearmed
lotr06016.game_text: Skirmish: Reveal the top card of your draw deck to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -X, where X is the twilight cost of the revealed card.

lotr06017.name: Forewarned
lotr06017.game_text: To play, spot 2 Elves. Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Add (1) to look at the top card of your draw deck. You may discard this condition to discard that card.
lotr06017.lore: ”'Whether by the sword or the slow decay of time, Aragorn will die.'”

lotr06018.name: Galadriel, Keeper of Nenya
lotr06018.subtitle: Keeper of Nenya
lotr06018.game_text: At the start of each turn, heal Galadriel. Skirmish: Exert Galadriel to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is a Shadow card, make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -3.

lotr06019.name: Gift of Foresight
lotr06019.game_text: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to reveal the top card of your draw deck. You may discard it, return it to the top of your draw deck, or take it into hand.
lotr06019.lore: ”'Here you will dwell, bound to your grief, under the fading trees.'”

lotr06020.name: Must Be a Dream
lotr06020.game_text: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to reveal the top card of your draw deck. Heal up to 2 companions whose culture matches the revealed card. You may discard the revealed card.
lotr06020.lore: ”'May the Grace of the Valar protect you.'”

lotr06021.name: Naith Longbow
lotr06021.game_text: Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: Exert bearer to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [Elven] card, exert a minion.
lotr06021.lore: ”'Show them no mercy, for you shall receive none.'”

lotr06022.name: Naith Troop
lotr06022.game_text: To play, spot 3 Elf companions. Skirmish: Exert Naith Troop to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [Elven] card, make a minion skirmishing Naith Troop strength -2.
lotr06022.lore: Now only the bow and the sword can forestall the coming of the Shadow.

lotr06023.name: Naith Warband
lotr06023.game_text: To play, spot 3 Elf companions. While Naith Warband bears a ranged weapon, it takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase and does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lotr06023.lore: ”'But do not think that only by singing amid the trees…….'”

lotr06024.name: Boomed and Trumpeted
lotr06024.game_text: Skirmish: Make an Ent strength +X and damage +X, where X is the number of unbound Hobbits you can spot.
lotr06024.lore: ”'For bole and bough are burning now, the furnace roars-we go to war!'”

lotr06025.name: Crack Into Rubble
lotr06025.game_text: Regroup: Exert 2 Ents to liberate a site and discard a Shadow condition.
lotr06025.lore: ”'To Isengard! Though Isengard be ringed and barred with doors of stone; / Though Isengard be strong and hard, as cold as stone and bare as bone….'''

lotr06026.name: Enraged
lotr06026.game_text: Bearer must be an Ent. Limit 1 per bearer. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.

lotr06027.name: Ent Avenger
lotr06027.game_text: While you can spot 3 Ents, this companion is strength +2.
lotr06027.lore: “As they drew near the flash and flicker of their eyes could be seen.”

lotr06028.name: Ent Horde
lotr06028.game_text: To play, spot 2 Ent companions. Ent Horde's twilight cost is -2 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot. While you can spot more minions than companions, Ent Horde is defender +1.
lotr06028.lore: ”'With doom we come, with doom we come!'”

lotr06029.name: Ent Moot
lotr06029.game_text: To play, exert an unbound Hobbit. Bearer must be an Ent. Limit 1 per bearer.
lotr06029.lore: “But when the Ents all gathered round Treebeard,… then the Hobbits saw that they were all of the same kindred, and all had the same eyes….”

lotr06030.name: Gandalf, Mithrandir
lotr06030.subtitle: Mithrandir
lotr06030.game_text: Damage +1. Each time the fellowship moves, wound Gandalf.
