lotr06030.lore: ”'The Dark Lord has Nine. But we have One, mightier than they: the White Rider. He has passed through the fire and the abyss, and they shall fear him.'”

lotr06031.name: Glamdring, Lightning Brand
lotr06031.subtitle: Lightning Brand
lotr06031.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. He is damage +1. Each time you play a spell during a skirmish, you may make Gandalf damage +1 until the end of that skirmish.
lotr06031.lore: ”'Thunder they heard, and lightning… smote upon Celebdil, and leaped back broken into tongues of fire.'”

lotr06032.name: Host of Fangorn
lotr06032.game_text: To play, spot 2 Ent companions. Host of Fangorn's twilight cost is -2 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot.
lotr06032.lore: ”'Of course, it is likely enough, my friends…that we are going to our doom, the last march of the Ents.'”

lotr06033.name: Quickbeam, Bregalad
lotr06033.subtitle: Bregalad
lotr06033.game_text: Quickbeam's twilight cost is -1 for each Ent and unbound Hobbit you can spot.
lotr06033.lore: ”'But if we stayed home and did nothing, doom would find us anyway, sooner or later.'”

lotr06034.name: Roused
lotr06034.game_text: Skirmish: Exert an Ent to make him strength +1 for each Ent you spot (limit +4).
lotr06034.lore: ”'To Isengard!' the Ents cried in many voices.”

lotr06035.name: Skinbark, Fladrif
lotr06035.subtitle: Fladrif
lotr06035.game_text: Skinbark's twilight cost is -1 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is about to take a wound, exert Skinbark to prevent that wound.
lotr06035.lore: ”'He was wounded by Orcs, and many of his folk and tree-herds have been murdered and destroyed.'”

lotr06036.name: Threw Down My Enemy
lotr06036.game_text: Spell. Skirmish: Make a minion skirmishing Gandalf strength -1 for each wound on each character in the skirmish.
lotr06036.lore: ”'…he fell from the high place and broke the mountain-side where he smote it in his ruin.'”

lotr06037.name: Treebeard, Guardian of the Forest
lotr06037.subtitle: Guardian of the Forest
lotr06037.game_text: Unhasty. Assignment: Exert an unbound Hobbit to allow Treebeard to skirmish. Skirmish: Exert Treebeard to make an Ent damage +1.
lotr06037.lore: ”'The little that I know of his long slow story would make a tale for which we have no time now.'”

lotr06038.name: Don't Follow the Lights
lotr06038.game_text: Response: If Smeagol wins a skirmish, add a burden to discard a minion.
lotr06038.lore: ”'Careful, careful now or Hobbits go down to join the dead ones and light little candles.'”

lotr06039.name: Don't Look at Them
lotr06039.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Spot Smeagol and discard 3 cards from hand to wound a minion Smeagol is skirmishing once (or twice if that minion is a [Wraith] minion).
lotr06039.lore: ”'You should not look in when the candles are lit.'”

lotr06040.name: Gollum, Old Villain
lotr06040.subtitle: Old Villain
lotr06040.game_text: Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to make Gollum strength +1 (or +2 if skirmishing a Ring-Bound companion).
lotr06040.lore: ”'Must take it. The Wraiths are searching. Must take it.'”

lotr06041.name: Master Broke His Promise
lotr06041.game_text: Regroup: Exert Gollum 3 times to wound each companion. The move limit for this turn is -1.
lotr06041.lore: ”'Kill them! Kill them! Kill them both! And then we take the Precious! We be the Master!'”

lotr06042.name: Nasty, Foul Hobbitses
lotr06042.subtitle: Foul Hobbitses
lotr06042.game_text: Response: If Gollum wins a skirmish, add a burden.
lotr06042.lore: ”'We ought to wring their filthy little necks!'”

lotr06043.name: Not Listening
lotr06043.game_text: Response: If Smeagol wins a skirmish, heal him and remove 2 burdens.
lotr06043.lore: ”'They'll wake too quick and kill us… Not now. Not yet.'”

lotr06044.name: Safe Paths
lotr06044.game_text: Regroup: Exert Smeagol 3 times and discard him to wound each minion. The move limit for this turn is +1. If the fellowship moves, each Shadow player may take up to 3 Shadow cards into hand from his or her discard pile.
lotr06044.lore: ”'Soft and quick as shadows we must be!'”

lotr06045.name: Smeagol, Poor Creature
lotr06045.subtitle: Poor Creature
lotr06045.game_text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to make Smeagol strength +1.
lotr06045.lore: ”'And we're so lonely… We'll be nice to them, very nice, if they'll be nice to us, won't we, yes, yess.'”

lotr06046.name: They Stole It
lotr06046.game_text: Plays to your support arear Skirmish: Spot Gollum and discard 3 cards from hand to wound a companion Gollum is skirmishing once (or twice if that companion is a [Shire] companion).
lotr06046.lore: ”'Where iss it, where iss it: my precious….'”

lotr06047.name: You're a Liar and a Thief
lotr06047.game_text: Response: If Gollum wins a skirmish, wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr06047.lore: ”'No, sweet one. See, my precious: if we has it, then we can escape, even from Him, eh?'”

lotr06048.name: Anborn, Skilled Huntsman
lotr06048.subtitle: Skilled Huntsman
lotr06048.game_text: Ring-bound. Ranger. Each time Anborn wins a skirmish, you may make a minion's site number +3 until the regroup phase.
lotr06048.lore: ”'Perhaps under the shadow of the Unnamed some of the beasts of Mirkwood are wandering hither to our woods.'”

lotr06049.name: Ancient Roads
lotr06049.game_text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot 3 rangers, the site number of each minion skirmishing a ranger is +2.
lotr06049.lore: ”'…they go ever more heedlessly, we learn, thinking that the power of their new master is great enough….'”

lotr06050.name: Aragorn, Defender of Free Peoples
lotr06050.subtitle: Defender of Free Peoples
lotr06050.game_text: Skirmish: Remove an [Elven] token to make a minion skirmishing Aragorn strength -3. Skirmish: Remove a [Dwarven] token to heal a Dwarf. Regroup: If Aragorn is mounted, remove a [Rohan] token to wound a minion twice.
lotr06050.lore: ”'…this is the hour when we draw swords together.'”

lotr06051.name: Banner of Westernesse
lotr06051.game_text: Bearer must be a [Gondor] companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may heal another [Gondor] companion. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this possession to liberate a site.
lotr06051.lore: ”'What brought they from the foundered land / Over the flowing sea?… / and one white tree.'”

lotr06052.name: Garrison of Osgiliath
lotr06052.game_text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot a [Gondor] Man to place 2 [Gondor] tokens here. Skirmish: Discard this condition or remove a [Gondor] token from here to make a [Gondor] Man strength +1.
lotr06052.lore: ”'So ever do we watch the shores nigh Osgiliath….'”

lotr06053.name: Mortal Men
lotr06053.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Gondor] Man strength +2 (and exert a minion if you spot a [Rohan] token).

lotr06054.name: Perilous Ventures
lotr06054.game_text: Regroup: Exert 2 rangers to discard a minion (or 2 [Wraith] minions).
lotr06054.lore: ”'But still we will not sit idle and let Him do all as He would….'”

lotr06055.name: Ring of Barahir
lotr06055.game_text: Bearer must be Aragorn. At the start of each of your turns, you may spot a culture token to heal a companion of that culture.
lotr06055.lore: ”'This is a thing of worth beyond your reckoning. For its ancientry alone. It has no power, save the esteem in which those hold it who love my house.'”

lotr06056.name: Trust
lotr06056.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [Gondor] Man strength +2 (and heal a companion if you spot an [Elven] token).

lotr06057.name: Agents of Orthanc
lotr06057.game_text: This minion is strength +2 and damage +1 for each Free Peoples culture that you can spot over 2.
lotr06057.lore: ”'How long is it since Saruman bought you?'”

lotr06058.name: Assault Ladder
lotr06058.game_text: Machine. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai to place an [Isengard] token on this card. Skirmish: Spot 3 [Isengard] tokens here to make an Uruk-hai strength +3. Discard this condition.

lotr06059.name: Banner of Isengard
lotr06059.game_text: Bearer must be an [Isengard] minion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion for each site you control.
lotr06059.lore: ”…blazoned upon every helm and shield the ghastly hand of Isengard was seen.”

lotr06060.name: Berserk Butcher
lotr06060.game_text: Damage +1. Berserk Butcher is strength +1 for each wound on each character in its skirmish. Maneuver: Remove an [Isengard] token from a machine and exert Berserk Butcher twice to prevent all wounds to Uruk-hai until the assignment phase.

lotr06061.name: Desertion
lotr06061.game_text: To play, spot an [Isengard] Man. Plays on a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Assignment: Assign an [Isengard] minion with less strength than bearer to skirmish bearer. Discard this condition.
lotr06061.lore: ”'Who knows what you've spoken to the darkness in the bitter watches of the night?'”

lotr06062.name: Fires and Foul Fumes
lotr06062.game_text: Regroup: Discard 4 [Isengard] orcs to wound a companion 4 times (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr06062.lore: ”'One of them… got caught in a spray of some liquid fire and burned like a torch: a horrible sight.'”

lotr06063.name: Gnawing, Biting, Hacking, Burning
lotr06063.subtitle: Biting, Hacking, Burning
lotr06063.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a regroup action discards an [Isengard] Orc, you may stack that Orc on this card. Shadow: Discard 2 cards stacked here and remove (1) to play an [Isengard] Orc from your discard pile.

lotr06064.name: Iron Fist of the Orc
lotr06064.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a regroup action discards an [Isengard] Orc, you may stack that Orc on this card. Regroup: Discard 3 cards stacked here and remove (1) to discard a Free Peoples possession.
lotr06064.lore: ”'The old world will burn in the fires of industry.'”

lotr06065.name: Isengard Artisan
lotr06065.game_text: Regroup: Discard an [Isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lotr06065.lore: Minions of Orthanc shared their master's fascination with machines.

lotr06066.name: Isengard Builder
lotr06066.game_text: Regroup: If stacked on an [Isengard] card, discard this card to add (2).
lotr06066.lore: ”'They were all singing with harsh voices, and laughing, making a hideous din.'”

lotr06067.name: Isengard Journeyman
lotr06067.game_text: Regroup: Discard an [Isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lotr06067.lore: Drudgery and toil at Isengard left Saruman's minions hungry for sport.

lotr06068.name: Isengard Mechanics
lotr06068.game_text: Regroup: Discard an [Isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion (or 2 companions if you spot 6 companions). Regroup: If this minion is stacked on an [Isengard] card, spot an [Isengard] Orc and discard this minion to add (3).

lotr06069.name: Isengard Plodder
lotr06069.game_text: Regroup: Discard an [Isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lotr06069.lore: Saruman dispatched his trusted Orcs to aid in the sack of Rohan.

lotr06070.name: Isengard Tender
lotr06070.game_text: Regroup: If stacked on an [Isengard] card, discard this card and remove (2) to exhaust a companion.
lotr06070.lore: Unfortunate Orcs assisted in Saruman's foul wizardry.

lotr06071.name: Isengard Tinker
lotr06071.game_text: Regroup: Discard an [Isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lotr06071.lore: ”'I wonder if his fame was… due to his cleverness in settling at Isengard.'”

lotr06072.name: Rohirrim Traitor
lotr06072.game_text: While you can spot a companion bearing an [Isengard] condition, this minion is strength +2.
lotr06072.lore: ”'Once it was a man, and did you service in its fashion.'”

lotr06073.name: Scaffolding
lotr06073.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a regroup action discards an [Isengard] Orc, you may stack that Orc on this card. Response: If an [Isengard] Orc is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards stacked here to prevent that wound.
lotr06073.lore: Towers marked the inner ring, implements of industry.

lotr06074.name: Sharku, Vile Marauder
lotr06074.subtitle: Vile Marauder
lotr06074.game_text: Warg-rider. While Sharku is not exhausted, he is fierce. Regroup: Exert Sharku to add (1).

lotr06075.name: Twisted Tales
lotr06075.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving a [Isengard] Man, you may spot a possession to stack that possession here.
lotr06075.lore: ”'Too long have you sat in the shadows….'”

lotr06076.name: The Balrog, Terror of Flame and Shadow
lotr06076.subtitle: Terror of Flame and Shadow
lotr06076.game_text: Damage +2. The twilight cost of The Balrog is -3 if you can spot a [Moria] minion. The Balrog cannot be assigned to skirmish companions or allies of strength less than 6.
lotr06076.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set6/lotr06076/The Balrog, Terror of Flame and Shadow (6R76).jpg

lotr06077.name: Durin's Tower
lotr06077.game_text: Plays to your support area. At sites 2T and 3T, The Balrog's twilight cost is -3. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a unique [Moria] minion strength +3.
lotr06077.lore: ”'…carved in the living rock of Zirakzigil, the pinnacle of the Silvertine.'”

lotr06078.name: Easterling Army
lotr06078.game_text: Easterling. Fierce. Skirmish: Spot 2 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +1. Skirmish: Spot 4 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +2. Skirmish: Spot 6 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +3.

lotr06079.name: Easterling Polearm
lotr06079.game_text: Bearer must be an Easterling. While you can spot 2 burdens, bearer cannot take wounds. While you can spot 5 burdens, bearer is damage +1.

lotr06080.name: Southron Archer Legion
lotr06080.game_text: Southron. Archer. Archery: Remove (3) to add 1 to the minion archery total for each companion over 4 (limit +4).
lotr06080.lore: ”'But I've heard tales of the big folk down away in the Sunlands.'”

lotr06081.name: Southron Invaders
lotr06081.game_text: Southron. Ambush (1). When you play this minion, you may spot another Southron to play a minion with ambush from your discard pile.
lotr06081.lore: ”'So when you said “Men out of the South, all in red and gold,” I said “were there any oliphaunts?” For if there was, I was going to take a look….'”

lotr06082.name: Trample
lotr06082.game_text: Maneuver: Spot a mounted [Raider] Man to discard a companion (except the Ring-bearer). The Free Peoples player may add (4) to prevent this.
lotr06082.lore: ”'…I stomp round and round, / Never lie on the ground, / Not even to die. / Oliphaunt am I….'”

lotr06083.name: Fell Beast
lotr06083.game_text: To play, discard 2 cards from hand. Bearer must be a Nazgul. Bearer is fierce.
lotr06083.lore: ”'And these winged creatures that they ride on now, they can probably see more than any other creature. They are like great carrion birds.'”

lotr06084.name: Spied From Above
lotr06084.game_text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a Nazgul twice to play a [Wraith] or [Sauron] minion. That minion's twilight cost is -8 and it comes into play exhausted.
lotr06084.lore: “It leaped into all of their minds that the Black Wings had spied them and had sent armed soldiers to seize them….”

lotr06085.name: Sword of Dol Guldur
lotr06085.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. While bearer is Ulaire Toldea, each time he wins a skirmish the Free Peoples player must discard a Free Peoples possession or a Free Peoples condition.
lotr06085.lore: The weapons of the Nine are wrought with sorcery.

lotr06086.name: Ulaire Lemenya, Winged Hunter
lotr06086.subtitle: Winged Hunter
lotr06086.game_text: Regroup: Exert Ulaire Lemenya and discard 3 cards from hand to return a companion (except the Ring-bearer) to owner's hand.
lotr06086.lore: ”…the helpless horror that had come with the cry in the wind and the shadow on the moon….”

lotr06087.name: Ulaire Nertea, Winged Hunter
lotr06087.subtitle: Winged Hunter
lotr06087.game_text: When you play Ulaire Nertea, spot another Nazgul to make the Free Peoples player exert a Ring-bound companion for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.
lotr06087.lore: “A vast winged shape passed over the moon like a black cloud… The stars fainted before it….”

lotr06088.name: Ulaire Toldea, Winged Sentry
lotr06088.subtitle: Winged Sentry
lotr06088.game_text: Fierce. Each time Ulaire Toldea wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion or add a burden.
lotr06088.lore: ”'They are calling for it. Calling for the precious.'”

lotr06089.name: Winged and Ominous
lotr06089.game_text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a Nazgul to place a [Wraith] token on this card. Shadow: Remove 3 [Wraith] tokens from here to add (2).
lotr06089.lore: “It scudded across the moon… outrunning the wind in its fell speed.”

lotr06090.name: Banner of the Mark
lotr06090.game_text: Bearer must be a [Rohan] companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert a minion. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this possession to liberate a site.
lotr06090.lore: ”'Fell deeds awake. Now for wrath. Now for ruin, and the red dawn.'”

lotr06091.name: Blood Has Been Spilled
lotr06091.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard a mount borne by a [Rohan] Man to prevent that Man from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
lotr06091.lore: “They were hemming the Orcs in, preventing them from scattering, and driving them….”

lotr06092.name: Eomer, Rohirrim Captain
lotr06092.subtitle: Rohirrim Captain
lotr06092.game_text: Valiant. While you can spot a [Rohan] Man, Eomer's twilight cost is -1. Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to make a [Rohan] Man strength +2 for each wound on each minion in his or her skirmish.

lotr06093.name: Ever the Hope of Men
lotr06093.game_text: Regroup: Exert 2 mounted [Rohan] Men to discard up to 2 wounded minions.
lotr06093.lore: ”'Would that day was here and we might ride down upon them like a storm out of the mountains!'”

lotr06094.name: Hama, Doorward of Theoden
lotr06094.subtitle: Doorward of Theoden
lotr06094.game_text: To play, spot a [Rohan] Man. Skirmish: Exert Hama to discard a possession borne by a minion he is skirmishing.
lotr06094.lore: ”'Yet in doubt a man of worth will trust to his own wisdom. I believe you are friends and folk worthy of honour, who have no evil purpose.'”

lotr06095.name: Hrethel, Rider of Rohan
lotr06095.subtitle: Rider of Rohan
lotr06095.game_text: To play, spot a [Rohan] Man. Skirmish: Heal a minion skirmishing Hrethel to make Hrethel strength +3 (limit +3).
lotr06095.lore: ”…gaining on the Orcs, gaining on them like a tide over the flats on folk straying in a quicksand.”

lotr06096.name: News From the Mark
lotr06096.game_text: Fellowship: Spot 3 mounted [Rohan] Men to make the move limit for this turn +2. Each Shadow player may draw 6 cards.

lotr06097.name: We Left None Alive
lotr06097.game_text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot a [Rohan] Man to place 2 [Rohan] tokens here. Skirmish: Discard this condition or remove a [Rohan] token from here to make a [Rohan] Man skirmishing an exhausted minion strength +2.

lotr06098.name: Banner of the Eye
lotr06098.game_text: Bearer must be an [Sauron] Orc. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may add (1) for each site you control.
lotr06098.lore: “Stony-faced they were, with dark window- holes staring north and east and west, and each window was full of sleepless eyes.”

lotr06099.name: Corpse Lights
lotr06099.game_text: Twilight. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a [Sauron] or twilight minion strength +1 for each twilight minion you can spot.
lotr06099.lore: ”'I tried once; but you cannot reach them. Only shapes to see, perhaps, not to touch.'”

lotr06100.name: Dead Ones
lotr06100.game_text: Twilight. Damage +1. To play this minion, remove a burden or spot a twilight minion.
lotr06100.lore: ”'The Dead can't really be there! Is it some devilry hatched in the Dark Land?'”

lotr06101.name: Gate Picket
lotr06101.game_text: Maneuver: Exert this minion twice to make the Free Peoples player name 3 cultures. Wound each companion and ally not of a named culture.
lotr06101.lore: “Now the watch-towers, which had fallen into decay, were repaired, and filled with arms, and garrisoned with ceaseless vigilance.”

lotr06102.name: Gate Sentry
lotr06102.game_text: Maneuver: Exert this minion twice and spot another [Sauron] minion to discard a condition.
lotr06102.lore: “In it there was a single gate of iron, and upon its battlement sentinels paced unceasingly.”

lotr06103.name: Gate Troll
lotr06103.game_text: Fierce. While you can spot a Troll, Gate Troll's twilight cost is -4. For each other [Sauron] minion you can spot, this minion is strength +1.
lotr06103.lore: “This was Cirith Gorgor, the Haunted Pass, the entrance to the land of the Enemy.”

lotr06104.name: Orc Insurgent
lotr06104.game_text: Shadow: Exert this minion to draw X cards and add (X), where X is the number of Free Peoples cultures you spot over 2.

lotr06105.name: Peril
lotr06105.game_text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a [Sauron] Orc to play a Nazgul or [Sauron] minion. Its twilight cost is -4 and it comes into play exhausted.

lotr06106.name: Troll of Udun
lotr06106.game_text: Fierce. While you can spot a Troll, this minion's twilight cost is -4. Skirmish: Discard a [Sauron] card from hand to make this minion strength +1.
lotr06106.lore: ”'…Trolls are only counterfeits, made by the Enemy in the Great Darkness, in mockery of Ents….'”

lotr06107.name: Troll's Chain
lotr06107.game_text: Bearer must be a [Sauron] Troll. When you play this possession, you may draw a card.
lotr06107.lore: “Trolls they were, but filled with the evil will of their master.”

lotr06108.name: Wisp of Pale Sheen
lotr06108.game_text: Twilight. Regroup: Spot another [Sauron] or twilight minion and discard this minion to add a burden.
lotr06108.lore: ”'They do not see what lies ahead / When Sun has failed and Moon is dead.'”

lotr06109.name: Held
lotr06109.game_text: Bearer must be Frodo. Each time Frodo is about to be killed by a wound, add a burden instead. When the fellowship moves to site 9, Frodo is corrupted. Regroup: If you can spot no minions, discard this condition.

lotr06110.name: It Burns Us
lotr06110.game_text: Regroup: Spot Sam and Smeagol (or Gollum) to choose an opponent who must reveal his or her hand. Wound a minion X times, where X is the number of different cultures revealed.

lotr06111.name: Kept Safe
lotr06111.game_text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, place 2 [Shire] tokens here. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is about to take a wound, discard this condition or remove a [Shire] token from here to prevent that wound.

lotr06112.name: Long Slow Wrath
lotr06112.game_text: Skirmish: Exert an unbound Hobbit to make him strength +1 and damage +1 for each [Gandalf] companion you can spot.
lotr06112.lore: ”'The coming of the hobbits and the tidings that they brought have spilled it: it will soon be running like a flood….'”

lotr06113.name: Merry, Impatient Hobbit
lotr06113.subtitle: Impatient Hobbit
lotr06113.game_text: Regroup: Discard Merry to heal a [Gandalf] companion.
lotr06113.lore: ”'Don't talk to it Merry. Don't encourage it.'”

lotr06114.name: Pippin, Hastiest of All
lotr06114.subtitle: Hastiest of All
lotr06114.game_text: Regroup: Discard Pippin to choose a Shadow player who must wound one of his or her minions.
lotr06114.lore: ”'By root and twig, but this is a strange business: up sprout a little folk that are not in the old lists….'”

lotr06115.name: Rocks of Emyn Muil
lotr06115.game_text: Fellowship: Play a companion with the Frodo signet to remove a burden.

lotr06116.name: Westfold
lotr06116.game_text: Fellowship: Exert Aragorn twice to play a companion with the Aragorn signet from your draw deck.

lotr06117.name: Meduseld
lotr06117.game_text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Exert 3 companions with the Gandalf signet to play an unbound companion from your dead pile.

lotr06118.name: Hornburg Hall
lotr06118.game_text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Spot 3 companions with the Theoden signet and discard your hand to draw 4 cards.

lotr06119.name: Valley of Saruman
lotr06119.game_text: When the fellowship moves to this site, discard all allies.

lotr06120.name: Saruman's Laboratory
lotr06120.game_text: Response: If your minion is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent that wound.

lotr06121.name: Faramir, Ithilien Ranger
lotr06121.subtitle: Ithilien Ranger
lotr06121.game_text: Ring-bound. Ranger. If Faramir is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. Fellowship: Play a ranger to heal a Ring-bound companion.
lotr06121.lore: ”'Not while Faramir is Captain… his life is charmed, or fate spares him for some other end.'”

lotr06122.name: The Witch-king, Deathless Lord
lotr06122.subtitle: Deathless Lord
lotr06122.game_text: Fierce. Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving a Nazgul, wound an ally twice or exert a companion.

lotr06123.name: Enraged (AI)
lotr06123.game_text: Bearer must be an Ent. Limit 1 per bearer. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.

lotr06124.name: Skinbark, Fladrif (AI)
lotr06124.subtitle: Fladrif (AI)
lotr06124.game_text: Skinbark's twilight cost is -1 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is about to take a wound, exert Skinbark to prevent that wound.

lotr06125.name: Don't Look at Them (AI)
lotr06125.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Spot Smeagol and discard 3 cards from hand to wound a minion Smeagol is skirmishing once (or twice if that minion is a [Wraith] minion).

lotr06126.name: Ancient Roads (AI)
lotr06126.game_text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot 3 rangers, the site number of each minion skirmishing a ranger is +2.

lotr06127.name: Isengard Mechanics (AI)
lotr06127.game_text: Regroup: Discard an [Isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion (or 2 companions if you spot 6 companions). Regroup: If this minion is stacked on an [Isengard] card, spot an [Isengard] Orc and discard this minion to add (3).

lotr06128.name: Gate Troll (AI)
lotr06128.game_text: Fierce. While you can spot a Troll, Gate Troll's twilight cost is -4. For each other [Sauron] minion you can spot, this minion is strength +1.

lotr07001.name: The One Ring, The Ruling Ring
lotr07001.subtitle: The Ruling Ring
lotr07001.game_text: Response: If bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he wears The One Ring until the regroup phase. While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, add a burden instead.

lotr09033.name: Isildur, Bearer of Heirlooms
lotr09033.subtitle: Bearer of Heirlooms
lotr09033.game_text: While Isildur is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or exert 3 companions. While Isildur bears The One Ring or an artifact, each [Gondor] knight is strength +1.

lotr09034.name: Narsil, Blade of the Faithful
lotr09034.subtitle: Blade of the Faithful
lotr09034.game_text: Bearer must be a [Gondor] Man. If bearer is Elendil or Isildur, he is strength +1 for each [Gondor] artifact you can spot (limit +6). Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, exert 2 [Gondor] Men to prevent that.

lotr09035.name: Sapling of the White Tree
lotr09035.game_text: To play, spot an unbound [Gondor] Man. Response: If a [Gondor] Man is about to take a wound, discard this artifact to prevent that.

lotr09036.name: Scroll of Isildur
lotr09036.game_text: Tale.To play, spot a [Gondor] Man. The Ring-bearer is resistance +1 for each [Gondor] artifact you can spot (limit +3). Fellowship: Discard this artifact to play a ring from your discard pile.

lotr09037.name: Seeing Stone of Minas Anor
lotr09037.game_text: To play, spot a [Gondor] Man with 3 or more vitality (or spot a [Gondor] Man and add 2 threats). Regroup: Exert a [Gondor] Man or discard this artifact to discard your hand and draw 3 cards.

lotr09038.name: Seeing Stone of Orthanc
lotr09038.game_text: To play, spot a [Gondor] Man with 3 or more vitality (or spot a [Gondor] Man and add 2 threats). Regroup: Add a threat or discard this artifact to remove (2) or to draw a card.

lotr09039.name: Library of Orthanc
lotr09039.game_text: Shadow: Play an [Isengard] minion to stack the top card of your draw deck on this card. Skirmish: Remove(1) and discard a Free Peoples card stacked here to make an [Isengard] minion strength +1. Regroup: Remove (1) to take an [Isengard] card stacked here into hand.

lotr09040.name: Sack of the Shire
lotr09040.game_text: If an [Isengard] minion wins a skirmish, until the regroup phase, make that minion strength +1 for each site you control and fierce.

lotr09041.name: Host of Moria, Legion of the Underdeeps
lotr09041.subtitle: Legion of the Underdeeps
lotr09041.game_text: When you play Host of Moria, you may play a [Moria] card from your discard pile.
lotr09041.image_path: build/do/assets/cards/set9/lotr09041/Host of Moria, Legion of the Underdeeps (9R+41).jpg

lotr09042.name: Ring of Asperity
lotr09042.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. When you play this artifact, you may wound an unwounded companion. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

lotr09043.name: Ring of Ire
lotr09043.game_text: Bearer must be The Witch-king. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a [Wraith] minion damage +1. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

lotr09044.name: Ring of Rancor
lotr09044.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. Maneuver: Remove a burden to heal each Nazgul. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

lotr09045.name: Horn of the Mark
lotr09045.game_text: Bearer must be Merry or Pippin. Bearer gains the Theoden signet. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, exert him to discard each minion involved in that skirmish.

lotr09046.name: The Red Arrow
lotr09046.game_text: Assignment: Exert a [Gondor] Man to play a [Rohan] Man. You may exert that [Rohan] Man to play a possession on him or her. Discard this artifact.

lotr09047.name: Ithil Stone
lotr09047.game_text: To play, exert a [Wraith] or [Sauron] minion. At the start of each of your Shadow phases, you may draw a card. Shadow: Discard this artifact to play a [Sauron] minion. Its twilight cost is -3.

lotr09048.name: Sauron, The Lord of the Rings
lotr09048.subtitle: The Lord of the Rings
lotr09048.game_text: Damage +2. Enduring. Fierce. For each burden you spot, threat you spot, and site you control, Sauron's twilight cost is -1.

lotr09049.name: Bilbo, Bearer of Things Burgled
lotr09049.subtitle: Bearer of Things Burgled
lotr09049.game_text: Ring-bound. Each time the fellowship moves, if the twilight pool has 2 or fewer twilight tokens, add 2 burdens or add (3). Regroup: Add a burden to play a [Shire] tale.

lotr09050.name: Everyone Knows
lotr09050.game_text: Tale. Each unbound Hobbit is strength +1 for each vitality over 3 he or she has. Skirmish: Prevent an unbound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled. Discard this condition.

lotr09051.name: Goldberry, River-daughter
lotr09051.subtitle: River-daughter
lotr09051.game_text: Each time the fellowship moves to a river, heal Goldberry and Tom Bombadil. Skirmish: If the fellowship is at a river, exert Goldberry to make a companion strength +1.

lotr09052.name: Tom Bombadil, The Master
lotr09052.subtitle: The Master
lotr09052.game_text: To play, remove 2 burdens or 2 threats. Skirmish: Spot 2 [Shire] companions and exert Tom Bombadil X times, where X is the fellowship's site number, to cancel a skirmish involving a [Shire] companion.
